reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing precinct
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lived in a hotel just two blocks from the Ipanema beach. Great bars and restaurants in walking distance.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic location
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The hotel is situated opposite the beach so if you are a beach lover or just want to “people watch” it is a fantastic location. It isn’t really a shopping area but there are bars and restaurants around.The staff at the hotel desk are extremely helpful and courteous and there is always at least one on the desk who can speak English.My room was clean, modern and very nice with a balcony that overlooked the beach.....amazing the activity in that area 24 hours of the day. Brazilian hotels do not supply tea and coffee making facilities and the plumbing is always a bit of a problem. You do not flush toilet paper down the bowl...if you do the bowl fills up and overflows onto the floor! This is not just a problem for this hotel as I had the same issue everywhere else.There is a safe in the room which was great and the bed was comfortable. Breakfast was good - Brazilians like cake for breakfast. The selection was quite good.The food in the restaurant was also good.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ipanema Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fabulous beach. Clean warm water. We found a lovely quiet area to sit near the Uber drop of point in the Sunset Rock side. A few of us did a lovely open water mile swim there and really enjoyed it. Highly recommended

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in Rio
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous beach with stunning views. Less seedy than Copacabana beach, in my opinion, and a little less active. Fewer vendors and restaurants and more locals, which was a plus for me. But also close enough to Copa if you want to ride bikes or scooter there (there are tons of these rentals available).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Most famous beach in Brazil.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most famous beach in Brazil, located in the heart of city next Copacabana, very good service on the beach, most crowded during the weekend.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: "The Girl From Ipanema"
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our Guide played the song.."Tall and tan and young and lovely The girl from Ipanema goes walking ..." and we all look for her (1964)...yes..This is a great beach to enjoy..fro lovers!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most famous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our visit to the beach was a real surprise, the place is controlled by a lot of police, every 100 meters at least to policemen from the city, the army the police department......You feel secure at day time I don’t know about late hours.During weekends the place is crowded with local people giving an special atmosphere not to be missed.On top of it yellow sand and clean sea water make this place UNIQUE.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great besxh
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great, Long Beach. During the week there were very few people and you could come any time. It got a little more crowded during the weekend

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fun beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Loved this beach. Stayed at a condo on the beach. Sand was soft and there were plenty of food vendors serving you. You could sit there and never move off the beach. Clean!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing nice long beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice long beach with many people but have to be careful of pick pocket. There is nice clean sand and good view

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Worth the walk
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Really pretty beach less commercial than Copacabana with lovely beach bars.    Scenic and easy to walk to from Copacabana with lots of bars/shops along the way.   Really clean and well maintained.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: This is Rio!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just beautiful!! Ipanema and Copacabana are the heart of Rio. Any time of the year. Full  of life and people

reviewsWithKeywords.title: DANGEROUS PLACE
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very dangerous in weekends,Many thiefs strolling on the road without any security to protect the tourists.You never can show cameras, cellphones ,watches, nothing of value.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach to enjoy!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice place to visit but be beware of petty theft anytime of the day. Like all the city of Rio de Janeiro, the sights are the most dangerous to visit. But with some caution, disguising your appearance as a tourist, there will be no problems ... there is much speculation about the violence itself.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Decent beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Plenty of facilities and street hawkers. Busier and more commercial than Leme. For young families we preferred Leme as it was more peaceful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great time playing and walking on the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I really enjoyed walking on the beach.  The scenery and water were beautiful.  I was able to play in the water, even though it was a little chilly.  Nice people serving drinks on the beach.  Recommend for sure.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The view is amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I absolutely loved the view at Ipanema beach. We took a bicycle ride and met the sunset on Ipanema. Always overcrowded though.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very famous and a must see in Rio. Cleaner and less dangerous than copacabana beach, can always buy alcohol on beach and there's also outdoor gym equipment you can use too

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just like the postcards
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The famous Ipanema beach appears on many Brazilian postcards and travel guides. It’s a perfect place for a stroll especially during the day which is well patrolled by local police. Along the sidewalk there’re souvenir sellers and food tents. The water is clear and crisp. Lots of action on the soft sand ranging from passive sunbathing to beach to soccer and volleyball.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Always a pleasure
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema 🏖 Beach is where the rich,chic & beautiful people hang out. At any time of day...Though regular folks are there mostly to peddle the ware & 🥘 food. You get coconut 🥥 water 💧 out of the coconut 🌴...Grilled 🧀 cheese off the barbie grill...Heads up do not buy 💦 water from vendors buy the water with gas...The vendor have been known to refill with local tap 💦 water...It may cause you to be 😷 ill....Also there is local WiFi along the beaches 🏝🏝🏝..Some free some you 💰 pay..Inquire at the tourist kiosks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach ever
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My hotel is located right at the beach front. Very peaceful beach. Less crowded and touristic than copacabana. Convenient to run without any distractions or human roadblock. Most of the people there are locals who workout. And it's much more beautiful and cleaner.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Better than Copacabana?
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I read in reviews that this beach and surrounds were cleaner and nicer than Copacabana Beach.  Not to me:  it is much smaller in terms of sandy area, and if you set up, you are very close to the busy road.  I found the restaurants and shops no better than the Copacabana/Leme area.  But, each visitor should see the highlights of Rio, and this is certainly one of them.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The best in Rio, very beautiful. I’m biased, I grew up going there. It’s crowded on weekends. I like to go early in the morning. Don’t go after dark for security reasons (true for every beach in Rio).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beauty and diversity
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The view from this iconic beach is uniquely beautiful. The experience of staying here is very different depending on what time of day you go here from early morning to late afternoon, and what kind of weather wind, clouds or humidity offers. Some days the waves are too dangerous for swimming, but the sight of the mountain surrounded ocean alone makes it worth staying at the beach. Don’t bring expensive or valuable stuff. If you wear swimsuit under some cheap cloth, little cash and a towel You are fully equipped for a wonderful day. My photo is taken from a building because I didn’t bring my phone or camera to the beach at all.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Better than Copacabana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Much better than the Copacabana Beach. No skyscrapers casting shadows after 3PM. Better view of the mountains to the right. Amazing! Can’t really swim though.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Srunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I stayed here with my sister and cousin and it is beautiful. Very safe area and the restaurants and shops in this area are brilliant. The beach itself is very clean, very safe and beautiful. A great area to stay in, would recommend it to anyone visiting Rio.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Day at the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: it is safer than Copacabana, waves vize, but pickpokets are everywhere. Waves are calmer, you can make amazing photos there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Another beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Rio is probably the envy of almost every oceanfront city in the world.  Not only does it have one world class beach, but two.  Both Copacabana and Ipanema are among the best beaches that we have ever visited.  We spent most of our time on Copacabana because our hotel was there, but Ipanema may well be the better of the two.  You can't lose no matter which one you choose.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were staying in Leme which is at the northern end of Cococabana but walked down to Ipanema Beach for the day.  It is well worth the effort.  The water is magnificent.  Got a couple of chairs and an umbrella for R30 which is about 10 dollars. Beers are cheap and it’s easy to get something to eat should you want to. There are a lot of beach vendors walking around but you just politely wave them off if you don’t want to purchase anything.  Great day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A True Gem
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I've been to many tropical locations with my family and due to my aversion to heat I rarely enjoy the beaches. Ipanema is the exception. Clean, white beaches that are full of vendors and cheap places to rent chairs and umbrellas (most of which have wifi) and people drinking coconut water out of coconuts is a common sight. The sand was unlike any sand I've come across, easy to pack down like brown sugar, so it's ideal for sand castles and beach sports. The only thing is that someone told my father not to bring fancy phones, credit cards or leave even your basics unattended. Also, since our hotel happened to be equidistant to Copacabana, I'd say that Ipanema is much more enjoyable.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A must do thing if you’re visiting Rio
reviewsWithKeywords.text: An iconic beach and a bit more upscale that Copabacana. There’s lots going on - people doing sport, people selling all sorts of food and beach necessities, people asking if you want drinks which didn’t seem too unreasonably priced. A polite “no thanks” gets them to move on and if you buy something, they’re your friend for life. The sand is very clean, no rocks etc and the sea is warm enough to swim in and with quite big waves which make it fun but it’s still safe. The toilets are in the life guard buildings. Apparently the closer to posto 9 you get, the trendier you are!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Postcard worthy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great beach. Good for swimming most of the time. Be careful with your things. We stayed beachfront between post 9 and 10. Absolutely wonderful. Evening run was amazing. What inspiration. Highly recommend.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, great surfing and waves and variety. Spoiled only by the constant beach sellers shouting and badgering all day

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach of Rio
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean, beautiful and the people are even more beautiful. It's a very nice people to take your kids, they will nuts, for sure. People will try to sell you everything, but evenwhile doing so, cariocas are the coolest people ever.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Preferred it over copacabana beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: For me this was a nicer experience than the copocabanna beach. It is much deeper and seems therefore less cluttered. I also found that you are hassled a lot less here by sellers which was a welcome distraction after copacabana. Lush golden sand with the perfect view, not much more you could ask for!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach in Rio de Janeiro
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful Beach in Rio de Janeiro, located in a nice neighborhood that includes a large modern multilevel shopping center. Similar to Copacabana, long beach with large sidewalks and a principal avenue. Adjacent to Leblon neighborhood where the big shopping center is located. This is a large open, public beach that includes the Ipanema and Leblon neighborhoods.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: I come here to admire my crush
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There is a girl that I see there and she is so gorgeous and graceful but I spaghetti out every time I see her and I can never think of a way to go over there and start a conversation with her. I'm pretty sure she doesn't even notice me. Ah well. Cool beach though.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Sunset you will see on your life!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema beach is know worldwide for having one of the most amazing views. The Two Brothers Hill at the end of the beach set the scenery for one of the best, most instagramable, sunsets in town! If you decide to come early to enjoy sometime at the beach, be sure to taste Mate Gelado (Iced Mate Tea) and have a Biscoito Globo from one of the many vendors that walk by on the beach.If you need any help during your stay, I'm Vinny from @BrazilExperienceTours get in touch with us through any social media and we'll gladly help you on your stay in Rio.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A gorgeous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Like its sister beach, Copacabana, this is an iconic Rio MUST DO. Beautiful soft sand, gorgeous bronzed bodies and a warm sea. Different from Copacabana in that the waves seem bigger. Stroll along the promenade or hire a motorized scooter and just enjoy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great place to surf, swim exercise or hang out
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spent time here every day of our stay in Rio. On the Sunday morning the roads along Ipanema and Copacabana beaches were closed to traffic, and we joined a great crowd of runners and cyclists getting some exercise in the sun. Plenty of space (and company) to run on other days too. Nice sunsets (though over the land, not the sea). And it seemed pretty safe.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spent one afternoon on Ipanema Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A friend of ours lives in a condo on ocean front on Ipanema Beach.  We visited him one afternoon our first day in Rio.  This beach is a great place to stay.   View from his ocean front patio was absolutely beautiful.  We only spent a few hours at Ipanema Beach, but highly recommend the area.   There are a lot of nice restaurants to walk to in the area.   Every place we went to in Brazil had fresh squeezed juices.  Also, every place we went to in Brazil took our American MasterCard.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Only in Rio
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Only in Rio could you be offered illicit drugs as well as a cold beer as you lounge on the golden sand. With the waves crashing into the shore my mate and I were twice offered illegal drugs and we sipped on a cold frothy after completing the Rio Marathon. No thanks mate I said to them and the other fifty pedlars of various good from hat and sunglasses to massages and watches. Thank goodness for the surf at Ipanema which was absolutely fantastic. The waves were vicious! It was great rehab after the run and it was a truly beautiful setting. The hawkers did ruin it a bit but when in Rio.....

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful but unsafe!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I loved ipanema beach, specially the walk path but it is a bit unsafe.. if you are going for swim don't leave your stuff alone.. you might be robbed !!!! the rest its spectacular !!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach, visited by all ages and nationalities.Many nice little bars and cheap comfortable chairs with or without umbrella.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bucket list tick!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just couldn't be in Rio and not stop for a short while to view Ipanema beach. yes it was a Sunday so beach very busy but we were still able to appreciate it's beauty.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Too touristy?
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Too touristy?Well, if sells Caipirinhas on the beach (a good thing in my eyes) but you do get hassled a fair amount as a tourist, with locals pushing drinks, deck chairs, jewellery etc on you regularly Great views though,  and cleaner than I had feared. We got there just in time for sunset,  and watched the view change completely in 15 minutes (see photos), which I would recommend. Not sure I would want to stay long after dark, mind.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Praia Ipanema got my heart forever!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing beach, clean, safe, tourists friendly, I even lost 5 Kg (seeing Brazilians so driven by sports, I got myself a PT and got back in shape), overall I left Rio...in love with Rio! We'll be back sooner than later!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gotta go to the white sand beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went very early in the morning and the beach was all ours.  You must go, it's incredibly beautiful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and fun beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: White and beach with beautiful views of the mountains to the south and three island right inf front of you, that make it very ubique. The sunset in this area is to die for because the sun hides behind the mountains that has a very exotic shape, so that in itself is already pretty. As any other public beach they have the good and bad, tons of you people playin volleyball or foot ball, music, people running and of course street vendors.The sell the famous female swim suits, and also a delicious grilled cheese, they do it right in from of you and they sell the as an skewer, They also sell cold coconuts and grilled shrimps. It is cheap to get chairs and umbrella, some hotels give it to you.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great place to chill!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema beach is a post card of Rio de Janeiro! The beach is beautiful and a mandatory place to go! As a "Carioca da Gema" I would recommend visiting Ipanema`s Beache on a week day, once in the weekends it is too crowded! But if you only have the weekend you can go there early in the morning or in the last ours of the sun, just don't leave Rio without this experience!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It could be better
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema is a very expensive place but the beach wasn’t cleaned enough to get more than three stars. I saw trash on the streets every where I went.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach, good eateries and fun shopping in Ipanema
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is fun to stroll around Ipanema Beach, clean beach, lot of restaurants and shops around the beach and in the Ipanema area. You can easily spend half a day just strolling around the area. orth a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: WOW!  Just wow!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Everything that you could ever want from a beach is here!  Beautiful sand, food, jewelry, local goods, beach showers....just amazing!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very disappointing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We walked for a while from copacobana beach to here as have always wanted to visit this. What a let down - the beach is small and crowded with no refreshment areas. Not worth the walk - copacobana is superior in many ways.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice , but should improve the infrastructure
reviewsWithKeywords.text: In general it’s a nice beach , but the infrastructure to be improved , not enough toilets, an access to the beach from the road is very difficult and it’s seems like the municipality had no desire to improve the maintenance of the area around.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and clean!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous beach....clear blue waters and golden sand..great for families...sunday morning stroll was very nice and safe... al ot of top notch hotels in this area!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome beach, dangerous water tho
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach lives up to the hype, its beautiful, so clean and a great place to spend the day.The vender can get annoying on the beach but not to bad. Be careful swimming as the waves can get big and the current is strong

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ipanema baby..
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The famous Ipanema Beach. Beautiful beach much better and quiter than Copa. Big and clean with the most beautiful people of Rio. Every where they play football and have more  tourists.arpoador Ipanema and leblon is one beach in reality and the walking street on the beach is something special. This is the place to be in Rio de janeiro

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My husband and I spent most of our sunbathing here at Ipanema beach, while there were many vendors, we found it to be less crowded and more relaxing than Copacabana beach. You can get everything you want at the comfort of your beach towel or chair from beer, cocktails, shrimp skewers, coconut juice, empanadas, etc. We also went back to Marcelo, the chair and umbrella vendor right by Post 9, he was very nice and accommodating and always checked up on us to see if we needed anything more to drink.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Less crowded than Copacabana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We walked to Ipanema Beach after our lunch at Copacabana. It took us about 20 minutes walk from Posto 5. Ipanema Beach was less crowded and cleaner compare to Copacabana. There were less street vendors selling things to you and less restaurants on the beach. I have been told by a local to avoid Posto 8 and 9 as it is not safe especially at night.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beachin out..
reviewsWithKeywords.text: muito bom!worth seeing for. recommending to everyone. worth your time. relaxing and beatiful. chill😁

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A very good and clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It was a Sunday and our first day in Rio. We visited both Copacabana and ipenema beach. Both were very busy but Ipanema had class. It appeared much cleaner and the crowd better. The white sands and the deep blue sea add to the charm of this place. The atmosphere was great .This beach is worth visiting.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just go!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's not a trip to Rio unless to stop by to see the "girl from Ipanema"! Great waves, beautiful sand and Brazilian people abound. Put on your swimsuit and spend the afternoon here. Enjoy!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nicest beach I have come across
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely white sand.. maybe 100m in depth.  Lovely atmosphere.. stunning scenery. Also it felt quite safe but of course as anywhere, keep an eye on your stuff!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in Rio
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Although I stayed in copacabana, I must say ipanema has better views and is less crowded.  The hotel and restaurant prices are higher which probably makes this beach more exclusive for tourists.  It’s really only about half an hour away from copacabana by foot.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Girl of Ipanema
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you want crowded beach, with many famous places in Rio (Girl of Ipanema, Posto 9 (GLS), Farme de Amoedo, General Osório Square etc). Watch out because during the weekend there are many pickpockets around!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Much nicer than copacabanna beach....area is full of legs to shopping nearby.  This time of year is great in that it’s not crowded and still warm

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sandy, very sandy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach, white sand, clear sea, coconuts and cocktails. What else do you need. Also, its a pretty safe beach just dont leave your phone or valubles unattended, which sounds obvious but as we all know, people are stupid.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: World famous beach 🏝
reviewsWithKeywords.text: World famous beach, facilities are okay but local people claim the showers and make tourist pay to use it. Pay attention!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach, but just that, a beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I tend to give really realistic reviews, so I won't change it up for this. The beach is really pretty and of course being on the ocean is nice, however, it is only a beach. A very crowded one at that. Bring comfortable walking shoes and avoid the street food vendors. They don't always wash their hands and you're not meant to drink tap water in Brasil which they often use to wash the fruit for the drinks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: So much beautiful sand.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We walked along the side of the beach which was a lovely expanse of clean sand with lots of beds and umbrellas for hire. There were also vendors continually offering food and cool drinks to the sun worshippers. If water sports are for you there were a number of activities to participate in.Yet another iconic place well worth visiting.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: relaxing beach with lots of food options
reviewsWithKeywords.text: wonderful place to enjoy the sunshine and all the food options that are available. the vendors come to you so no need to walk around looking for food and drink, that's nice. there are no change rooms so go in your swimwear when you're planning on a beach day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Classic
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful and world renowned beach, just be sure to stay safe. People will try to sell you drugs at certain parts of the beach, and the cops don't care.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Go to this part of the beach for "me" time
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema beach is quieter and you get space from other people. There are still some let's say "unique" people on the beach like the white trustafarians (rich western hippies) sleeping in a binbag but that's not Brazil's fault, blame the parents (and if those parents are reading, I think you should give me your kids' trust fund money and I will make good use of it).The sand was lovely (hot!) and the water lovely. It's the more peaceful stretch of the beach. I will refrain from using the word "boring" but it's sitting there in the subconscious. I will however use the word "middle class". It's less lively.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The girl from Manchester hits ipanema
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach, not threatening and good shops two streets back. We were told to go to the fasano hotel end from our hotel in Barra great tip. Nice bars and restaurants.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Walking with the girl and the boy and the people from Ipanema
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sunday mornings the motor traffic along Ipanema is rerouted and the street is given over to walkers, runners, skaters and bicyclists to enjoy the sun and breeze along the beach. A wonderful pageant of young and old.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: STUNNING
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is a lovely, but very touristy place. The beach bars along here and Copacabana are great for a light snack and drink during the day. If you are lucky (like me) you may get involved in a game of football or volley-ball with the locals. If not, its easy enough to spend a day or evening here in the sun or water (it is beautiful clear). Well worth a visit as beaches go it is easily one of the most beautiful I have seen.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cleaner and Peaceful version to Copacabana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sand:Whiter sands than compared to Copacabana; and softer.Water:Seemed cleaner and more clear. Tides weren't as strong as CopacabanaAmbiance:Had more of a hippy, artsy, peaceful vibe. Copa was more lively and energetic.Less vendors on the beach and restaurants on the strip; but still had a handful to address invidual needs.  Distance:From Windsor Martinique (Copacabana area); it is more accurately 20-25 mins with a normal pace of walking to Ipanema Beach. Hotel said it would be just 5-10 mins. I don't thinks so but maybe if you are a fast walker. Then again, things often seem like a shorter distance when you are familiar with the neighbourhood. I timed it to get a general reading of distance vs time so that I know for the next time I visit.There is the main beach. Behind it is another smaller beach; it is more secluded and has a nice view of the Rio landscapes. At the end of the main beach is rocky cliff where you can sit to enjoy the mountain views and the stretch of the full beach; you can also tan here and absorb the sun rays, as I did without getting wet or sand in my shorts. Definitely a more quiet alternative to Copacabana. And in general, Ipanema and its neighbourhood is suppose to be a lot more chic and higher class than the copacabana  area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Upscale beach in an upscale neighborhood. Some levels up from Copacabana beach in a sense that it is just more touristy. Cannot get to this part of town easily by public transportation: taxi or rental car only. Great upscale shops, restaurants around. Very pleasant and pleasing. And very relaxing. Copacabana is happening and hopping by contrast.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful wide beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful wide, white sand beach. Good for an early morning walk. By 11 am you cannot see the water with the many merchants setting up shop in front of you.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ipanema FASHION
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The best beach in Rio, south zone. Not only regarding the clear water but also the updated people who usualy to go there to practise sports like " altinha", frescoball, volleyball and sunbathing with the most fashion beach wear. Vendors go back and for selling all sort of stuff. Big view of Vidigal favela and best sunset ever from Arpoador rockstone on one side of the beach. Do not leave your belongin alone in the sand while swimming.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A spectacular view!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema Beach is one of the most amazing places you'll ever have a chance to experience. It has a unique blend of nature&cosmopolitan flair, that kind of gets under your skin, and you're instantly overwhelmed by it. You can spend the whole day or just a few hours, but don't miss: going into the sea, having a splash in the waves; drinking some "Caipirinha" (from the kiosks at the sidewalk); just sit by the sidewalk and watch how the Brazilians enjoyed the beach, the "calcadao", as they call it, and finally don't miss the sunset from The Arpoador point.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Always wonderful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Going to Ipanema beach during the week is great as the crowds are there in general in the weekends. I did stand up paddle last time in Posto 8, and it was awsome! Loved it! The water was crystal clear!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The beach is relaxing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had some chairs for 10 r each and went into the sea to jump the waves . There is great scenery around and sport going on everywhere on the beach . The sea isn’t cold and the beach is sandy but the can shower off the sand . There are many sellers of food and drink plus clothes . Could become annoying after a while .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of Rio's iconic beaches.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is one of the special locations to visit when in Rio. Particularly during the Southern Hemisphere summer months. When there you will see loads of local people enjoying their beautiful beach. They will be doing all kinds of things particularly playing ball. And you will see plenty of the iconic tanga swimming costumes. On the subject of personal safety and security - the rules of common sense apply. Thus try not to look like an obvious tourist. Dress down. Don't wear flashy expensive clothing nor jewelery. No expensive cameras to be visible. Don't do anything stupid. Then you should be OK. You are sure to enjoy this beautiful beach. We can't wait to go back in early 2020.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you ask me which is better Ipenema or Copacabana, I prefer Ipenema, less crowded, better athmosphere.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of my favorite city beaches in the world. So far at least (~;
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of my favorite city beaches in the world. So far at least (~;The water looked clean, the beach sand was soft and pretty darn clean all considered. We stayed in front of Posto 8 and had the best view of a double rainbow our second day. Unforgettable.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not as busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema is a more upmarket area of Rio , so if you want to escape the tourist masses of Copacabana beach then this is definitely the option , it's quieter but still has a great beach with football & volleyball "matches" on the go all the time. Next to Arpoador Rock , which is famous for sunsets. Also numerous vendors selling their refreshments & souvenirs on/along the beachfront

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautifu, Clean and Sereal Place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was staying in Copacabana Beach. I took a a subway metro to Ipanema just to lazz around the beach and also to shop around. The beach is more cleaner and less populated than Copacabana. It is a must visit in your list of places to visit in Rio.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing Views and Big Waves
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went to Ipanema Beach when it was hot outside, and the cold water was just what we needed. We didn't even need to ease into it; it felt that great. The waves are enormous sometimes, and they will bring you under. I recommend staying close to shore if possible. The beach was very clean, white sandy beach and clear waters.  The views of the mountains are breathtaking. You can rent chairs and umbrella if need be, and there are places to get a drink or food nearby. This beach is just a 10-minute walk give or take from Copa Cabana Beach. Going to Ipanema was one of the most memorable and fun times I had in Rio.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It's a beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach area is quite expansive. There is a lot of development along this stretch of coastline taking in Copacabana and Ipanema.  I did notice a very sensible thing - water was being sprayed along parts of the beach to allow beachgoers to walk on the otherwise very hot sand.  For us we're not great sun-worshippers so it was a matter of just walking along and having a look.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Tall and tan and young and lovely....maybe
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Even though Not tall, tan, young I LOVED Ipanema Beach. Especially loved the unique walkway the length of the beach. It was a hot, humid day and we had just finished shopping in the Ipanema Hippie Market. What a great day in Rio!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach ever
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I have been to a lot of beaches but none hold a candle to Ipanema. The water is warm. The waves are strong. The sand is clean and fine. And there is nothing floating around in the water. No seaweed like you get on the California beaches. Plus anything you need to eat or drink is brought to you.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but a lot of thievery.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Please, please, please do go to Ipanema Beach if you go to Rio, but don't take much with you. Don't flaunt cell-phones or a lot of money or other expensive stuff. Don't wear expensive jewellery or any jewellery. ALWAYS rent a chair and probably an umbrella from one of the baraccas lining the sidewalk and keep your things in a beach bag and tie it to your chair or umbrella he baracca workers will often keep an eye out for your stuff, but don't count on it. If you or both of you or all of you leave your spot to go in the ocean ask someone close by to keep an eye on your things. I have witnessed stealing every day this trip. Its very bad, the worst I have seen in 8 years. The main culprits are the cigarette sellers who wander the beaches scouting out careless people. They work in gangs and keep in touch with each other on cell-phones. THEY ARE DANGEROUS. They swarm like piranha when they have spotted a chair that has some-one's things on it and one by one they will swoop in until they get what they want. It all happens very subtly and very quickly. Usually all the people around don't see a thing. Just be careful! Evidently (on hear-say) the favela chiefs have made a deal with the police that they have free reign of the beach and the police stay up on the sidewalks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach but horrible people
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited Ipanema beach on a weekend with local people and it was terrible it's dangerous you have to be very careful of your stuff otherwise it's 100% sure the will rob you and the people there was horrible seems like the people from the favelas come to the beach...anyway the beach is nice  but i didn't like the people and there were many vendors selling whatever you can imagine it's fine because you don't have to bring anything but your presence and you can eat and drink as much as you want for good prices.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach with big waves
reviewsWithKeywords.text: All of the beaches have people who will get you chairs, umbrellas, drinks etc and they are very reasonably priced. As there are lots of people who do it the prices are very standard. Some of them offer wifi and will watch your things when you go for a swim. The waves can be large and the rip currents can be dangerous so not the best for small children.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ipanema beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice place to stay. Manu hotel..restaurants...shopping...and tua beautiful beach of Ipanema. One of the best

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Horrid
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is awful non stop vendors beggars no decent beach restaurants no way to relax on this beachViews are beautiful but better go elsewhere

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ipanema Stay
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you visit Rio I recommend staying in Ipanema - the beaches are clean, the location is central and safe.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: one of the best in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema is quite calming and less lively than copacabana but you really get to enjoy the beach and the calm here. The hotels like sofitel provide their own cabanas and the beach is beautiful. The sands are fine, waters are warm, this is the ideal beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Iconic Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Try the green coconut water for a very refreshing break when the weather is really warm. Sand is lovely.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice but fairly unsafe
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Perhaps the nicest beach in Rio de Janeiro. Wavy sea, not suited for kids. Fairly clean water. One of the costliest neighborhoods in Brazil. But beware of thieves, especially on weekends. A pity!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It’s a beach...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Went for a look at Ipanema beach and a bit of a walk around. Lots of blokes renting umbrellas and beach chairs, selling drinks etc. There is no doubt it is a lovely beach but when all is said and done, it’s just a beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great way to spend an afternoon or two!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our hotel was literally around the corner so we visited the beach quite a bit over the week. A great place to watch people! Lots of local ‘tents’ offering you chairs, parasols for not too much money.....great caipirinhas! We enjoyed the area between posts 9 & 10....you can buy endless drinks, snacks, sandwiches and even sunglasses, lotion & bikinis. The surf is fun but take care of the undertow. Beach is fairly clean and there is a fresh water shower hose. Weekends get busy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: great beach !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not only is this a great clean beach but the vendors are great! you can by all kinds of handmade gifts and art directly from the local artists. Take note of the mosaic sidewalks, awesome!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice beach with friendly Brasilians
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If body culture is a statement, than you have to be here. Well shaped young girls AND guys are parading none stop on the beach and the pavement. But also people of all ages with not such great bodies walk around without caring at all: everybody is relaxed and happy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Better than Copacabana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were staying in Copacabana, not far from Ipanema. I thought Ipanema beach was a better beach to visit; it was cleaner, less busy, a bit more vibrant and the area seemed overall a bit "classier". I think that is down to the fact it's slightly more residential that touristy. We walked along the beach a few times (not really the type to sit there for hours) and it was always pleasant and enjoyable.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great time!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I love Brazil. Ipanema was just great. The beach was clean and water fresh. Just the waves were quite big. I’m not sure if I would take my kids with me. We always hired little chairs on the beach, the drinks are very cheap and the staff look after you. We only met friendly people ... We had a great time!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It was a little over cast the day we walked along the beach but we stopped for a tall boy (473mL Brahma Beer for $6R) and enjoyed the scenery. There were a lot of people starting to crowd in and they had nets up for FootVolley (very cool to watch)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wish I had stayed here
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Only drove through Ipanema because we were staying back at Copacabana. It looks great - clean and tidy much better on the eye than Copa.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ipanema is THE BEST!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There are 4 beaches in the main tourist area of Rio:  Leme, Copacabana, Ipanema, and Leblon in that order (with Leme at the furthest edge, followed by Copa, etc.).  My favorite beach is Ipanema.Copacabana and Ipanema beaches meet at a point.  For example, consider the left side of this page Copa beach, and the top edge of this page Ipanema beach.  Leblon is then to the right of Ipanema, meaning Ipanema is in the middle.  So, it's very easy to travel to other beaches when you're in the middle.Copa seems to be more for older adults and families, whereas Ipanema had a younger, hipper vibe and is where folks play a lot of beach volleyball.  Additionally, if you want to see some of the most beautiful people in the world, Ipanema would be it in my opinion.Copacabana has a small shopping strip where local vendors sell souvenirs, etc., but again, you can get there by being at Ipanema.  TIPS:- Rent a bike or electric scooter and you can ride all along the coast and see all 4 beaches.- If possible, stay at a place overlooking the tip of Copa and Ipanema with a view of the water.  You'll get to see both beaches and some amazing sites.  Otherwise, stay in Leblon.  Tons to do there.- While on Ipanema, be sure to stop at a local stand and drink directly from a cold coconut.  It's the best coconut water in the world!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: head here for the evening Rio sunshine
reviewsWithKeywords.text: a beautiful stretch of beach with island views and it keeps the sun after it goes behind the buildings at Copacabana

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Go to the beach in the morning, in the afternoon it get's very busy. Rent umbrella and chairs for the beach at the vendor's. Very nice beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Day at the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice sunny day, clean and warm waters. Lots of vendors decent food and drinks available, would highly recommend

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach for perfect sunset photos
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema is one of the places where you can take the most beautiful sunset photos.  There are a lot kiosks line up on the pretty mosaic lined sidewalk, and you can grab a cold drink and watch people from all ages, sizes and shapes enjoying themselves. Do be careful at nighttime because there is crime in the area, stay off the beach late night and rather walk on the promenade side where it I safer.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ipanema Girl
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach.   So many gorgeous looking young people on the beach. Also families with children.  A bit sophisticated crowd than Copacabana Beach.  I could stay here longer time just chilling.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most famous beaches in the world and it is very beautiful. Plenty of activities to see and do on the beach. Run along the coast line or street that borders this coastline is a great run as well. There are games of all sorts being played on the beach as well. Amazing pictures to be taken here as well. Disclaimer I  came in 2016 when I visited Brazil for the 2016 Olympics

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ipanema in the sun and the rain
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Certainly the beaches in Rio are very special and the number of people and beauty depends on the weather.The tides and surf are not for the faint hearted and can be very strong, with dangerously high waves.Great for photography, but less so for swimming.Others commented on trash on the beach - that wasn’t too noticeable, but the pavements needed some repair. But that is the same throughout most of the city.Did like the use of spraying water along strips of the beach to walk on, keeping feet cool and giving a firm base to walk on - very sensible.A must see if the are Rio, with good weather.Not much to see or photograph in the rain.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: wide beach with great sane,  lots of trash on the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Excellent beach from other beaches.  very hot but the water was cool.  Dangerous rip tides.  Disappointed with the amount of trash on the beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is quieter than copacabana but still beautiful. Nice breeze as well to help with the heat.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A pale shadow of the beach that inspired the song
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The maior seems to have abandoned the city and the beach suffers from it.The sidewalks have huge holes, the dirt is everywhere and you don’t feel safeBut nature can’t be changed and the beach is still beautiful

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach in south zone
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The best beach in  souh zone area in Rio de Janeiro city. Beautiful people, good kiosks and excellent Caipirinha.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic beach, amazing sunset
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema beach is a very famous place in Rio and very worthwhile visiting. Around the corner from the famous Copacabana, Ipanema beach is even more beautiful. Prices are slightly higher here then in Copacabana, and if you are clearly a tourist, be aware local sellers will definitely charge you a higher price (potentially twice as much) as they would a local for something like a beach towel. The most amazing thing about Ipanema is the sunset. This is a review, but there are barely words to describe the beauty of this sunset, with the backdrop of the mountains and the buskers filling the air with music as you stroll along the pristine sands of Ipanema.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best one in Rio!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Definitely enjoyed it more than Copacabana. The sand is white and the water is turquoise. There was a beautiful sunset! Many places to eat too!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: best beach in Rio
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach. Not so narrow as Copacabana, but with Cleaner water and not so crowded. there was a lot of people on beach during Carnival, however it was possible to find place near sea.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beaches and sights everywhere
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We lucked out with the gorgeous weather to see this beach and Copacabana. People everywhere. The water and waves were quite nice as well. There were a lot of vendors selling anything from food and drinks to sunglasses and smokes. The boardwalk is as cool as you see in the pictures. Btw - If you're from the USA or Canada be prepared for a lot of skin.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A new kid in town
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beautiful beach is taking over from Copacabana,  it is becoming more trendy and more upscale catering for more modern clientele...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the many things you must see when visiting Rio
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful clean beach with many places to stop for drinks and souvenir shopping. Just keep your bags firmly in your hands as there are pickpockets

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful stunning views and amazing clear water!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I recently visited this amazing  beach made famous by Antonio Carlos Jobim a Brazilian singer who wrote the song about The girl on Ipanema that was made internationally famous by Santana, the Brazilians are so proud they named the international airport in Rio after him 🎼The beach is really clean lots of space to soak up the sun and swim and take some time to climb up the rocks and soak in the amazing views. Definately one to visit!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ipanema is nicer than Copacabana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema is a beautiful beach but after traveling around the world it is not as spectacular as I had expected

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wow
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just another beautiful beach in Rio, clean sand, a little surf and plenty of sunshine,  and all the usual facilities of course.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach, with good views.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing beach with good views. Easily accessible by road. A must go in Rio. And not too crowded when we went there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Unique Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: For me, one of the most beautiful beaches in Rio. Besides the beauty reminds me the music: Garota de Ipanema (Girl from Ipanema)For those who like it, this is a place to admire, not just the sea, but to admire the most beautiful silhouettes both male and female. Not a place to harass, quite the opposite. Respect is good anywhere, but surely, here you will not have to fail to see, both men and women worthy of admirationThe water is generally a little cold for most of the year, but nothing to be discouraged to experience the sea, to feel the waves and to admire, from the sea, the beauty of this city so exhilaratingThe strip of sand, white and fine is good both in width and in extent.There are many street vendors, who selling everything. Particularly I do not recommend anyone to anything except drinks, because as the heat here, it is usually very intense and since it is not possible to know for sure the level of hygiene in the handling and the preservation of the products sold here, it is better to be limited to beverages, preferably industrialized ones. If you wish to eat something, there are several good restaurants nearby, where you can eat more peacefullySecurity here is better than other beaches in the city, which is not to say that you should not be aware of your belongings, especially your cell phone. Today there are waterproof protections for mobile, where you can also put small values or even copy of documents; this makes your life on the beach easier. There are chairs usually accompanied by umbrellas. If you are a visitor in the city, I think they are worth it even when they may seem a bit too expensive. They give you protect yourself from the sun and it also allows you to better protect your belongings.Coming to Rio, do not forget to visit this marvel of Rio

reviewsWithKeywords.title: perfect beach and people
reviewsWithKeywords.text: no relaxation though as food/drinks vendors walk and shout non stop.. Still amazing :)its among the liveliest beaches i have been to.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema Beach is more upscale than Copacabana Beach which we also enjoyed. More people seem to flock to Ipanema - the place was packed. We rented two Beach chairs and an umbrella for only 30 real, for an unlimited time period. There are many vendors walking the Beach selling food and drink, bathing suits, sun screen, etc...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Large Beach with Lots of Action
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice clean, light sand beach. The beach was very active during our weekend plus stay: souvenir and food booths, a modern music evening concert, sunsets and muchas personas. The ocean water temperature was in the 70’s F. /22 C. The waves are powerful because of the beach’s sharp drop off. Showers are available. Water is dripped on the path from the street to the beach to keep you feet cool?  Palm trees are close to the street in case you have forgotten your umbrella; the sun is really hot. Copacabana Beach is walkable, about 2 miles/3+ km to the east.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Top of the list in rio
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The first place to go in rio. Beautiful beach, beautiful people relax with some drinks and food from a kiosk or grab a chair and umbrella either way you can spend hours on this beach. When you done spend the rest of the day wondering around Ipanema itself

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sun, sand, sea & people watching in a beautiful location
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We took a walk along Ipanema beach and found it a beautiful place to appreciate the mountain views, sun, sea and warm sea. The beach has a really relaxed vibe and there is plenty of space to relax despite this being a city centre beach. There are plenty of places to rent a sun lounger and you can readily get drinks from the sales people who ply the beach carrying drinks or from the beach stalls. We stopped for a coconut (through a paper straw) at the end of the  beach which was a wonderul thing to do to stop and people watch.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Easy to rent umbrellas
reviewsWithKeywords.text: And chairs. Sea is lovely right there. Vendors sell all that you would need, drinks, bikinis, snacks...vendors are helpful, not annoying.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cool Vibe at Ipanema
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Really enjoyed our time at Ipanema Beach!! Spent many days here during our stay in Rio. It is much quieter than Copacabana Beach but it provides a really cool, laid-back, artsy vibe. Something to definitely experience. The views are beautiful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Well you have to, don’t you?
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Walked round from Copacabana. Much quieter and far less commercial. Waves more powerful. People were actually surfing. Not such good waves as the west coast of France though!Iconic beach. Iconic place

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Rubbish
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Better than Copacabana but we still saw loads of rubbish in the sand . Wish people respected the environment more . It costs nothing to pick up your rubbish and put it in the bin instead of throwing it in the ocean or leaving it on the beach:(

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ioabena beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach but you could not see the sand from all the umbrellas and people on the beach. Miles of beach with umbrellas.If you love the sand and water then you will love this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The Girl from Ipanema Does Live Here at this Gorgeous Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Like the Bossa Nova song, you will see many beautiful people, with their skimpy bathing suits on this urban beach. It definitely attracts the upscale sunbathers and their hangers on. Many restaurants nearby and other  options.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at a hotel walking distance to this beach. It was clean and really nice. It was great to sit on the sand and go into the water. It was crowded but not too crowded. We were very happy there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: J’adore!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I visited Río de Janeiro with my friend, Ipanema it’s very clean and safe, more than Copacabana. I love it and I want to come back!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Really good beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I visited this beach with my friend, and we liked it, very clean and safe. Water was perfect and you can see a beautiful sunset.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fluffy sand of an agreeable temperature
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sand at Ipanema Beach is of the most fluffy variety, and its temperature also most agreeable, ideal to sit on in the evening without getting a cold bottom.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ipanema Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach- I liked this beach better than Copacabana beach.Only 10 min walk from Copacabana beach. I liked the area here as well- we walked into the neighborhood, found a nice coffee shop, stores, local market happening. It was nice.The beach is clean and the waves are very powerful here. The views are good. You can kind of see the favelas at the tip of the beach. The beach is long and stretches far. You can see christ the redeemer as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A great beach. Very clean but waves very powerful. We walked from Copacabana beach which is only 5 to 10 mins walk.  First day very windy and cloudy but still beautiful.  From the beach you can see Christ the redeemer in the mountain. Locals selling on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great day at the beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Overall this is your typical tourist beach. There are umbrella rental options and people who walk the beach selling food/drinks, souvenirs, etc...You have to cross the street from any hotel for beach access. This is the one thing I did not like. On the other hand, it was an enjoyable atmosphere with an adjacent promenade for biking and jogging. Everyone was friendly and not too pushy when trying to sell you things. I’m not sure if any hotels accommodate for food/drink service while you are on the beach, but there are a lot of independent people who will approach you to buy cold drinks and hot food. The empanadas and cheese on a stick are delicious!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Prefer this beach to Copacabana. In a more residential area. The nicest area is in Lebron on the north end. Few high-rise hotels.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach, just avoid weekends if you don't like the crowd (but it also can be an experience!). Don't take any valuable with you, ie remove ALL jewels and watch. Also perfect for a jogging on the promenade. Don't walk alone on the beach early morning or at night when it is desert. Completely ok during the day but stay where there are people... many tourists but never forget where you are!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice to see
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We came to see the beach which we found it very clean. Went during the day on the advice of locals.Well worth a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great sunset at Arpoador's rock
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Praia de Ipamena is a thriving beach located on Rio's Southern District, which has a well-known beachfront promenade and a famous scenic view over the Two-Brother's hill (morro dos Dois Irmaos) and it's favela Vidigal. On top of that, make sure not to miss the sunset at Arpoador's Rock, which is truely romantic, even if it tends to get really crowded all around at that time of the day.  Next to it is a small park where you can enjoy music and even open-air dance performing during weekend evenings. A great experience to live among Cariocas, Rio's locals.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach and beautiful people
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Large expanse of clean white sand crowded with young people have a good time. The ocean can be a bit rough but a must see in Rio.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach, not too overcrowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We spent our first morning in Rio at this lovely beach sitting under our rented umbrella and fold-up chairs, basking in the hot baking Rio sun and drinking Vodka-caipirinhas and beers, served to us by some very attentative and good-looking waiters!With Sugar loaf mountain on our right and the busier Copacabana beach to our left, we had a fun time in the sun, interspersed with heat-relieving dips in the sea, buying sun hats, bluetooth speakers, Brazilian soccer shirts and surf bracelets from the beach hawkers that constantly crawl the beaches, looking for a sale, but are not annoying at all. I reluctantly packed up my bags after 4 hours in the sun, and was pleasantly surprised at the very reasonable rate of our rented gear and drinks tab at the end!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nothing special
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Like Copacabana, Ipanema beaches have a great name (marketing) but in reality are so disappointing. Sea water has no clarity and seems dirty, beach is crowed with people the one next - and sometimes on the top- of the other, plus all these who sell from sun glasses to fish, lol. Difficult to find a nice spot for you under an umbrella. There are so many other much better beaches, Pepino, Itaipu, Grumari.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Sand, Clean Water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema beach is really pretty - the sand is soft and the water is clear. Definitely worth going because there is so much happening besides just sitting on the beach - the kids kicking soccer balls, sand volleyball and soccer ball are all interesting to watch. The negatives are: you can't leave ANYTHING in site and go to swim - it will be stolen, and there are too many vendors walking around with merchandise and food/drinks - it's non-stop yelling which gets annoying.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ripped off
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I am clearly a gringo and I ordered one pineapple caipirinha in Portuguese and the guy gave me two, second one with passion fruit. I refused to take the second one and he tried to force me to buy it till my Brazilian fiancé stepped in. Every 30seconds-1minute people walk by yelling at you to buy water, beer, food or clothes. That gets really annoying after 2 minutes and the beach is like a rubbish dump and the water had plastic in it. Too unsafe to leave your belongings on the beach and go for a swim so what’s the point?

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning but too crowded for me
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous beach but not easy to relax. Lots of people around and lots of sellers calling out. Beautiful beach with stunning views. Small bars on the walkway to get beers and coconuts.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The Sofitel has free private beds on Ipanema Beach with supervision
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema clearly is a world class beach from the perspective of setting, sunshine, sand, surf and sea, but safety remains a concern. After sunset the mood quickly changes, we were offered drink and drugs by some of the seat vending people. During the busiest part of the day pick pockets are allegedly active - for sure there are a lot of beach boys selling stuff. We henceforth enjoyed the services of the Sofitel offering free beds with some supervision and also water bottles. They are located in the hippest area between Posto 9 and 10.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pretty amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful long beach with many beach vendors. The waves can be a bit big, especially for small children, and the beach is very very very crowded (we are here in the summer). Staying at a hotel on the beach affords you a little security with the lounge chairs, umbrellas, towels and attendants all included. If you don't have that expect to pay for anything you'd like and then be very aware of what you leave on the beach while you go cavort in the water. Better to have someone always with your belongings (and don't bring anything of real value).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ipanema beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Well what can I say the place is packed with locals and tourists alike but beware don’t leave anything valuable with you if you are going swimming just bring you’re bare essentials like sun cream and swimsuits,plenty of vendors at the beach to sell you cool drinks on hand

reviewsWithKeywords.title: nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not cool as the Copacabana Beach but still very nice. Here You find more local families and somewhat less turists. services are therefor also bit more limited.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach, especially at sunset
reviewsWithKeywords.text: In my view Ipanema ia a cut above Copacobana, primrily in that it is that little bit more classy.It s well worth being at the copacabana end of the beach at sunset, where there are spectacular views if you climb up on the rocks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very popular
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My observation, way too crowded.  There is a surfing school, but they keep to the side.  So you hopefully won't get hurt.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: crowded but this added to the atmosphere
reviewsWithKeywords.text: we visited end of december when it was really crowded, but personally liked this and added to the basic Rio experience.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Service Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were located on the part of the beach that is across from the Sofitel Ipanerma. the service that the beach attendants provided was great, they had a menu for food and drinks and it was reasonable priced. We enjoyed our experience so much we went back to the same spot. Their are a lot of vendors walking around but they have great deals better than the deals on the Copacabana walkway and never take the first price you can always make a deal

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful People
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Brazilians seem to be very comfortable in their bodies and wear what is comfortable but not necessarily attractive.  Dental floss bikinis abound.  Hot sand is sprayed with water to make it bearable for walking or playing soccer volley ball -- no hands.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I heard that this beach is the most popular place to see the sunset. I went every single evening to see the espectacular show . Unique experience when the sunset happens people clap . I didn’t understand why but through the time I understood that people thanked to the sun . Beach is very clean and safe.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Must see and enjoy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is one of the top attractions in Rio.  Still along the beach and see the beautiful people from all over the world. Beware of smart young thief's.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crowded beach! The Brazilian hang outs! Everybody loves this place.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If I loved the COPACABANA, I love this beach even more... A perfect place for family to chill... The water here is much better than that of COPACABANA and the vendors here is twice as many as that of Copa. Crowded and beautiful people around...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: the next time I would stay close to this beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema beach was on of the more confortable beachs, for me was no the best one beacuse there were a lot of people but its so confortable, there are restaurants, good people, good drink, good vibe!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach near Copacabana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I'd say it's worth walking from Copacabana to Ipanema to see this place as well. it's not as busy and well known as Copacabana, but it's equally nice. It can be a better option, especially if Copacabana is crowded. it's only 15 mins walk from Copacabana

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The place to be in the Summer
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach in the world, period. Has it all, beautiful people, music, fun, liberty, great weather, fancy places, relaxed ambient. Rio is a magical place and the meeting point for New Years. Sunset is magic and you could spend all dats relaxing in that beach and meeting new people.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: SUNSET!!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice to swim but the sunset view is amazing!  Easy subway ride from Copacabana. Good restaurants in the area. Can grab a beach Pisco Sour as you watch. Hiking to The Rocks isn't necessary.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach - Sun - People
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I like Ipanema more than Copacabana, the beach is more relaxing and with less vendors, so you can enjoy the time on the beach without people walking selling everything.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Only famous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is not what you see in pictures.If you go for the beautiful women with exhuberantes body maybe you can see three or four but that is it.Anyway was an amazing day.Restaurants are very expensive and seafood expensive and hard to find being at the coast.It is incredible.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Much more better then Copacabana, beautiful view, a little bit crowded. If you want to see amazing sunset, you need to be there!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Go at Sunset
reviewsWithKeywords.text: While copacabana gets a lot of attention, in my opinion, Ipanema is a nicer beach. The water is less wavey, you have gorgeous views and the sunset is incredible. Everyone stops to watch and applauds as the sun sets.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crowded as always and too loud
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Crowded as always and too loud Someone stole my flip flopsApparently he/she needed it CKrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrClose too 100 digits now .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Tall and tan...The Girl from Ipanema
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The girls from Ipanema was my father’s favorite song and this beach gave me the flavor that the song portrays. It is beautiful - more upscale than Copacabana and probably a little safer. More residents and less tourists. But not as pretty as Copacabana.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Copacabana’s little sister
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Smaller, calmer and less crowded than Copacabana. The water is usually cleaner because further away from downtown.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Busy but better than Copacabana. We visited in the busy season after new years and Rio was packed. It's nice in the morning before 10am but then gets really crowded. Fun to people watch though. Lots of interesting characters. Beware your jewelry on the streets surrounding, I got my necklace yanked off me by a passer-by on a bike. I don't really have any other beaches besides Aus to compare it too (Aus beaches are amazing btw) but ensure u sit on something as the sand is littered with little bits of rubbish.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very busy but buzzing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is buzzing all the time, it's a gorgeous beach to walk along and enjoy a coconut at one of the beach side vendors.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach lives up to its name, it has real nice sand lovely sea however be careful the sea can be rough. The venders that provide chairs are very helpful however the chairs could do with updating as they seem old. There are a million sales people in the beach selling everything. However we couldn’t find any food to eat that we liked nerby.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice area
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The next beach besides copacabana on walking distance. The 2 beaches have a different presenting style.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach was beautiful with a park nearby. Awesome views and surfing available.  More locals here than Copacabana Beach. I recommend a day out of your vacation or business trip for a quick visit to Ipanema Beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sunset on the rocks at Ipanema
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Preferred this beach to Copacabana. Watching the sunset from the rocks that separates Ipanema and Copacabana is a must part of the trip. Felt safe on both beaches and as long as you stay in the first part of the strips do not worry about some of the things that put others off coming, very polite helpful people everywhere

reviewsWithKeywords.title: My Happy Place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a very busy stretch of beach beside Copacabana. It’s divided into lifeguard station sections. Posto 9 is my favorite. Very eclectic and diverse. Water is quick and rough at times, but lots of fun. Basically choose the barraca you wish to serve you and they’ll place a chair and umbrella in the spot you need and bring you food and beer as you watch the parade of fit bodies stroll past. Lots of extra vendors coming by too but not pushy, some are quite entertaining. Intense sun. I wish bathrooms were more readily accessible, they appear to only be at the lifeguard station itself. Ipanema doesn’t have as many hotels lining the beach as Copacabana dies but it’s just as nice if not better.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ipanema Beach Review
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Miles and miles of beautiful sandy beach.  Well marked lifeguard stations (numbered for easy locations).   Tons of vendors for food and drink near the sidewalks.  Amazing sand sculptures also near the sidewalks. A must to visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach in Rio
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beautiful colored umbrellas that provide needed shade also make up perhaps the most exclusive beach in the area.  Surrounding residential areas are relatively quiet but the beach is hopping!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love this beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema beach is the place to be during the day in Rio. It's a fab place to spend the day. So many different foods and drinks on offer and I even bought a decent bikini. The waves can get quite intense during tides, if you're into surfing then it's a bonus!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Another great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach but as others very crowded. Epanema beach is only an easy walk to the best haviannas shop that has the best range.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely stretch of beach more up-market than Copacabana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This being said, travellers need to be aware of the various "posts" starting at copacabana and stretching to the end of ipanaema as post 8 slap bang in the middle is that favoured by the favella locals and as such is very busy and prone to scams. Passers by are besieged to rent chairs, sit on the beach etc. I would head to post 9 and rent a chair if possible. The beach is narrower than copacabana and there are fewer kiosks here where you can buy eats and drinks. For us, we stayed in a copacabana hotel and stayed by the hotel pool for the sun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach but full to the brim with hawkers
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I love this beach. The sand is white, the sea azure blue, the waves amazing but it is full of hawkers selling everything and they are very loud. At times there were as many as 10 around me all shouting their sales. so, I don't wish to put you off coming here because it is lovely but bring a good set of noise cancelling headphones with you.Many of the hotels have areas on the beach with chairs and sunshades for their guests so check with your reception before paying for these things.Ipanema beach is less touristy than Copacabana, more for the local residents but both beaches get very busy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great place to take a stroll and for people watching
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice sandy beach... great for taking a stroll and people watching.  Of course there are the beautiful people but more interesting were the athletes of various ages, shapes and sizes... some playing soccer (on disrupted sand), beach volleyball, and more impressively the new foot volleyball (where players do not use their hands but skillfully use their heads, chest, shoulders, legs, and feet.  Even saw one player make a bicycle kick at the net.Truly amazing!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cracking beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice, wide, long strip of light sand. great, powerful waves (a bit too dangerous as I nearly drowned having gone in when I shouldn't have - my fault) beautiful surroundings and a great place to laze around. Loved it!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crowded and dangerous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just like Copacabana, crowded and dangerous, military police everywhere, Scary, best sunset, go when it gets dark.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: More crowded than Copa
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema has a completely different vibe than Copa Cabana. It was much more crowded on a sunny day, and felt less touristy and much more local-which is nice. It was a sea of different colored umbrellas today.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love Ipanema
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's our favorite beach, less touristic than Copacabana. Love Posto 9, onwards. In the morning or late afternoon, watching volley ball and "fute volley". Ice cold beers and caipirinhas. On Sunday Avenida Atlantica closes down for traffic. Joggers, skateboarding, strollers,bicicles etc. Fabulous energy and entertainment.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Far from the madding crowd
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We found Ipanema beach to be much less crowded than neighbouring Copacabana beach. Plus the beach & sea level was much more even.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Girl from Impanema
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Walked through Impanema beach on the way back from Copacabana beach.  Found the restaurant/ bar where the song Irl from Impanema was written.  Stopped in fir a drink Beach is quite busy. Water was fairly calm today.  Lots of people swimming Definitely worth the trip to see

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just another busy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Having walked Copacabana beach, Ipanema was much the same, except for the absence of beach front bars and restaurants, except at the far end, where a couple of small units sold beers and some food items, more ‘snack shacks’. Within the confines of the beach itself, nestled in the sand, were numerous cabins selling things, including I assume refreshments and the like. Since you have to walk across the sand to reach them they are really only useful for the beach goers. Even on the opposite side of the road there appeared to be a complete absence of road side restaurants. As with Copacabana beach, lots of sun worshipers, some hiding under a sea of parasols.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach in the city of Rio
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice water and sand with lots of tents to buy cold drinks. Umbrellas and chairs are available for all, but be aware that if you are not local they may charge you a lot more. Always negotiate with the owners. Also be attentive with thieves, they are everywhere in the city... a shame!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach, wonderful local sights, one of the reasons for going to Rio
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Firstly, over 60's can use the facilities at the various Points for free with photo id. Becomes more important as I get older! Fabulous sandy beach in its own right, felt that Ipanema was a little more up market than Copacabana.
