Amazing beach cocktail bars that offer wicked caipirinhas at very reasonable rates (5 reals) whilst offering free wi fi and the ability to pay by card, very good beach side cafes offering incredible steak meals at cheap prices, and a popular surfing area. However, the best part for us was to just promenade from one end of the beach to the other, watching a very colorful beach life. Loved it.Personally, I would book any break to include a weekend in Rio when the beaches just come alive. The beach is a lot quieter mid-week. We also felt very safe here, There was a strong police presence during the weekend but we did not feel hassled or threatened during the day. Would not be so confident at night.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent place to visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema beach is the right place to find the locals and enjoy one of the best part of Rio. Relaxing and taking a caipirinha on this beach is something you must do in Rio.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Surfing potential is evident, Lovely waves and great people watching. Just plainly a beautiful location. Lots of activity .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Look this Nice and Beautiful place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema is the land of Vinicius de Moraes and Tom Jobim. Ipanema Beach is a most beautiful place to go to see the sunset. The water of the sea is good, the temperature is good, the sand is very soft and the people are nice. Everything is good. If you want to relax it is the appropriate place to go. As in many parts of the world you have to pay attention and do not wear jewelry.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Natural beauty not well kept
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is situated in the richest neighborhood in Rj, one of the most expensive in the country. However, in spite of its natural beauty, it has been neglected by the public administration and its not safe nor clean enough. Beware with pickpockets, especially in weekends. Many times polluted waters and dirty sand. A shame! Rio de Janeiro deserved a better destiny!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A must visit when in Rio
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A lovely beach with white sands and lots going on. You can have surfing lessons or just watch the world go by. Whilst there are no beds to hire, the common theme is beach chairs and umbrellas. The sea as you would expect is cold to begin with and some big waves so if your not a strong swimmer keep a look out for the flags to see if it is safe to swim. Lots of hawkers seeing their wears, but they are not forceful in any sense - lovely local people wanting to make some money.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Famous Beach worth visiting!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We typically stay in a high rise hotel in Leblon overlooking Ipanema.  Ipanema is an expensive area but very popular with its beach, restaurants, hotels, bars, etc.  It’s more laid back than the very active Copacabana Beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach walk
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A clean, long, white sand beach.  Especially enjoyed watching the surf school.  There are areas where they sell you beach chairs, wifi, water, drinks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Each beach in Rio has it's own style. Ipanema is crowded but enjoyable
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Looking for a crowded beach but kind of more upscale than Copacabana, it's the way. Posto 8 to 9 is the gay spot. Posto 9 is mixed and you can watch volley ball games on some evenings ; best spot for Sunset is just opposing the Sofitel building. If you want the more quiet location, upscale, go to Leblon

reviewsWithKeywords.title: vey nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach to relax. A few stalls all along the promenade with tables outside to enjoy a snack or drink.  We had a whole coconut each and just relaxed and enjoyed watching everybody just doing what they were doing playing sport swimming or just relaxing. Similar to Copacabana beach lots of condominiums along the promenade. We did explore the town area down one of the side streets and found a lovely little market selling all sorts of things. Also found a café and had breakfast there which we enjoyed. A lot of people walk from Copacabana but we just took a taxi both ways cost around 25 Reals.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A eeekend must
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The amount of people on the beach is amazing and it’s got a fantastic vibe going on. Also on a Sunday there is a hippy market in the square by the subway station.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just as pictured
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I walked the length of Ipanema Beach, just to say I did it!  The site was beautiful, the experience excellent.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful clean beach and crystal clear sea, although lots of high waves with a very strong current. The beach is dog friendly and so if you are a dog lover lots of dogs to watch enjoying the sea. You will he constantly bothered by people trying to sell you rubbish but if you ignore them they just walk on by.You can hire two chairs and umbrellas for R$20 not the most comfortable but the umbrella was a must as was sooo hot. The man also sold water, coconuts and such like.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The Rio you want to see
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The Ipanema Beach is one of the two famous beaches of Rio de Janeiro, the other being Copacabana.Unlike its more crowded neighbour Copacabana, Ipanema feels less crowded and looks cleaner. There are less sellers on the street and they sell handcrafted goods instead of cheap souvenirs. The place feels pricey and rightfully so, since most of the luxury hotels of Rio are located on this beach. It has more policeman walking around it than in Copacabana and you can look over the whole beach from the Pedra do Arpoador.In short, this is a highly suggested spot for visiting and to spend some lazy hours under the scorching sun or learning how to surf.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and famous people
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Enjoy the sun the sea and the waves of one of the most beautiful beaches of Rio de Janeiro. Go at ease, wear Hawaiian sandals and step on the sands of Ipanema beach and enjoy the sun with beautiful and famous people. Do not forget to take an ice cream mate and eat Globo cookies so typical of Cariocas.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing hotel, staff and location
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This Hotel and staff are awesome. The staff went the extra mile to make our trip very special indeed. The secretly arranged a romantic boat trip for 2, great tickets for the football at the Maracana and some very useful help and advice of getting around Rio. Hotel was clean and room was huge.Breakfast was very nice with lots to eat.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the two classic beaches in Rio (also Copacabana).  This one is a bit cleaner and seemed to be a friendlier vibe.  Immediately adjacent to LeBlon's Beach to the West. There are shops and places to eat across the road from the sand, but a bit pricey.  We looked everywhere, but never found "the girl from Ipanema".

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in the south zone
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach in the south zone, but can get very crowded on weekends and vacations. Better arrive early in these days (before 9am ou in the afternoon, after 3pm)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Surprisingly dirty
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We walked along the beach and there was a lot of trash.  This was surprising since I read that this was the most expensive beach.  Copacabana was much cleaner.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach - rammed when sunny
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Of the two big beaches I prefer Ipanema. Be sure to bring a towel and a cooler full of beer and chill away the day. In the streets behind there are a few great, but pricey, restaurants and boutiques.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Timeless Beach Culture
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was told that Ipanema Beach is safer than Copacabana Beach... and I was fortunate enough to live across the street at the Sofitel Ipanema.   I went on the beach both Sat and Sun.  The vibes were just wonderful.  People were very friendly, especially on Sunday.  I was able to walk around and took pictures and participated in the beach culture.   I found the water colder than the pacific but it was bearable.  The waves were much bigger than expected so I was very careful as to not go too deep...watched out for those undertows.  The water was really clean and the atmosphere was just timeless.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very awesome!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazingly beautiful beach and a must see if your in Rio!  Love the wall with all the graffiti on it.  Lots of open space to lay out on the sand.  Lots of food and drink vendors walking the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in Rio - don't visit during the night
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's an amazing beach - located between Copacabana and Leblon. Very safe during the day. It doesn't have as many beach shacks or live music joints as Copacabana - it's a place you come to for relaxationIdeally, don't visit after 7:30 PM as everything shuts down by then and the place is completely deserted

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Rio Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: White sandy beach with beautiful bodies makes for great people watching, however, other than eye candy on the surface, the beach is NOT CLEAN.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What a Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the truly must see sights in Rio. Beach was really crowded and was really being utilized by the locals.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ipanema Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema Beach is a very beautiful, and, quite large in size, 3.5 km. of pure white sand.  It is a very active beach with many activities going on, like volleyball, vendors selling souvenirs, it appears to be a much younger crowd, more locals than tourists, and,  more crowded than Copacabana Beach.   Go and spend a day a day at Ipanema Beach and feel the vibe!  It will not disappoint you!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ipanema & Leblon best city beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: While most tourists stay in hotels in and therefore go to Copacabana / Leme beach, locals prefer the beach of Ipanema / Leblon. In reality one 3.5km stretch of beach, with the canal of Jardim de Allah dividing Ipanema from Leblon. Arpoador is surfer oriented and has the best sunset view. Beach references are the Postos,  lifeguard stations at each km. Posto 9 in Ipanema and Leblon’s 11 and 12 are most popular, with Ipanema more ‘seen and be seen’, and between Postos 8 and 9 is mostly gay popular. Leblon is more laid back and families. All four Ipanema and Leblon metro stations are 2 blocks walking distance from the beach. Advice from a 9-year resident.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: LOVELY BEACH. NOT AS LIVELY AS COPACABANA BEACH
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I took a walk from Copacabana Beach to this one and this beach is not as big or as lively as copacabana.   Its a lovely stretch of soft sand and if you like a bit more peace and quiet this would be for you. Has a few kiosks along the way, toilets and the vendors trying to sell their souvenirs. Felt safe if you follow a few basic rules.   Glad to of seen and a lovely walk there. Got a metered taxi back to Copacabana, cost 15rs (£3).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful sand with lively waves
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We swam in both Ipanema and Copacabana and there is nothing much to choose between them. Apart from a headland called Aproador they would really just be one long beach. Aproador is a lovely place to sit and watch the sun set though. The sand on Ipanema beach is beautiful. We found the place not very crowded although we were a little early in the season. Promenade is very pleasant as well. Waves seem to be a feature so swimming might not suit people with a cautious nature. Kiosks along the promenade have drinks at reasonable prices. It is a beautiful place to sit and watch the waves, while the city is just across the road. And of course you are looking out at the vista of a beautiful bay and the Sugar Loaf.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach - Easy walk from Copacabana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Walked from Copacabana to Ipanema - an easy walk. Ipanema Beach is less crowded than Copacabana, less beach sellers. Beautiful white sand, and wide boardwalk. Worth a stroll or even a swim!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Waves breaking in from the Atlantic
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Impressive but don't swim! Nice relatively quiet beach after Copacobana. Good to walk but head inland for bars and restaurants.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best city beach in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just love to be here. Walking distance from many hotels, beautiful people, sports and whatever you need. My number 1 place in the world.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Girl of Ipanema
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It seems the girl of Ipanema still exist, nowadays as a beautiful grandma. However her daughters are stil running wild and charming,  enjoying sun and blue water, for your enjoyment, admiration and strolling and relaxing on the white sands of this marvellous beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Really nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a great setting.  Bluewater, large waves, clean sand and lots of beachgoers.  I never once felt uncomfortable [i.e. rumors of pickpockets, theft, etc]

reviewsWithKeywords.title: No Rio without Ipanema
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema is one of the best large beaches in Rio. Despite it is narrower that other beaches, it is nice, clean and safe. I would advise to enjoy Ipanema during week days as weekends can get really populated. It is also very nice for jogging on its tidy running course.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Must visit on a visit to Rio
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema beach is probably less crowded than Copacabana beach but is definitely worth a visit.We went on a Friday which was also a national holiday and three of the five traffic lanes in addition to the beach, pavement and cycle track  were opened up to joggers, walkers and cyclists.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Most interesting Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning! From the fresh coconut drinks to Mojitos on the Beach made by a traveling guy! We teased my daughter that we will come back and wear the dental floss bathing suit bottoms!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relax and enjoy the sand and sun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: With a world renowned reputation, Ipanema beach has a lot to live up to and it does. Beautiful soft fine sand and crashing surf mix with the cries of food and drinks sellers as you enjoy the sunshine. The beach gets busy with locals which adds to the atmosphere. A good tip is to stay at one of the beach front hotels and use their designated chairs and umbrellas for free. We were able to walk out of the hotel on to the beach and relax in a sun lounger without any issues. When on the beach do not miss some of the great, simple food (sweetcorn fresh off the cob and cheese grilled on portable barbecues were our favourites) and, of course, relax with a well made caipirinha.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: NICE
reviewsWithKeywords.text: nice beach, glad we stayed in Ipanema - beach is very close, it’s huge and so are the waves! Good shops nearby for clothing and also a lot of good places to eat near by

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Unbelievably clean given the number of people there.Officias certainly know the value of a clean beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Loved my Visit to Ipanema Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The boardwalk was great - the beach lovely although the ocean was quite rough so beware if you're travelling with children. Perfect for surfing, though!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We spent almost two weeks on Copacabana but the weather was mostly rainy. On the one nice day we had we took a cab to ipanema. The beach had beautiful people, just like Frank Sinatra said. We noticed hotels were more expensive here and probably meant the people had expensive taste. Definitely got that vibe. Gorgeous water and a bit nicer than copa.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Over hyped
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Yes, this is a nice sandy beach. Thats about it. The seas not blue, there are waves, potential security issues from thieves and it abutts a noisy road,. Why bother?i

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean, beautiful beach with waves to play in and felt very safe!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our family stayed at a hotel on Copacaba beach, but as beach lovers, we could not pass up the opportunity to see the much talked about Ipanema.  Glad we did!We walked to the right along Copacabana beach from our hotel to Ipanema beach.  Although the waves weren’t super big, there were about 12 surfers waiting to catch a wave.  The beach itself is very clean, the sand is soft and the water is BEAUTIFUL!  Even though the day was cloudy and only mid 70’s, the water was warm.  We all enjoyed playing in the surf before heading back to Copacabana.  Glad we made it a “must do” on our Rio bucket list.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the Copacabana Hotel but wanted to experience both the Copacabana AND Ipanema Beaches.  They're both similar in that they are both beautiful with sand as fine as sugar.  Ipanema felt much safer and we really enjoyed watching all the volleyball games.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The other beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: After Copacabana you arrive on the otherside to Ipanema which is equally as stunning and far less busy

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Worth the hype
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous, beautiful and nicer than Copacobana.  When we went it was quieter and more enjoyable than Copa.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach with plenty of service for chairs, umbrellas and drinks.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I saw the girl from Ipanema Beach, but she didn't see me and kept walking. We got a couple of beach chairs and an umbrella and the guy brought us drinks. The water is a bit cold so go all in and you will be fine.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A Crowded Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What makes this Beach are the steep hill around it providing a picturesque backdrop. Lots of people crowded onto the beach making the most of it. Certainly have to go and see this. Walk out onto the headland and look back at the beach. Drink a cold coconut n the promenade and just watch the beach in action.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Chilled Out Kinda Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A very relaxed and chilled out beach to walk during the day and night.  Full of great seafood cafes and restaurants.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Kangaroo Chris
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Must Do! Go to Grotto de Ipanema Beach Great People BEST. The Beach one of the Best Around. Restaurants great assortments and quality food.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The girls of Ipanema are still there ...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The famous song made "Ipanema Beach" known all over the world! And it surely deserves all that fame! A beautiful beach at the  trendy quarter of Ipanema! This is certainly the "place" to be while  in Rio de Janeiro. The beach is fantastic, what doesn't mean it has no problem. Of course, it does. The water and sand are not very clean. The water temperature is generally pretty much on the cold side. Beware of your belongings - cameras, cell phones and backpacks - at all times and avoid the surf area after dark - principally if you are alone. Overcrowded on sunny weekends, many vendors trying to catch your attention ... Just like anywhere else. But it is unmissable! You will certainly fall in love with Ipanema! Enjoy!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: THe Girl of Ipanema
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I live here, in Ipanema.It is the most beautiful neighbourhood in Rio. It is just caomparable to the adjacent Leblon area. But, it remains more quiet and cozy.The beach itself was better to bathe in the past. Somedays, it gets really polluted. Others, it is very clena and transparent. It depends on the currents and if it has rained recently. After a rainy day, become s a mess. Its waters are a bit cold. And the waves and currents are very dangereous. Do not go far from the beach. The sand is white (nos a Caribbean white, though), and it is cleaned in the mornings. But, after a few hours and depending on the crowd (very uneducated), it can get really dirty. The girls though are gorgeous! Sexy and almost naked. Brazilian bikinis are made to show, not to hide. In fact, you have two sightseeings: the hill& the sea + the girls of Ipanema. Never bring your expensive watch, i-phone, jewelry or excessive belongings to the beach. Specially, during weekends. Tha chance to get robbed is very high. Rio today is literally surrounded by favelas (slums). The largest part of their population is just poor. But, drugdealers have made them their fortresses. And they originate therefore, a lot of violence. Ipanema is, by far, the best place to satay in Rio. Its sidewalks are great to do a bit of exercise, in the mornings. On Sundays, on the street lanes is closed to cars.And families, kids, dogs, bikes, street artists and small vendors are evrywhere. It is like Miami Beach or Santa Monica (LA). The best hotels are the Ceasar Park (****) and the Fasano (*****). The last one is expensive as a fancy resort. It is a beuatiful hotel. But it is not a resort. Nearby, you have the Sheraton. Its location though, at the Nyemaier Highway, after Leblon Beach, is a bit off to get by walking. It is old, but very complete. If you come to Rio, Ipanema Beach is THE place to stay. No doubt. Boa viagem!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: great beach in the upscale neightboorhood
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach, looking to the see, try to go to the right or to the extreme left (Arpoador, close to the rocks), the beach is better in this points.  Very easy to get out of the beach and eat in one of the restaurants close to it, if you prefer the sofisticated ones, go to the Anibal de Mendonça or Garcia Davila streets.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not sure I understand the hype about this beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Maybe having been to a few other beaches around Rio I was a bit underwhelmed by Ipanema Beach.  It was crowded, less places to have drink or something to eat than say Copacobana but still the same amount of people trying to sell you something.  I am sure this beach will be “liked” by many many people but there are better beaches within easy reach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Less crowded than Copacabana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Enjoyed a crowd free swim and sun lounge. Surfers, sun lovers & hawkers. Felt safe with Police and security present.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sort of boring off season
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our hotel was right on the beach and while the beds were comfy, I don't think it's worth paying the extra in the off season.  The beach is just like all beaches.  The life is really over at Copacabana and Ipanema was just quiet and not too many people.  the weather was not great so maybe I'd have a better opinion in nice weather!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Second best beach in town (or maybe third)
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Let's be clear: if you have time for one beach only in Rio, then that should be Copacabana, not Ipanema. Said that, then there is nothing wrong in spending a few hours in Ipanema too, especially in the weekend, when the beach is full of lively people and the beach kiosks are in a great mood. Get a chair, enjoy a caipirinha or a beer, a great sandwich at the Uruguay kiosk and do some high quality people watching. Is a smaller beach than Copacabana, similarily smooth and clean, but what makes the experience worse than the more famous neighbor is the promenade, much less large and majestic, and the other side of the road, which has a narrow pavement and is lined by anonymous condos for rich people protected by ugly high fences and armed guards. Not cool. Just stay on the beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: "The place" to be.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you are heterosexual or homosexual, this beach caters to everyone. Beach life is the way of life for many Cariocas as well as visitors. For your comfort small restaurants and kiosks are serving drinks and small / fast food and dealers are offering sunblockers, sunscreens, sunglasses and what else one needs for a comfortable and lazy day at the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Winter   Sun! This  is the weather in the winter in Rio.  Nice for a coconut water and a stroll  on the sidewalk.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Today was hot and the sun is still shining at 5pm so you could stay at the beach enjoying a relaxing day, play volleyball, go for a walk on the sidewalk, have a swim in the green pristine water... amazing weather

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema beach is walking distance from Copacabana beach.  It is a clean beach, but gets busy over weekends.  Chair and ambrella rentals available at reasonable prices.  Food and drink vendors.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great cycle ride
reviewsWithKeywords.text: As a beach prefer to Copacabana - more intimate, and much better bars and bistros near by. Some genuine great massage services on the beach - total relaxation and then dive back in the sea

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing experience
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous sand and surf waves make this a beach totally living up to the fame it deserves. Felt so delighted to sit and soak up the atmosphere, all the traders (no hassle though) and watch the world go by.  Hired chairs and umbrella, drank caipirinhas and paddled in the surf. What an amazing place.  Couldn’t read as the place was so fabulously busy I was entertained all day long.  Beach beautiful bodies, football, volleyball and a wonderful chicken sandwich from Uruguay (near Posto number 9). I would love to come back one day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wow!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach!  I loved Copacabana Beach but I preferred Ipanema!  It's definitely worth spending some time there, and walking between the two beaches.  It's a beautiful scenic walk!  There are rocks which you can climb on Ipanema and which offer amazing views of the beach.  Don't miss them!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: As Copacabana, an Icon of the Planet !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just continue walking out of Copacabana, you'll do a bend and the beach is going to change name in Ipanema.Just beautiful as Copacabana, let me say, choose the beach depending on where are you closer.But if you wanna enjoy both, why not ??

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Walk to your Heart's Desire
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It seems like this beach never ends.  We walked from Copacabana Beach to Ipanema Beach.  Then we walked along Ipanema beach.  It was beautiful! Lot's of "futbol" players in the sand playing a form of volleyball that somehow included soccer.  It seemed to work for  them!I want to go back....

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesomely beautiful & trendy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I’ve been to Brazil over 40 times and to Rio about 20 times. On my free beach time in Rio, I divide my time between Ipanema Beach and Copacabana Beach. For daytime relaxing by the beach, I prefer Ipanema. I find that it is more relaxing here and that the sand and water are cleaner. I prefer the section of Ipanema Beach which is between  Lifeguard Posts number 8 and 9, which are near the end of Ipanema which is closest to Copacabana Beach. I generally get a spot to relax which is away from those playing beach-volleyball and other games. From the standpoint of “The Girl(s) from Ipanema,” the ladies at both are equally beautiful. I like and respect the great degree of equality I see in Brazil’s large multiracial society. I’ve often worked in our Sao Paulo and Rio offices, I I loved seeing the respect shown between people of different racial heritage. Brazil has a high degree of racial democracy, and one of the best in the world. You’ll get some insight into it by looking at how the Brazilians interact on Ipanema Beach. Get out early in the morning to claim your spot on the beach. The good spots disappear quickly. Don’t take any valuables with you. Although there are very visual police and military presence, thieves thrive on the beaches. Often, I’ll stay at a hotel across from the spot on the beach, where I wish to chill-out Ipanema is considered to be a more hip and trendy beach than the beaches on its two sides, being Copacabana Beach and Leblon Beach. Although Ipanema has many nice cafes and restaurants, for evening dining, I prefer the restaurants in the Copacabana Beach area. My attached photos of Ipanema were taken while we were hang gliding over Ipanema Beach. This was an awesome experience.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A most wonderful beach but be warned the sea in Rio is cold. What's more they don't sell Agua de coco when the temperature is less than 25 degrees

reviewsWithKeywords.title: nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: nice  beach for people who enjoy playing all kind of sports that involve a  ball, with nice bars around it. The send and the beach in general is better than Copacabana.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Well worth a visit.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Didn’t go during the best weather but there were plenty of surfers riding the waves and plenty of places to stop for refreshments and shelter.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best of Rio
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema was probably the best area to walk around, and best for restaurants and the beach. Could get crowded on weekends but we were off season and loved it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach front lined with good hotels and apartments. Few big  rocks in the sea further beautify the sea line. Lots of clouds all the time. Lot many tourists and locals flock the beach. Outdoor Gyms and outdoor games on the beach. Specific mosaic pattern on the sea side is very specific. On Sundays the beach road is closed for normal trafic and is only open for cyclists skaters and people running and walking creating a feastival like activity on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: All of Rio's beaches are just beautiful and so clean!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The nicest beaches I have ever been to. The water is clear, even though it's quite big waves. The sand is beautiful and not hot under your feet. The beaches are so clean and just wonderful for all ages. The only thing I would say is to watch your bags, as mine did get stolen. There is a lot of people walking around selling things which can be annoying as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had enjoyed our stay in hotel nearby this amazing beach. We relaxed on the beach every day. Nice beach and lovely ocean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous but expensive
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema Beach is the best place in Rio for watching beautiful bodies walk, run, cycle, and rollerblade along the path.  The beach features surfing at one end, volleyball and football in the middle, and kiteboarding at the Leblon end.  The prices at Copacabana Beach are much better, though (ie. price of cachaça, etc.).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I love this whole area. It’s great to sit back and relax. Lots of little bars who do food and drinks. Very cheap as well . Can’t wait to go back.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Como a garota
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just as beautiful as we hoped, with great views, vibe and folks.  Easy to get a drink and soak up the sun but also good waves to ride.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great place to hang out if you live in Rio
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is pretty crowded and there is a lot of action. It's mainly residential along the beach with a few restaurants and not many hotels. There are bars along the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Oh beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at Ipanema Beach at Mangotree Hostel - the beach spirit was unbeatable. The sunset was gorgeous

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful..simple as that
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A great place to walk and enjoy all the activities going on in the beach area.The surfers at the Copacabana end of the beach are worth seeing.Also great photos from the rocks at this end of the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I enjoyed my time at Ipanema beach. I actually think it is much much better than Copacabana. It seemed way safer and nicer. The water looks better here and i did not feel in danger , no one stoled anything from me and you can rent chairs and umbrellas. The merchants sell you food and drinks that vary but do not miss on the Coco! ;)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach but busy so watch your bags!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were a family group of seven and visited Ipanema Beach once during a two week holiday in Rio.  All Rio’s beaches are beautiful so your favourite will be down to personal choice - we found Ipanema busy and therefore, very busy with hawkers selling a variety of goods (and possibly looking for unguarded possessions).  We had heard all the warnings and kept our beach bags close at hand but still had a bag stolen - be warned, either use your bag as a pillow or keep it right underneath your subbed! Also, the waves & tide in Rio are powerful so I highly recommend swimming near the lifeguard stations that are located at regular intervals along the beach - we watched the lifeguard assist a swimmer about every 10 minutes!!  So be careful but don’t be put off - definitely worth a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good for families
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema has a family feel top it.  The beach is clean and long with plenty of room, except maybe during Carnival.  Enjoy the surf and sun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Miles of sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Anyone visiting Rio needs look no further. Miles of beautiful beach. Though the waves can be very rough the water is refreshing and the caipirinhas are everywhere. Loved it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Safe and clean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It doesnt have as good view as Copacabana but it's cleaner and safer.Many guys offer there service, you can ask for chairs, umbrellas, drinks, foods. It's little crowde even in the morning, so better to come early.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy but beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely warm sand beach - busy but not ludicrously so, was easy to find space to lie down.Lots of people selling food, drinks, towels and bikinis, but they don’t hassle you too much

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Our favourite beach in Rio
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I thought Ipanema beach was actually nicer than Copacabana. The landscape of the mountains in the distance is very dramatic, the sand is beautiful and there are good waves on the beach. We really enjoyed our time here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Intense experience,  beaches close by better
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I did not know what Ipanema beach is until I visited. During my stay in Brazil I lived by General Osorio just a short walkie to Ipanema. So I used the Bech frequently and spent many sunny hours there. All days are not suitable for swimming, the currents are too strong and this makes also sunbathing almost impossible, you want a dip every now and then, the sun factor being 6+ like Australia. I used 50-60 spf and an umbrella and yet I turned dark brown. And the heat is immense.Now there are so many people you cannot be cooled down by the sea breeze,the most calm times of the day are early mornings after the sand have been shifted, and in the time before sunset. By the way the sunset is magnificent! The beach is crowded, everything have to be paid for, umbrellas, chairs and even space. There are many charming vendors providing you all kinds of services from coconut water to sex. Everything is for sale here. Prices are low and not relevant to discuss, I spent on. Hair and umbrella every day, drank beers, water and coconut waters constantly for no money at all.The bad thing is the loud vendors shouting all times, there were moments I wished for a shotgun, I could not bare hearing all this “ saaanwiches” and stuff, eight hours a day, non stop. People pee on the water. People peel on the beach, and the stench can be evocative. But this is the fine Ipanema still, Copacabana is worse with frothy yellow urine waves. I lived three months in Brazil. My tip to everybody is: walk in the sun, walk towards Leblon beach where the delta wing flyers land. Clean, pristine calmness, no people, no fuss, just Chrystal waters, waves and wind, some occasional passers- by, some bottlers, but why gather on the hysterically overcrowded Ipanema when you have all this at hand.Remember many people are afraid to go somewhere else, and also it seems important to make a statement by being at Ipanema. Coast guard and security holds their eye on the beach and surrounding area, which makes this area secure for tourists.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Smaller but busier than Copacabana beach. Many restaurants and shops nearby. More beach activities in the evening. Go in the evening to watch the sunset.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Classy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: More classy but less to do than copacabana. Less stalls and bars. Breathtaking views. A cool place to spend a half day chilling

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spectacular experience!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Everything is simply Magnifique from traditions to food,nature and amazing people.We really e njoyed all.We will be back❤

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Our daily spot
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our daily spot in Rio. We were located near Copacabana, but we immediately felt in love with the Ipanema atmosphere. Close to the Garota (the big rock on the left of the beach) you will not be disturb by the cars and the noisy street activity, not like in Copacabana, who is a beautiful beach with a nice view, but too too close of the trafic in the street !

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed in Copacabana for a few days and walked to this beach pretty much every day. Safe but you still need to look after your things, great view of the mountains and you can have a lot of capirinhas !

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful place with cute shops, cafes and restaurants
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema is your 'high street' - a little glamorous, a little upscale. Except unlike those elsewhere, this high street isn't extravagantly expensive. Brazil in general is pretty cheap. Ipanema has great shops, such as Melissa (for shoes), as well as interesting food markets. There are great gyms, hotels, cafes, acai shops and more. Plus, you're right by the beach! Make sure you check out the hippie market during the weekends too

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went to Ipanema Beach when we in port in April - it was a beautiful beach and lots of restaurants etc. nearby.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ipanema delight
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach family oriented in some parts, warm  clear waters, no waves, you can swing, rent some kayaks, water motos etc.,

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice surf
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach was beautiful and there were a lot of sand volleyball games going on.  The surf was nice and the sand was very white.  The atmosphere was very festive and fun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Chic but not pretentious
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice bars, reataurants, shops and above all beautiful people and beach. Of course you should always be alert.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean Beach..
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is adjacent to Copacabana beach but less crowded .It's clean and nice to visit .you can find a surfing school and try if you love surfing .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean and fun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fun to walk along.  Lined with volleyball nets with people playing variations on the game.  Lined with small food/beverahe stands.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I visited on a bad day, but its lovely. GNice stretch of sand with vendors selling snacks and drinks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: View of Twin brothers mountain
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Located south of Copacabana beach . It is shorter and narrower . The sand is not as white as the Copacabana . Many people watch the sun set with the View of Twin brothers mountain . The wave is stronger than Copacabana There is a song written namely A Girl from Ipanema and made famous by Frank Sinatra .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good place to visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Its a good place to visit..if you have felt copagabana beach..then you can go ipanema beach,not far from copagabana ..walking distance,if you being there don’t forget to Cruze over arpoador a small hill..in the end of ipanema beach..for sight seeing and lot’s of photography..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning view from the bike path
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Came round the corner from the tranquility of Copacabana to find the waves beating up the beach at Ipanema - spectacular with the scenery behind.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The girls and boys of Ipanema
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with usually higher surf than Copacabana, but not as wide. Gorgeous beach bodies abound. Dress (less) to impress. Go during the week when it is not as crowded as on the weekends.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cool but not safe
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach. Actually liked it more than Copacabana. You can surf there, eat and drinkk cocktails. Two things that annoy a lot: 1. Never ending people who are offering you chinese sun glasses and everything that you can and cannot imagine🙈2. Huge problem with safety. You can’t relax completely because at the moment you will turn your head-someone will still your bag. But in general very cool place with a lot of positive people. I bought amazing swimming suit there as well👏🏻

reviewsWithKeywords.title: THE beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: When you are visiting Rio one of the synonymous words that come to your mind is Ipanema Beach. Come and visit and take some time in the afternoon when sun goes down .. breathtaking view

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Loved it!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema Beach is a place I will miss! We went early morning and relaxed before most of the vendors were out. It was quiet and relaxing and perfect beach time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A lovely Rio beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We walked from our hotel around here it was a good 30-40 minute but nice walk totally safe during the dayWe found this beautiful beach equally as good and not so busy with lots of cool shops & eateries cheaper then capacabana area Well worth a visit

reviewsWithKeywords.title: so much better than copacabana beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach was WAY cleaner, WAY safer and WAY less crowded than CopaCabana beach.  And we were staying at the Copa and still felt crowded and stared at on the beaches.  We felt much safer walking aorund this beach and seemed to be less shifty people about.  The trash level was less, although Brazilian beaches are some of the dirtiest I've seen in the world.  This one was better than many.  Still, lots of tiny crap in the sand, which they clean frequently so it scares you how much would be there if they weren't cleaning.  Anyway, if you are hitting beaches, don't miss this one.  It was my favorite in Rio.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A fantastic place!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It really speaks for itself, the history, the view, the vibe. I would like to add that it is perfectly safe!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach in Rio
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema is the best beach in Rio (along with Leblon), especially around Life Guard station number 9. It is less crowded that Copacabana beach, and the crowd is more upscale. If staying at the beach any length of time, this is the place to hang out.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A PEOPLE'S BEACH
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We did not go there for a swim or to sit on the sand, but mainly to walk and people-watch : compared to Cocacabana Beach, Ipanema is crowded and busy, with a quantity of chair-hirers who all try to rent you a chair. There are people gathering a small groups of friends, people playing football and volleyball without nets ( there are nets and pitches on Cocacabana ) and people just lying in the sun.To get there from Leme beach, as we did, take the 539 bus for 260 R each. We enjoyed a safe walk back along the water's edge all the way back along the beach at dusk. Magical !

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic beach, safe and clean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were staying near the beach in Ipanema, and so visited here a few times.The beach was very safe, and clean (far better on both counts than Copacabana).Plenty of beach bars nearby as well if you wanted a drink whilst you were sat there.Sun lounger and parasol hire was very inexpensive too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Better than the rest
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is less crowded than copacabana, try it out. For an even better experience walk towards Leblon.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Had to visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We walked around to Ipanema Beach from Copacabana - it was a very hot day but it was an interesting walk.  We did not actually stay at the beach, took the obligatory photo and then got a cab back to Copacabana, where there were many more options for a cold beer and delicious lunch.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Place to relax and enjoy Rio Beach Culture
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a huge beach and very busy when I visited.  You can buy all sorts on the beach so do take some money for drinks, souvenirs, food etc  You can hire a chair and umbrella for not much money and enjoy the day on the beach.There are lots of places on the Ipanema walkway to sit and eat or have a beer or iced Coconut (coco fredo) which doesnt cost much.  Enjoy the sites of the beach, volleyball, football, swimming and all the people going by.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous beach, chilled out vibe. Much more relaxed than Copacabana with less vendors. You can still pick up a chair and umbrella and there are plenty of food options though. It is very quiet Monday - Friday but at the weekends and holidays it is packed. Great spot for people watching.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A much smarter beach and less crowded ,even some sun loungers . Plenty of places to eat and drink. Just nice to walk along the wide pavement and enjoy the view

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Feel the vibe
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema Beach counts with one of the most energetic vibes in Rio de Janeiro. The place (and girl) which inspired the song “Girl of Ipanema”, still have its fascinating atmosphere.The beach became one of the preferential “get together” points in any of its posts. The sand is shared by those who are looking for a relaxing day and to the addicts to the sport. We can find a large variety of places to eat or stay comfortable in the chair under the umbrella waiting for your Acai, Mate with lemonade guy to pass by. Don’t forget to stay for the sunset! It is spectacular!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Girl From Ipanema Statue
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You gotta get a picture of a babe with the statue of the man who wrote"Girl From Ipanema". The beach is beautiful all along the coast.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Quieter than Copacabana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: When walking back from the hippy market, we stayed on Ipanema for a while.  Quieter than Copa beach and not as many sellers... but still a lot.  Nice walk along the promenade.Worth a visit..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stayed for a week. Fantatic
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely clean beach with white sand and a clear blue sea. Quieter than Copacabana. Great views with food and drink from the beach sellers. Sorry to leave.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: saturday morning at ipanema
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were at ipanema beach all Saturday morning before lunch, many people enjoying the sun and the sea, also many practiced beach volley ball and football, you can find all kinds of food and drinks, clean public toilets.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach - great experience
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a very interesting experience - just watching the salespeople on the beach is an event in itself. The beach is clean and although the water is cold in April it is clean and worthy dip. Lots to "see"

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: On a par with Copacabana beach.  Stunning and a bit quieter.  Easy to reach on local bus transport if you're staying more towards the city centre/Copacabana areas.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning scenery
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Scenery was stunning.  That includes both the topographical/geological and the physiological.  Nice to see mix of tourists and locals of all incomes levels enjoying themselves side by side.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Famous for a reason
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach has fabulous soft sand and beautiful water.  There are all kinds of kiosks to buy drinks and snacks.  Many vendors are selling their wares but most are soft sells.  A caipirinha maker tried to con us into giving him a Real $50 tip for his “weak son” and said Real $100 would be better.  He got none from us.  Overall, it was a great place to sit and watch the sunset.  Lots of people there just kicking the ball and having fun!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Trip to Brazil
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Long , clean beach  excellent location, friendly local people , fun, sports activities available together with Food & Drinks

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A wonderful friendly beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Having been to Copacabana beach, we decided to try somewhere different.  So it was off to Ipanema beach, just around the corner from Copacabana. This isn't as wide as Copacabana and wasn't as crowded either. Also the rental costs for chairs and umbrellas was about 1/3 that of Copacabana. The Guy who had the stall was always on hand to keep us topped up with refreshments, and even reserved our places whilst we went for lunch, to a small restaurant that he recommended. A great day out at the beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Heart of Rio City
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Tourist make sure you stay near Ipanema Beach, one can also look alternative to stay at Coppacabana.Beaches safe // walkers delight.Kids/ even adults can cycle for rent as low as 10 real a month.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: famous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema Beach is right next to Copacabana Beach, with a wide swath of sand, stands where you can buy drinks and snacks. Others rent beach chairs and umbrellas. And there are street vendors selling tee shirts and other tourist stuff. We also passed a lot of elaborate sand sculptures which you can photograph for a small payment.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic people watching!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wasn't sure what to expect from this beach as it was our first time in Rio. It was not relaxing in any way but it was a brilliant experience. You can hire chairs and umbrellas for a really reasonable price as well as ordering drinks. There are so many people walking up and down selling - grilled cheese, prawns, sandwiches, soft drinks, cocktails, sarongs, bikinis, beach dresses, speakers - you name it, you can buy it! The waves were awesome and the view from the beach is beautiful. Well worth a visit!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We are a family of 4 and we stayed in Rio for 5 nights. We stayed in Sol Ipanema hotel overlooking the Ipanema beach. We happened to be visiting on the Easter weekend. Although the beach was crowded but added so much color to the beach scene. The view from our hotel window with all the colorful umbrellas was spectacular. We went to the beach all 5 days and we still couldn't get enough of it.This beach is not a kid friendly beach. The waves are high and pretty rough during high tides. Also it is a public beach with no life guards. We got to watch sunset on one day (the other days it was cloudy). The beach is lit in the night and we could see people till late in the night walking or just hanging out on the shore. There is also a walking area just on the side of the road. It goes all the way from beginning of Ipanema till the beginning of Leblon.Ipanema beach is a must visit while in Rio. There are many vendors on the beach selling all kinds of things from Ray bans to bikinis to T-shirts to coconut water. They really add to the colorful scene of the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ipanema
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Chosen the hotel here and didinät regret it. Like it better tha CC for swimming running and bars alike.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Better Than Copacabana, Great For People Watching and Sunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema is smaller than Copacabana and has slightly higher class shopping opportunities.  Getting there can be maddening depending on the traffic conditions, but still you gotta see it when in Rio.  The Girl from Ipanema is there, she's just aged a few decades!  Beautiful beach of course to enjoy the sun in.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not many girls of Ipanema around, if the song is to be believed, but a beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spent a couple of hours here whilst on a trip and had a blast.  A busy and bustling beach with some real characters running around the place.  Loads of beach bars and fast food places around and a very chilled out place or if you want, a mecca for beach volleyball, running, or weight training.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice Beach but Dangerous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Actually Ipanema has upper class shopping area compared to Copacabana, however, I have witnessed two criminal incidents in front of my own eyes here. First a biker snapped a tourist necklace and ran away. 2nd a guy was following us but luckily a Brazilian lady warned us to walk away quickly. All incidents were at Ipanema beach. So.. it was beautiful but be careful..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice stroll!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach a bit smaller than copacabana and less crowded too, we visited during a public holiday in the morning and was almost deserted and nice to walk! i did not feel unsafe at all though I had taken all precautions to avoid attracting attention to me as a tourist. It was close to my hotel and highly recommend it for a walk!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A way better than Copacabana. It’s cleaner and views are a way better. I’d definitely prefer to stay there than in Copacabana, next time!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ipanema beach: not the same but essential
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was a teenager when started to find my crowd in the Ipanema "posto" number nine, or the "Nove" as we use to call. The beach has different crowds. Depending on the location and day time, they are completely different. Find yours by walking and checking out the different people in each spot. Gays, sportsmen, potheads, they are all there. Just need to do some research. And enjoy!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach for people watching
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Rent chairs & umbrella from Elias in front of the Rio Country Club.  Less crowded part of Ipanema because there is less apartments as the club takes up space.  Don’t bring valuable items - we brought an old iPod to take photos and left our phone at home.  Best photo op is just before sunset.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach in Rio
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A typical atrractive beach. Suitable basically for swimming instead of playing volleyball etc. Nice waves. Cleaner than Copacabana.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beaches - comparable to South Africa
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I think naming the beaches with beautiful names like Ipanema, not to mention the odd Beach Boys song, makes it a place you really want to see. Not as many waves as there are on the South African coast but lovely for swimming

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A must see
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema is much more lively than other beaches and has some great spots. I was down in the gay area of the beach. My tip is to find a good tent that has good prices on chairs and beers. Sit down and enjoy the view on the beach, have a swim. I found the beach safe, met lots of lovely people and had a great day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fun and happy place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Go, enjoy, have a few Caipirinhas. Loved everything about it, beautiful views of the sugarloaf mountain.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just like the postcards
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is one of the world's most beatiful beaches.  The scenery is amazing.  Easy walking around.  Even the sand paths are watered to keep the heat down!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Keeping fit in Rio
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazed at people always out walking, biking ,running, volleyball and of course soccer. On a Sunday they even close one side of the road to accommodate runners.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very Quiet for when we were there
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Such an iconic beach and nearly deserted while we were there. had a great drink of coconut milk from a beach vendor and watched the wind surfers landing in the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Better than the Copacabana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The two famous beaches, maybe the most famous beaches of the world are in RioAfter seeing both the Copacabana was very alive but to be honest Ipanema was so much better..Beautiful sunset and extremely clean.The beaches are so long and wide , a great way to run or to walk along when you’re in a romantic mood.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach Nicer from above
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Huge beach famous all over the world  and somewhat deserving of its fame. Aerial views look beautiful but on the ground this beach becomes a giant seaside city. Generally much safer than some think but sensible safety precautions should be taken, especially at night.There are many opportunities to rent seating and umbrellas as well as to purchase drinksAlways worth a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Packed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is always full and it is not so different than Copacabana Beach, a lot of people selling stuff and at weekends it will be hard to have peace there. If you don't like the smell of marijuana just avoid it and be open minded to see everything there, it is one of the most open-minded beaches that I have been at. Very gay friendly, I love it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very cool beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Made positive impression on me, seems like safe place, at least according to Brazilian standards. Did not see any weird people of homeless begging for money. Of course better to be cautious. Sand and ocean was nice, there is a plenty eating or drinking opportunities at the beach. Multiple “stores” make great juices. There is also free WiFi at sidewalk. Nice place, worth to hang out. I like it much more than Copacabana.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just lovely, a real icon.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just be careful if you go swimming here, the wave can get very big and the current can really take you by surprise.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Went here couple of times with my husband. We went to Copacabana for half a day but it was filthy the eater was a horrible colour and full of rubbish same as the sand. Where this beach it's beautiful the water and sand are very clean. The rips in the water can be quite strong and waves are quite big. But definetly the best beach out the 2! You aren't expensive for chairs to rent out and parasol. There are always venders going by offering a range of food, drinks, clothing and speakers or sunglasses.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most beautiful beach of Rio de Janeiro
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You have to spend the day on this beautiful beach You have to rent some chairs and drink caipirinha all day So much fun with the music 🎶 You are in BRAZIL baby

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful beach and place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: That is a must go in Rio. This beach is good for leisure and also for surf sometimes. Great restaurants nearby. Beware with your cameras, wallets and cell phones.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Better the copacabana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: In my view, this is far more elegant and less crowded beach than copacabana. The shops, restaurants and facilities looked much upmarket. It nice to see both beaches for comparsion

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: In my view Ipanema Beach is far superior to Copacabana. It appears much cleaner and more refined and was definitely worth the walk from our hotel, which was situated at the far end of Copacabana. The waves were fantastic and attracted quite a number of surfers.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great area
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The spectacular sunset is breathtakingly gorgeous. Close to automobiles on Sunday , make it a family friendly beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Some cafes along the beach or go back a couple of roads into Ipanema for a wider range of options.  Can be reached easily by metro.Busiest at weekends and quieter on weekdays.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Loved this beach - there was some much happening here. We didn't swim just sat and watched life, every minute there was something else to see. Such fun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: We missed the gay section!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Apparently there is a gay section of Impanema Beach, though we missed it. It must be at the far south end. We’d walked over from Copacabana beach. It’s not the short 300 metres the signage claims. By the third we got to Impanema we were feeling a bit distant from our hotel and, perhaps because we’d just flown overnight, not that adventurous. After a too-long slog through the dense heavy sand on the beach we turned around to return. Another consideration is that there are a lot more services along Copacabana beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Can be rough
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach was easy to reach from our Arena Hotel and was full of locals swimming and having beach lunches, some Bar B Qs. The beach was very long and kept clean, just be aware of any red flags flying and beware the sun it is very strong even when cloudy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you are in Rio you should visit this beautiful beach. One of the most iconic places in Rio de Janeiro.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautful and clean beach water and waves were perfect felt safe only Downside is too many venders but never felt unsafe would defentlry go back

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Our favourite
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had a nicer time here than we did at the Copacabana. The waves are great the street vendors were friendly. Made a bill at the start and payed at the end. We had a great time, many times.At one point my daughter dropped her phone & had it given back to her by one of the street vendors?!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A wander along the prom
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beac is similar to Copacobana but slightly more upmarket. There is a narrow busy road to cross to get to the beach which has netting between it and the prom. There are makeshift bars every few hundred yards with cheap tables and chairs outside so it’s easy to get a drink. On the beach there are lots of ‘bars’ set up by locals. They’re quite scruffy looking and have huge ice filled boxes containing beer etc. Food is available at these places but it’s not easy to see what there is. I’d only be tempted to have a drink and we stuck to a bar on the actual prom.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: you have to stroll along Ipanema Beach and find the Girl from ipanema...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: have been on this Beach several times over the years... on weekends it is very busy and on the sidewalk there is a market, this beach is very long but not as wide as Copacabana.  It is very clean as well, there is a special cleaning Crew on the job in Orange suits to keep it that way... stroll along the Mosaic Tile floor, look for Garota de Ipanema  ( you can have LUNCH there as well ) it is on a side street where the song " the girl from Ipanema was written by Jobim... mark my word you will love this area of Rio...enjoy , now look at my photos...Our Tour  Guide " Nilton " at  (55 21  ) 99955-1798  very reliable & dependable will take you there ,his prices are down to earth, he will NOT disappoint you, use him and you will never have a problem in RIO de Janeiro....

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Simply beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I walked from Copacabana to Ipanema. I just love it. But, if you want to swim or surf, percuation is necessarry - big waves and strong current. If the red flag is up the air, do not go in the water because the risk for rip currents is too high. Don t be crazy. :) You can see the favela Vidigal from Ipanema, beach (I walked from there to Vidigal, but I didn't go in). For me, one of the most gorgeous beaches ever. Must visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just as I Imagined
reviewsWithKeywords.text: So I read REALLY great reviews and then poor reviews... which led me to just go visit on my own to form my own opinion.So glad I went because I was beyond pleased. Our hotel was in Copacabana by Posto 3 so an Uber cost us R$12 at 1000 to go to Posto 8. Upon arrival we realized it’s true... all the good stuff happens at Posto 9.Tips:- We chose to get Umbrellas and chairs from “Barraca do Uruguay N* 80” it was R 20 for an umbrella and 2 chairs that were already set up so we didn’t have to carry ANYTHING.- It’s true no one carry’s towels they all have “Congo’s” which we found for R$25 at little shops vs the beach men who sell them for R$50 - the place we locked in sold water bottles, juices, coconut water, beers, snacks ... basically everything you could possibly want so you don’t need to load up on snacks- their are numerous Vendors that sell snacks, bikinis, sunglasses, drinks, cigarettes, speakers ... I mean everything while you just lay and ran- try to stay in front of the Posto since the restroom is located there. It’s R$2 for the restroom.- almost each stand that sells chairs and umbrellas has WiFi that you can use if you’re a customer... so you can request an Uber as a tourist and not worry. - the tide rises as the day goes on so don’t get too comfy laying on the sand. We saw a couple of people get woken up by crazy big waves hitting them- tip whoever is helping you out. These guys work super hard to please you and I think it’s just appropriate

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ipanema and samba
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It was a great noon beach time, I got there slightly earlier and paid a chair for the entire afternoon with drinks and wifi abd even cheese fondue if you want. Beach is pretty clean and strong current. Pay for each bathroom time. samba musician was friendly and I get to jammed with them a little. It's good to run or bike around in the morning. Local told me is much safer on this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in Rio
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Less people than Copacabana. Betterr colour and size aswell. A bit more waves, but a very nice beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach younger crowd
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema beach is a great beach For Walking along the shore Bars and some restaurants Younger crowed and a gay beach in the middle The sellers on the beach are more friendly

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Less Populated Ghan Copa
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We liked this beach, as it was quieter than Copa.  There are lots of locals exercising, as the town provides great equipment free of charge.  There are more umbrellas not so on top of each other, since it is not as crowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Where the young people go
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We walked part of this beach, which was very busy. Unfortunately the rubbish from the sea gets washed up and is a constant problem and requires constant attention

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nicer than Copacobana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I would pick Ipanema over Copacabana any time as it's just a nicer beach. Less busy during the week.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fairly clean water. Great views all around. Plenty of bars and restaurants around. Perfect for relaxing, and for pictures.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema is one of my favorite beaches. It is for the grown and sexy, I rarely see any children when I go. My only caution is to be ware of the locals. The people working on the beach can be a tad bit aggressive. But they are friendly. Everything you want can be sold to you on the beach: beach chairs, umbrellas, drinks, food etc.. you will have a great time. The water is fairly warm in be summer.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Disappointingly dirty!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were told by everyone the best beach is Ipanena, that may be true at any other time but a Carnaval time it wasn't good, Dirty, many dubious hawkers and a strong smell of weed. Not advised at that time of year!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sunny in Brazil
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is crowded, especially on the weekends but there are some good eye candy on the each.  Watch yourself carefully because there are wondering eyes and hands all over, so do not taking anything of value there.  The beach is gorgeous and most of the people are friendly.  It's a must do while there but the water is colder than what I am used to in Miami.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Another beautiful beach!!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very close to copacabana less tourists compared to copacabana i ll say better sand too beach volley is a must on this beach and for my opinion better for swimming!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice beach in a nice neighborhood.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at our hotel on Ipanema Beach. The beach is beautiful with lots of touristy activities, places to eat, places to shop, and places to stop for a beverage. One of my favorite beaches.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Famous stretch of sand!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach but waves can build up at times.Can be some 'undesireables' at the southern end so don't show off your glitzy jewelry or posh phone!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: WOW
reviewsWithKeywords.text: stayed at a beach hotel, very busy and lively, but what fun, BEWARE the water can be very deceiving, it will drag you out all too easy, the waves are incredible

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A landmark site of Rio.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Rio is a city that lives under a lucky star: it has two of the most recognisable, popular, and beautiful beaches. One, Copacabana, the other, Ipanema. Copacabana has a view sprawling in front of you as if it were a painting in the living room. It’s iconic. It’s stunning. Some of the most amazing bodies can be found on the beach – as in living people!The constant flow of beach salespeople can be annoying, though, but if you can get past that, you’ll have a great time. Use the opportunity to watch the sunset from one of the far ends of the beach. People sit on the rocks and clap as if it were a theatre performance.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and vibrant
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There is not a significant difference between Copacabana and Ipanema. I loved them both. I sensed Ipanema a bit more expensive but this could be subjective. The eastern edge is very close to Copacabana and the rocks, the view point, are really interesting.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ipamena Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Phenomenal- everyone needs to go at least once in their life. If it gets crowded walk 5 minutes to Cococabana.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ipanema or Copacabana?
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Either one! Both beaches are beautiful but climbing out onto the flat rocks for sunset at Ipanema is a must. Get there 30 minutes to one hour before sunset for the best spot!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crazy at Carnaval
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was lucky enough be in Rio at Carnaval and Ipanema beach is insane.  Sp many people on the beach.  The water is beautiful and refreshing,  Great place to people watch - and spot some of the beautiful people.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Exciting, Crowded, Dangerous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited from a Celebrity Cruise ship with Glayber Silva Tours (look up on Trip Advisor!).  Glayber brought us to the beach in an air conditioned van.  He followed us through the crowded beach and watched our belongings as we swam in the warm waters.  There was quite an under tow and fairly strong waves near shore.  Young children should be watched.Because the beach is near a poor area of the city, Glayber carefully watched our belongings and advised about not keeping phones, bags and money out in the open.  Young teams of kids quickly grab and run.It was very scenic and historic, but far too crowded for my liking.  There were hoards of scantily dressed girls in thongs and bikinis to keep the imagination occupied.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I strongly recommend to stay at Ipanema beach while in Rio de Janeiro. The beach is gorgeous. Forget about packed lunches! Just buy meals/snacks and literally anything under the sun from the vendors / roaming vendors there! Support local business!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Too crowded during Carnival
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you love giant crowds then this is the place during Carnival    Getting food and drink with dollars is impossible.  Get local currency.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best sunset ever....
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is very cool mainly because the sunsets. Its not as wide as copacobana but still very beautiful always busy with some nice beach bars along the promanade. You must stay till sunset as this is an amazing sight to see.. there is a guy that sings on the edge while the sunsets giving you such a chilled out vibe its incredible.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Atmosphere is good
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited Rio during Carnival week.  Everywhere was packed with people dressing costumes and there were Police all over the street that you felt so safe.  A stroll along the beach after dinner was nice.  Remember not to bring valuables with you.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best experience ever
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We travelled when it was summer in Brazil - and what a beautiful time to be there. It is exactly how you would imagine it - bikinis, sand, sun, water, caiprinhas, sunbeds, towels - everything is perfection. I am not a big fan of crowded places - but this was something else. The crowd of beautiful brazilian bodies makes it even better :)My husband and I had one of our most memorable time at Ipanema. I hope we can go there again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most famous beach worldwide
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous place to visit in Rio de janeiro. Gives you one of the most beautiful natural sites of the world. Place where "The girl from Ipanema" became famous with one of the most popular songs of Brazil

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Brasil
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema beach is beautiful it's near all hotels, bars and restaurants. It's 15 mins away from Copacabana beach. Food is great a lot of churascarias not expensive at all... had a wonderful time ..will go back in 3 yrs...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the best beaches around Rio.  While Copacabana may be the most famous, this is the most beautiful  A must visit while in Rio.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What a beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I have stayed a Ipanema beach located hotel the whole week - and what a lovely place from the rising sun to sunset. Not as busy as Copacabana which I also past today. A 17km training walk along both beaches. You can choose between the pedestrian or simply in the sand. There is a lot of people exercising from morning to evening.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beautiful place for a stroll.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach and sea here are beautiful- more refined and pretty than Cococabana beach. We went on a Saturday and it had a lovely atmosphere with lots of families enjoying themselves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach i have been.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Excellent beach with friendly people ,good environment ,clean ,safety ,huge amount of attractions to do like  volleyball,football, etc.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema beach is beautiful just like you see in the photos. Lovely white sand and clean water. This is a great spot to watch the sunset. Was not too busy when we were there but I would imagine it can get very busy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful beach. We enjoyed the atmosphere and friendly people. We felt very safe and the water was great.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: During NYE time and it was amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Friendly people offering you drinks and chair to stay on the beach for really cheap price. Looking for you space, bring you everything, no rush at all with pay and more drinks. People are good looking around, beach is clean and in nye is was absolutely full. Music and good atmosphere is was what we need before the big party. Also we came back after nye time and much less people but still same good service. Def good beach to be

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Famous Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Worth a stroll along the sidewalk, and the view of the surrounds. Good swimming, but quite short edge into the water. Street sellers not as prevelant or as good as Copocobana

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Most sexy beach in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema beach is cleaner and more upmarket than Copacabana.  It is the place where rich and the poor Brazilians mingle.  The beaches are the most democratic parts of Rio.  Everybody is welcome here.  Lots of beautiful bodies, old people, children and a gay section around posto 9.  It is the best place to having a cold coconut drink, while watching he sunset.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just a fabulous beach, much quieter than Copacabana but equally beautiful. Fabulous white sand and blue sea. Great for surfing if a little rough if you are a novice. Well worth going to   Lots of places to eat or drink nearby but use only local currency no cards or dollars

reviewsWithKeywords.title: My Favourite Beach in Rio, especially at Sunset!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited in October 2014. Really lovely beach, quieter than the main Copacabana beach. Nice for swimming and relaxation. Be careful of currents and waves though. Great for surfing too. Enjoyed walking along the long promenade. Loved the view from the rocks at the far right corner of the beach and this is a prime spot to watch the sun go down between the Rio Hills. Great atmosphere here and enjoyed the native music and dance and little food stalls at sunset! Definitely must go here if visiting Rio.
