Can walk along the coast from Copacabana beach or its also easily accessible by Metro!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach, great sights
reviewsWithKeywords.text: As a well-known tourist spot, & beach to go to, you know it's going to be crowded! Well worth a look though, and a stroll swim will make you feel like you're really been to Rio de Janeiro! A must see sight when you go to Rio!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Romantic
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We loved the beach in front of the Fasano.  We had to lounge set up for laying in the sun together.  The waves and sand were perfect for a dip in the ocean. Gorgeous! Abrigada

reviewsWithKeywords.title: #upclass
reviewsWithKeywords.text: 1. Beautiful women 2. Excellent bars 3. Good waves4. Calm5. Relaxing 6. Safe and Secure7. Beautiful women

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Loved this beach. But be aware of your surroundings, pick pockets are about. The sales people on the beach seemed ok

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Incredible beach even more that I stayed at Ipanema Beach Hostel very close to this beach in especial space 11

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not as busy as Copacabana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It’s a smaller beach than Copa, and not as busy. So if you are looking for quiet and relaxing this is the beach to be at.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Better than Copacabana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The water is clean here and also there is something about it being away from the main road which made this beach a better experience

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great for wave jumping!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very strong waves and currents although heavily life guarded. Great fun! Lots going on - good place to people watch!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning and Lively beachfront and shops
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema is slightly more upscale than its neighbour Copacabana with more high end stores, restaurants and accomodation.  The beach is stunning and the locals friendly and welcoming.  The beach can get busy on the weekends but the street along the beach front and a block or two back from the beach are a nice respite from the heat and the crowds.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best beaches in Rio
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My wife and I, we were visited Ipanema and Ipanema beach during our one week vacation in Rio on November. It seems that Ipanema is one if the safest locations in Rio and Ipanema beach is beautiful. We loved Ipanema and Ipanema beach. Definitely, better than Copacabana. Barra beach also very beautiful, but not in downtown Rio. If you are interested with beaches, try Barra beach as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ipanema beach with friends
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My favorite place is Ipanema the most visited in Rio, the beach so amazing with a beautiful view the twins mountains also the energy in this place where u can make friends and share a good moments

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Famous Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We have all heard about this beach.  Since I ended up in Rio by myself I didn't want to go to the beach by myself but I still wanted to see it.  I hired a cab to take me.  The beach is amazing especially since it is so close to the city.  It was only about 28 C on the day I went to the beach which is cool for the locals so there were very few people on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Location to stay in Rio
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I highly recommend staying in this area. Smaller then Copacobana, and a bit quieter without the large Tourist hotels. Very safe, and you have the fun Hippy market on Sunday!. I am not a beach person, so wandered a bit on the sand, and the ocean is a bit cold for me. Only drawback here is downtown is quite a ways away, Uber is 30 minutes or so.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Next beach along from Copacabana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Slightly quieter than Copacabana. Lovely long bay to take a leisurely stroll. Shopping street parallel to coast, not worth the walk. Several coffee bars and small places to eat.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great spot, cleaner than Copacabana.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great place to swim and hang out and is narrower than Copa. You can people watch and grab a cold mate tea or coconut.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach culture in Rio
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I enjoy the promenades in Rio. You can walk from one beach to the next. Will take about an hour to walk from Ipanema to Leblon (my favourite beach). Lots of sports activities along the way, many vendors (quite noisy) selling their items, from drinks to food to beachwear. You can do chair and umbrella hire if your hotel does not provide these. The weather is hot so I found the need to dive into the shade every now and then. Tides are strong so beware of wading too deep into the ocean. Water is pleasantly warm, but waves can be big. For the rest safe to swim and clean. There are also fresh water showers on the beach to get rid of the salty water before returning to the hotel or stopping by one of the many beach 'restaurants' for a drink. Very enjoyable!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Happiness
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning beach, great cocktails, friendly people, great souvenirs, lots of different drinking places separated into zones,

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Upper market end of the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were staying in the corner section between Copacabana and Ipanema beaches and so going to both was very easy. We chose to go to the beach early morning and just after lunch time. It was a weekend so we was surprised just how packed the beach was by 0830amThey shut off one side of the road on the Sunday so people can skate and cycle and run in the unused side of the road. Great idea but means you need to be carful when crossing. The beach itself is clean and has a lot of activities going on all the way along it so it doesn’t matter where you chose to make your spot.There are plenty of bars and restaurants but we felt they were very expensive. The downside was the toilets appeared to be controlled by the bars and you were not permitted to use without a ticket which you only got when you purchased food or drink at the bar beside the toilet.Surf can be quite rough which is fun to play in

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Hive of activity and safe
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You hear a lot of bad things about the dangers of going to the beaches in Rio - you’ll get robbed, stabbed etc etc. But nothing could have been further from the truth - the wide beach was full of both families & ‘beautiful bodies’ and there was no hint of anything but fun. The shopping strip was worth a visit and we bought lots of Havianas as souvenirs for those at home. There is nothing to choose between Ipanema & Copa both being very pleasant days out. Just watch the surf - it was very rough & too cold for me.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breathtakingly gorgeous, but not relaxing.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: In my view this is Rio's most spectacular beach. The mountainous vistas to the left and right with the blue southern Atlantic in front of you are absolutely one of a kind. The fantastic photos that you have no doubt already seen look great for a good reason. This beach feels more local than Copacabana. It is however both shorter in length and narrower than Copa. A narrow canal separates Ipanema from Leblon. What gets emptied out into the ocean from that canal may give you at a minimum a persuasive reason to shower thoroughly from head to toe afterwards if you choose to enter the water.There is always something going on at this beach: folks working out, tanning, playing volleyball, walking, heading into and out of the ocean. There is also plenty of eye candy. Some show up wanting to be noticed. There are always folks trying to sell you something and it gets annoying at times. There is sadly often petty crime that happens, so if it isn't something that you can be perfectly happy living without, don't bring it along with you. That also means unless you are in a protective group, not wise for example to take out your new iPhone X to get that perfect shot of your friend.It is that combination of having to constantly be aware and constantly being solicited that makes the experience completely un-relaxing. If you go looking to be a part of an energetic Brazilian beach experience you should definitely see Ipanema, just go with a pragmatic level of awareness.Ipanema + relaxing experience = 5 starsIpanema + un-relaxing experience = 3 stars

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Copacabanas more local twin
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is a little bit more local, but rather similar to Copacobana. Very nice soroundings, and quite touristy. In the bottom of the beach there is a huge rock between copacabana and Ipanema where you can get a glimpse of a beautiful sunset. Here you have to be a bit more careful, but the police is also more present here, so you should be fine. :-)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love the energy!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema is shorter in distance length wise than Copacabana and it could be just me but I feel the locals go to Ipanema more than Copacabana which seems more touristy. I actually prefer Ipanema.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Even in clouds, it's a beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We walked along the beach and sat for a while even though it was the evening and cloudy. The sand and water is beautiful here and we ate at a restaurant nearby.  You can't go wrong going here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nearly the same as Copacabana and for me very nice.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Cannot tell how it might be during "high season" - but most pictures speak for themselves. I was there where nearly no one was on the beach and it was amazing. It is clean and in the evening there were lots of nice small locations to sit down and dring a little.It might be crowded, but I also liked the prominade and the restaurants there. In general there was no "but", but i think it is so famous that it will not be surprising, that stuff is a little more expensive and it might be crowded. BTW - there was not much of a difference for me to Copacabana.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: I LOVED IT
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A nice beach. wonderful.a true tourist spot.clean and sophisticated place. worthy holiday. what a wonderful bath and a view like never before. I LOVED IT

reviewsWithKeywords.title: WOW
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You can sit hours watching surfing with caipirinhas cocktails.The beach and the views of 2 Irmaos mountain is stunning.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: best beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a lovely white, soft, sandy beach. You can sit by the beach in boardwalk cafe/bars sipping a very inexpensive cocktail - you must try caipirinhas - enjoying the beach football/volleyball and watching the people cycle, roller blade, and jog by. Ipanema is smaller than Copacabana, with far fewer people selling things so much more peaceful. It is the perfect spot to watch the sun, looking like an orange ball, sink into the sea every night to the applause of the people on the beach. Pure magic - but please be careful after dark - the atmosphere gets a little more edgy as the area becomes much quieter

reviewsWithKeywords.title: white sand beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: best to go there for sunset watching as the locals. Take your beer or capirinia and enjoy beach beauties and life.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Windy and beautiful.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best at sunset. For a walk and taking photos. You can make a long walk from Ipanema to Copacabana and enjoy the views and atmosphere.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach crammed with people
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We cycled along to Ipanema from Cocacabana on a Brazilian holiday to find it even more crowded than Cocacabana. It is lovely however and full of lively locals having a great time. I'd recommend having a drink in the small cafes at the end of Leblon beach. From there you have a wonderful view right along the length of Ipenema and Leblon beaches.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Don’t hold out to go swimming here - the currents were strong and the water was dirty. Sunbaking appears to be the go.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There are 3 beaches that share this approximately 3.6 klm stretch of sand. Ipanema Beach is in the middle of Leblon Beach (to the west) and Arpoador Beach (to the east).We were lucky to have stayed for a week at a hotel just across the road from the beach and so had a lot of time to get a tiny bit of a feel for the place. We were looking forward to having a swim here but quickly observed that there were hardly any people swimming and when they did go in the water it was only predominantly up to their waist. We soon found out why when we went in. There are strong currants that run along the beach and we could see a number of rips. Also the water was pretty dirty and there were very few good waves for body surfing. On one day when the waves were a little large they were just breaking on shore.The beach though was packed on Saturday and Sunday, still very few people in the water, but with thousands of people sunbaking along the whole length of the beach. There were also literally hundreds playing volleyball, either the traditional way with their hands or just using their feet, chests and heads, or playing football or just kicking a ball around. There was a lot of bare skin and very few hats. There were plenty of people on the beach on weekdays as well.We were lucky in that our hotel had a tent on the beach and supplied us with sun baking lounges, umbrellas, towels and water at no extra cost. This would not have been a problem though as there were a plethora of other vendors who could supply the same things if you decided to sit in what appeared to be their designated areas, plus kiosks supplying drinks other than water. There were also dozens of vendors walking along the beach selling a range of things from trinkets to sarongs to hats to a large assortment of clothes, drink and food items.There were hundreds of people running, walking, skateboarding, roller skating and cycling along the beach every morning and afternoon into the early evening, particularly on Sunday when one side of the normally very busy Ave Delfim Moreira was closed to cars.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great waves for surfing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach stretches on from copacabana but differs in that there are better waves here for surfing. The Arpoador which is like a rocky protrusion is a good place to watch the sunset. You walk through the park to get to the Arpoador and then continue on the beach front. There is a statue of Tom Jobin of ‘the girl from Ipanema’ fame on the pavement.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not Like you Think
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Yes, very famous, no, not what you picture it to be.  Dirty, and not very inviting.  Locals were not very friendly, but that could be because of the amount of tourists.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the famous and popular beach. It is really nice with wonderful views and the best sunset in the city

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My husband and I walked Impanena Beach quite a few times as it was close to where we were staying. Also they had little bars for drinks scattered along the shoreline. Everyday was different and entertaining well worth the visits

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach in great city
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's a great wide beach right in the city with close access to many hotels.  There are also plenty of vendors and other kiosks or mini-bars selling drinks, food, and toys.Additionally there are plenty of nets set up for beach soccer, volleyball, or volleyfut.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Famous for its GIRL !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The most elegant beach in Rio. Beautiful sunset.  Not so crowded as Copacabana. Water usually clean and not treacherous.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: So beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just as lovely as we imagined!  Legend!  Ipanema Beach is a place for young and old.  We walked the wide footpath and watched the various activities.  The beach is full of life, bars, icecream, cool drinks, cafes, restaurants, exquisite, intricate sand castle.  Lines of water sprinklers across the beach create a cool path across the hot sand to the water.    We wish we could have stayed longer!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great vibe!!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Although i witness a lady getting her necklace robbed. The beach its amazing, make sure you stick for sunsets at the beach they look amazing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach , nice neighborhood to bike around . Path all along the beach . People selling everything !! Bikinis shrimp jewelry ... water ... you name it!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Everyone has to go to Ipanema Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema Beach is a place everyone should visit while you are there. The beach is full of life and activities. The people of Rio love their sport and beach activities. There is a walking / cycling path to view the beach if you don't want to get sand in between your toes. Lots of bars and cafes / restaurant along and across from the beach. I love the water sprinklers from the walk path on to the beach. It saves your feet from being burned by the hot sand. Australia needs to invest in this idea.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bike ride
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Excellent clean no threat beach. In a better environment than Copacabana and with less traffic and taxis. Definitely worth a walk or a ride from AvAtlantic.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Iconic Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We came and watched the sunset on the rocks over Ipanema beach. It was like a scene from a really cheesy romcom movie and I mean that in the best possible way.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Better than Copacabana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is getting more famous than Copacabana. More quiet as well with amazing view and amazing sea. Emplacemen at Posto 8 is one of the best

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Rent a bicycle .. cruise along the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is narrower than Copacabana  but still nice.  I live in Queensland Australia so I am spoilt for good beaches. Didn't think it was worth swimming in as the water is still cold in October. The place is still interesting though. Great for people watching and chilling out. We rented bikes and rode along the beach all the way to the end.  Then turned off by post 10 and rode inland to a lake and park. Was an excellent way to spend the day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: My favourite Brazillian beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: By far the best beach I visited along the Rio coastline. The water was the cleanest, warm enough to swim and calm.The service on the beach is amazing with waiters running up and down who can get you anything from caipirinhas to suncream to cigarettes to a swimming costume etc. I spent the most time here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The good days are long gone
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The famous Ipanema beach is losing its charm. With so many tents and chairs on the beach and  salespeople hunting tourists, it’s no longer an enjoyable or safe place to go. Hotels and apartment building are not being maintained and it’s visible the number of properties either for rent or sale. I wish I wasn’t saying this but it’s no longer a great place to go.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Insanely busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema is cleaner than copacabana, but atleast on a week end next level busy, you'll have to work for a spot in the sand

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Run and Bike
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Such a beautiful run this morning along Ipanema Beach. Although it was raining the lighting and activity was still amazing. Made good use of the exercise stations along the way too.Later on we hired a bike each and cycled it as well, stopping for a coconut drink then to the point between Ipanema and Copacabana Beach where we found an outdoor, concrete barbell gym. Ill hit it tomorrow and pump some stone!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crowded 🏖 beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: On early mornings and especially earlt mirning week ends, this beach is fantastic! Very quite, friendly and clean;) But within a day it is more like a market when everybody sells smth. I spent one day on this beach but no more... i can not relax being in the centre of the market place ;((

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Runner's review - Ipanema beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I'm not a beach person but I love to run.  Ipanema has a boardwalk running its entire length. Check the distance on something like map my run. It seems completely safe to me despite advice against carrying anything of value - though I did strip it down to an old ipod and cheap head phones. Nonetheless, this is another BEAUTIFUL Rio run, more attractive than Copacabana. I did it on a Sunday and one side of the bordering street was closed to traffic.  Hundreds of runners passing by all day long. Go for it.  Best part of Rio might be running the famous beaches and the Lagoon.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach but not as wide as Copacabana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We grew up with the soundtrack "Girl from Ipanema ......aaaarrgh" so we had to go  there. Essentially it is the same beach as Copocabana but it is narrower and much less commercialised. There are even a few places where the original sand dunes still survive - suitably fenced off

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not as crowded or famous as Copa but still a very nice beach. If you want to get away from the big crowds come here

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful to take a ride
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Río de Janeiro has many beaches, beautiful beaches, and Ipanema is not the exception, there are no as many sellers as there are in Copacabana. I advice you to rent a bike and take a ride throughout Ipanema.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and clean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Strolled along the length of this beach on a Sunday afternoon watching the beach life in Rio. No one bothered us and we felt perfectly safe.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach was beautiful. We were there before it was too crowded. Later we drove by and it was packed!! The sand is fine and there were a lot of places to get refreshments and cool off. A must see if you are in Rio.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Hot, hot, hot!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great span of clean beaches, plenty of food/drink stalls as with Copacabana great Caiprinhas and cheap!!Spaces to play beach volley ball and public work out stations.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful beach.It has a very good views of the mountains around Ipanema.Worth a visit.Free wifi!!
Not as long as Copa; not as deep; less cafes and juice bars; and a narrower pavement.But still iconic, and a must visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful, crowded epicenter of the Brazilian Beach Culture
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Of course when you go to Brazil you HAVE to see this beach. It's famous for many good reasons but it's not very clean (does any local even notice this?). The surf is a bit stronger than at Copacabana so more surfers and many tiny bikinis. People-watching is excellent -- maybe not so good for children.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beach where the differences coexist
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach of Ipanema is one of the most famous beaches in Rio de Janeiro, because there coexist the cultural differences of the world. Gays and traditional families live together in harmony. At the end of the afternoon, you can see one of the most beautiful sunsets in the world. The tourist can go to Pedra do Arpoador and from there watch this spectacle of nature.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The man in Ipanema
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Probably the classiest of Rio's beaches.  Swimming is only for the strong but a nice place to relax and enjoy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing views and ambiance
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you sre in thr area on sunday, then a 25minute bike ride from copacabana is beautifulOn Sundays one side of the main road is closed to allow the people foe leisure activities. Absolutely great for a great family day out for the young and old and elderly.  Saw a lot of wheelchair  bound seniors bening brought out for some sunsine and fresh air!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ipanema is overrated
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Decades ago Ipanema used to be a fantastic beach. Clear water, white sand, beautifully bronzed bodies and peace were the norm. And yeah, it used to be a hot surf spot too. However, Ipanema has been yet another victim of Rio de Janeiro's decadence. The water is no longer very clear, except in rare instances. The sand is dirty and the overall ambience is loud and hectic, with the ocasional mugging, or worse - the famous arrastoes (gang muggings). Surfing? Not a chance; successive "improvements" on the beachfront have ruined what used to be a good beachbreak.  By the way, if you intend to see the beautiful "Girl from Ipanema", you're better off going to Barra da Tijuca beach, at a stretch of sand known as Praia do Pepe. That's where all the beautiful people show off their muscular, tanned bodies these days.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing Beaches, coconuts, beer, music and soccer
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This place was just how I imagined Rio de Janeiro… People were out till night time playing volleyball and soccer in the sand, there were kiosks dotted along the coast next to beautiful sidewalks. In the kiosk you could get food, beer, or coconuts and listen to beautiful music! If you walk further, you can get to Arapoador (sp?) for a beautiful view and also see the famous park that inspired Garota de Ipanema to be written.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sun, fun and a lot of people.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Yeah' it's one of the most famous beaches in the world and, of course, it's a nice one but it's not too safe. The beach is always full of people and I know some people their bags have been lifted there. Policemen said there's nothing they can do.If you go there, take care.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful on vacations
reviewsWithKeywords.text: On vacation days the beach is closed to cars and open to thr public  a great place to enjoy the atlantic ocean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best beach in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema beach is located in Rio and truly one of the most beautiful and colorful beach in the world with people basking in the sun as vendors walk around selling pastries, cocktails, sarongs and bikinis etc

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great for watching Volley Futball
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I prefer this beach to Copacabana, and there are some nice restaurants to visit, as well as juice bars.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: best beach in Rio
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The best beach in Rio. You got everything in a more relaxing environment comparing to copacabana.You can also visit Loblon which is nearby

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Always Gorgeous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A must go for anyone visiting Rio.  Relatively safe to walk, even at night, fun, full of electricity.  It is the place where Brazilian democracy works.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Rio's best
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema is beautiful in many senses. Clean beach, water and friendly people all around. As other places, always keep an eye open at all times. Beautiful sunset to top it off. Love it

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema is known for it's beautiful beach with white sandy beaches. It' s not expensive to hire a beach chair and parasol. There are really alert lifeguards around who do there jobs seriously ( we saw 2 life saver situations in 2 days). Where you rent your chair you can also order drinks and they even claim to have wifi. There are however a lot of salespersons walking around selling goods. A bit annoying sometimes. A tip: do not use regular towels on the beach but only kanga's ( the ones you can buy at the beginning of the beach). This makes it a little bit less obvious you are a tourist and therefor a good prey for thiefs.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach and fun on the weekend
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our visit in August meant the beach was quiet during the week, but volleyball still went on. On Sunday lively crowd with fun vendors coming through, and amazing surrounding mountains to balance the giant waves rolling in.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: MUST SEE the statue of 'THE MAN FROM IPANEMA'
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema Beach is a totally happening busy place to visit or walk along, beachside shopping!! The statue is fabulous - take a picture standing next to him!Walk along the beach, swim, eat ,then walk to the rocky outcrop!! Take a picture, as everyone seems to do, looking back to Ipanema - beautiful!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the Best in the World
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I am a fan of beaches and have been to some of the best in the world. Ipanema is a great party beach.. Reminds me of SoCal and Cancun but with the natural beauty of a once in a million landscape. There was a food and craft beer festival when we went and it was amazing. Great music, great view, great vibes. Drumming circle too. Wow.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the worlds tip city beaches.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ok it's not Bahia, but it's a great place to relax with great sand and at times of the day the hilly sand creates pools for children to play safely in. It's also a better vibe than copacabana which is more famous but not as good (more touristy and dirtier)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach in Río!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The water, the view of morro dos irmaos, everything in this beach is awesome, we went in August with 6 friends and enjoy a wonderful, warm day. It´s not summer, so the place is not that crowded. I recommend, if you stay in Copacabana, that you go to Ipanema, walking through the Avenida atlantica, is a nice way to see all the beach line. The prices at the bars on the beach, are really expensive, so walk into the neighborhood and you discover better options at good prices.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Quiet stroll
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema is more quiet than Copacabana but seems to have the better waves. It is certainly a nice beach for mice walk along the sea shore

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wow'd by the sunset 🌅
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Didn't spend much time here but the sunset was immense, beach was clean and the vendors were friendly. We found an event on at the time and mixed with locals who were so friendly, great food and great drink!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: My favorite beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My husband and I always stay some days in  Ipanema. Many restaurants, bars, hotels, apartments for ren't, and the beach is so gorgeous and so nice to be. I live drink and eat those stuffs they sell around you. I love to lay back and enjoy the beach and the people.Water is cold but is all you need on summer time

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relax place to enjoy great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This great and big beach is one of best attractions what Rio have, this is not only for swimming, this is place where need to be!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful day!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach always has a lot going on. The subway stop has a market on the weekend close to the beach at post 8. There are lots of people and activity, but the vendors don't bother you too much.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breathtaking!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Landed in Rio and am staying on Ipanema Beach, and was lucky enough to enjoy a breathtakingly gorgeous FULL MOON sunset. Wow!! I'm most thankful for the experience!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice to stroll along the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: During low season the beach isn't crowded at all. I prefered the smaller beaches to the west (Vidigal, Soa Conrado) more for spending a complete day sunning and swimming, but I had some lovely late nights walks at Ipanema Beach. The beach is perfectly clean, very wide and perfect sand. Temperature is also perfect in April.I liked Ipanema more than Copacabana.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy but brilliant
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The best beach in Rio. A sun trap with sugar like sand - busy with vendours but sometimes you really want them as you need beer and empanadas to get you through the day. Beware the sun - it's stronger than it feels.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Big reputation but looked run down
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I stayed in Copacabana, near the fort, so it was a short 10 minute walk across local streets (Arpoador interrupts the coast.)  There were almost no vendors and half the buildings seemed empty or in disrepair.  Perhaps Ipanema has been hit harder by the economic slowdown, but I would go here for the "bucket list" factor, but I was definitely underwhelmed.  Copacabana was much, much better.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous Fun and Friendly
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Looking good for a stunning tropical beach with golden sand and calm waters for swimming the head to Ipanema! It has everything you expect in. Rio beach with low deck chairs,  umbrellas,  volleyball players,  people selling all sorts of tat and constant hustle and bustle. You might relax and read a book but you won't really get any sleep!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach and nice crowd
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Located in the posh area of Rio de Janeiro, here is less action and more relaxing. The beaches are not safe when there are not many people around

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cannot beat it
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sand, Sun, great waves, surfers on one of the two most famous beaches in Rio while looking at  the Sugar Loaf...Just go, summer, winter, anytime.  My favorite...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had a great time in Rio and spent some time at Ipanema Beach. It is quite incredible that a beach in a big city is so clean and well looked after. Renting a beach bed and having food and drink service is great and although there were lots of people selling things we did not find them aggressive at all and were happy to purchase things like acai and empanadas - yum! Also fun to watch people playing volleyball and having fun on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Mice
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A nice beach with family and friends everywhere, creating a happy and enlightening environment. The surrounding areas are beautiful such as the mountains and hills. However too many people selling things and advertising their businesses, which is nice but some don't leave you alone which can be rather irritating.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beautiful stretch of sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A lovely place to spend a day. Beach vendors sell everything you could need (from sun cream and bikinis, hot food, beer, ice cream to children's toys). You need not move all day if you don't want to 😎👍🏻

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful scenery and people
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The pictures and reputation speak for themselves. It's a great beach and feels more authentic than Copacabana. Be a bit cautious in the sea though: patches of foamy contamination sometimes come floating along.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Of course you can't go to Rio without going to the beach. Ipanema is active and fun. A bit pricey, but it's all part of the experience. It was nice to watch the joggers, dogs, exercise maniacs and volley/football beach tournaments. Don't walk there unless there are many people walking about as I ran into trouble early in the morning (about 6:30am).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ipaema Beach is Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema Beach is less crowded and quieter than Copacabana.  If you want the "action" go to Copacabana.  Ipanema, however, is beautiful and you can surf, swim, play volley ball, etc.  Grand view of Two Brothers mountains.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice and beautiful view points on the rocks.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Views from the Morros at the beginning of the beach coming from Copacabana are great. Large places on the rocks to enjoy the sun and the views. But the beach is smaller than Copacabana and too crowdy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crowded body fest
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I personally thought Ipanema district is one of the blandest and dullest areas of Rio, not the real Rio and it is a shame too many people spend their entire time here at this place.Ipanema for me is just a place for vain people to show off their bodies. This is not necessarily a bad thing. Being serious, Ipanema is way safer than people say, as long as you keep an eye on your stuff you should be fine, but it is much more of a target than say Corcovado or Sugarloaf simply because its much more accessible (i.e. because its free). There's a better beach in Flamengo.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: You feel the music
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We just loved walking in Ipanema Beach and singing "garota from Ipanema"! The beach is as many others, but you just feel the music

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Super
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema beach is super nice. I love the sand the weather the Caipiroshka the sauted with garlic shrimp.... Everything

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The local's beach. With the usual beach sales "staff" selling rubbish. Nice waves and relaxed pace. If you are not looking for an "in" place to go, this is a good beach to start with. Ipanema also has a good variety of shops in the neighbourhood.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A place of renown
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We walked there from Copacabana. It was crowded on a Monday. A lovely beach with a matching atmosphere . The iconic place created by the song. Lots of girls to was but not all slim and tender.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very clean beach and close to the business center if you need to grab some food or withdraw cash. Quite a few cafes on the beach for cocktails and beer. You do pay for chairs and umbrellas from local vendors.  Gets very busy when its sunny, people jogging and tanning. Also a nice location to view the majestic sunset.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing and safe
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is Really Nice, and the best thing is that I felt safe. The brazilian people told me to visit this beach since it's the "nicer" beach, and that it's safer... if Your in Rio, visit this place 😍

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Much prettier and less crowded than Copacabana! Worth going to with uber, metro or taxi..You can rent bike everywhere, go for a run or just chill. The beach is clean and less crowded!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just as you'd imagine it to be
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, clean, lovely views. Just play the girl from inane a while you're there. Lots of beach cafes if you need a drink or coffee

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Hang gliders land here too
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is very nice and has a more personal feel being smaller and not so busy at Copacabana.  A bit further away from the main part of Rio but worth a visit

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The Best Beach in Rio.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Unfortunately many of the dream -like beaches are not particuarly clean to sit or swim on, we were told by the locals to come to Ipanema. I love this beach- it gives me life!! There is space to chill, play sports, swim, dance, whatever you want to do! Fab views of Sugar Loaf Mountains at sunset too. Beautiful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Favorite beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I've been around the world and yet, this is still my favorite beach. The scenery is amazing, living and attractive crowds, and across the street is the city. This beach really has it all. It's a must see when visiting Rio.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most IN beach in RIOOOO
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love Ipanema beach, always so IN! Beach with the most beautiful people in Rio, where fashion is in the air!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Had an amazing at Ipanema Beach. Its a beautiful place and not as dirty as I'd heard people saying. The water is kinda cold but Rio usually is a very hot place. There are always some people selling ice cream and some sort of snacks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Outstanding Urban Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Few cities have the choices beach lovers have in Rio. Leme, Copacabana, Arpoador, Ipanema, Leblon, and the list goes on as the traveler ventures further down the Coast. With regard to Ipanema, specifically, it tends to be less crowded than its next door rival Copacabana and perhaps a bit more family oriented. But, on any stretch of beach the size of Copacabana or Ipanema you are likely to find a great variety of people and diversions. Families meet at the same location on the beach they have frequented all their lives, friends know exactly where to find them. Currently, Ipanema beach has one of those seemingly never ending/never completed construction projects - a new kiosk being built near the Aropador end, but that only interferes with a small part of the overall beach. Always keep in mind that the sun in Rio is extremely strong, and going to the beach without sunscreen or blocking cream is inviting a painful and potentially unhealthy sunburn. Brasilian beach lovers have skin conditioned by many years of exposure to the sun, but even most of them still use sun protection of some style or degree.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bonito
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice side walk towards the ocean.Many many people, walking, jogging, riding bicycles, skateboarding, playing at the beach. Lovely sand and sun. Amazing just it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Surfing spot with great sunsets
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach, with lots of activities going on. If you are up for surfing, you can rent boards there or take a lesson (Arpoador part of the beach).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Super clean, not crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is awesome, it wasnt crowded at all, there were plenty of umbrellas and tables available. The view is amazing, and I love the rocks. By far my favorite beach in Sicily.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Iconic Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed in an apartment just 1 block from the beach. It was winter there, but very comfortable, 75 degrees. We swam and enjoyed the beach. There is a great running/biking path as well as a beautiful walkway between the beach and the road. You can even have a drink brought to you as you lie on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach for swimming in zona sul.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you are looking for a nice Beach not far from Zona Sul Rio, this is your best option. It's cleaner than the more famous Copacabana beach but also has same look and feel. You can buy souvenirs, swimsuits, drinks,  food Etc from the vendors on the beach and sidewalk.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Local beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Copacabana is crowded and is usually the first choice for the tourists. Ipanema is the local beach for the locals.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What can one say, really. This is, after all, Ipanema! The beach does look gorgeous; would have dove into the sea if I were 30 years younger. Perhaps coz it was a relatively cold day, there was not many people there even though it was a Sunday afternoon.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach, soft sand, clean water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our family enjoyed an afternoon here after spending the day before at Copacabana. This was more upscale with fewer people selling stuff. The shopping area is nicer as well.  The sand is so soft and the water was just gorgeous. Very strong current so need to keep kids close.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Superb!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: And very long!! A nice beach with all the typical stuff you can expect: locals offering food, drinks, and other things to rent or buy. Beautiful sand and overall clean. Not crowded at all in this season😎

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beware
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is one of the zones that is not very safe. We visited this zone during carnival, and I had an attempted pick pocket. Thankfully the kid didn't get anything. I had my money in a hidden pocket. The way the scam works is when you buy drinks at one of the vendors on the beach they watch where you get you cash from and watch where you put it away. Then they tell one of the local kids where the money is that you're holding. Stay in a large group when buying things, and don't be on the beach of the boardwalk at night.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Take your rubbish with you
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing beach lots to see and do nearby but please don't leave your rubbish on the beach! Strong currents in the waves so not always good for swing but great for a walk along, water is more calm near Arpoador which is a big rock outlet near one end of Ipanema and is better for swimming. Arpoador is a great place to visit just a few minutes walk down Ipanema beach and you can get some great pictures of the city and the beach from there. Parking along the beach can be hard to find and if you get a park it will cost $2 reals.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: In my opinion it's better than Copacabana ! What else it's a beach isn't it, great sand ... hum lovely lace to chill, sunbath and have a deep.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beach with classes,
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, lovely cafe, fun and active people are the attractions at Ipanema Beach. During day time, the beach is full of people in their beach activities: sports, sunbathing, ocean dipping. On the shore, rows of restaurants, cafe's and  bakeries catering all you need. You will fall in love with Ipanema.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Similar to Copa
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ipanema Beach is very similar to Copa but a little less touristy and not as much going on. We stayed here so obviously had a look

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There really is a girl from Ipanema! She is now in her 70s but still beautiful! Breaking waves, lots of beautiful people playing games,and scenery to die for. Islands breakup the horizon and to your right Sugar loaf..

reviews.title: Unforgettable
reviews.text: Wonderful by nature! Beautiful and a paradise!

reviews.title: Worth a walk
reviews.text: Ipanema seemed a bit smarter to us (as tourists) and we enjoyed our wander along about 3/4’s of it. Stopping off for a beer here and lunch there, it has a very relaxed vibe. The outdoors gym is amazing! Well used too.

reviews.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in Rio
reviews.text: The beach of Ipanema is a classic that really makes jus to fame. The shore is beautiful, well cared for and with an amazing view, perfect for walking, relaxing or simply enjoying the climate of Rio.The sea is usually great and the movement leaves the atmosphere lively, without losing its charm. There is good structure around, with kiosks, bars and easy access.It is a beach that likes both those who want quiet and those who like a little more agitated, and always delivers a very good experience.

reviews.title: RJ is a chapter apart!!
reviews.text: The beach this day, was stunningly wonderful! Caribbean Carioca! Crystalline water, little pool and as incredible as it may seem, little water.. Last sea bath of the year, unforgettable!

reviews.title: Same chaos
reviews.text: What are you doing going to Rio and not taking a bath in Ipanema? Difficult to reach the sea, but once there I assure you the chaos you will love! Hundreds of people like in Copacabana, next to each other, who rejoice throughout the day and make you feel good.

reviews.title: Highly recommended hotel
reviews.text: Great hotel, friendly, clean, varied international breakfast buffet with fresh produce, strategic location. On foot you can get to Ipanema and Copacabana beach is very close.Special thanks to Mila and Valeria in the breakfast room, kind and nice and Adriana room attendant always smiling also gave us many little tips to spend the holiday at its best and safely.Would definitely come back here if I were to return to Rio

reviews.title: Great place to be happy.
reviews.text: Amazingly positive vibrations throughout the day and night. Happy people with great smiles and samba vibes, spontaneous singing of romantically mesmerizing words.

reviews.title: Ipanema is beautiful
reviews.text: I think Ipanema is somehow in the imaginary of the Brazilian, and I who am quite skeptical found the beach wonderful!! Translucent sea, fine sand, beautiful view, an amazing sunset! And the vendors are wanderers or the stalls of drinks with prices that I found fairly pro local and are not boring and insistent

reviews.title: Famous by the song about the girl from this beach
reviews.text: [View from the Rio Samba Bus] The World Famous Ipanema Beach, made famous from the song, ' The Girl from Ipanema" is a top destination from a day at the beach, drinking, eating and shopping.

reviews.title: Also a beautiful beach
reviews.text: It's a little quieter here than on the Copacabana. I also found the beach bars more welcoming. Just let it drift here, too.

reviews.title: Nice to visit with your family
reviews.text: A clean beach, very busy a with many sporting activities and things to eat, I really liked it, would definitely return

reviews.title: Praia Ipanema 🏝️
reviews.text: One of my favorite beaches in the world. An excellent vibe and beautiful landscape. You just have to be careful with your belongings and when buying something on the beach, everything can be paid in cash, cards or PIX.

reviews.title: Alternative to Copacabana
reviews.text: A beautiful beach in Rio that is not as wide as the Copacabana. Surfers have a nice spot here. If you are in Rio is definitely worth seeing. The bars and merchants are comparable to those on the Copacabana.Atmosphere: very goodCleanliness: goodPrice/performance: goodA clear recommendation

reviews.title: Relax yes, but always keep a watchful eye
reviews.text: Definitely a little better, like the beach section on the Copacabana, a little cleaner and not so many homeless. Of course, there are traders who are annoying here too, but you can safely dismiss them.An excavator is used here and there, as the surf pushes the sand partially into the channels. reviews.title: A Must-Visit Iconic Beach in Rio!
reviews.text: Ipanema Beach is everything I dreamed it would be—and more! The stunning stretch of golden sand, vibrant atmosphere, and breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains make it an unforgettable destination. The energy here is incredible, with a perfect mix of locals and tourists enjoying the sun, sea, and fun.The beach is impeccably clean, and the turquoise waters are ideal for swimming, though the waves can be a bit strong, so it’s great for surfers too. What I loved most was how lively and diverse Ipanema is—you can relax, play beach volleyball, or join in a game of futebol with locals.The nearby kiosks serve fresh coconut water and local snacks, and there's always music in the air, adding to the fun and relaxing vibe. Plus, watching the sunset behind the Dois Irmãos mountains is truly magical—it’s a moment you won’t forget.Ipanema Beach is also well-connected, with plenty of restaurants, bars, and shops just a short walk away. Whether you’re looking for a place to unwind or join the local beach culture, Ipanema offers a little bit of everything. It's a must-visit for anyone coming to Rio!

reviews.title: Imagine Becoming Part of a Bossa Nova Song. It's Like That.
reviews.text: Lounging during the day at Ipanema Beach allowed me to "feel" what Bossa Nova sounds like. The warm tropical breeze gently wafted over us as we sipped caipirinhas (without sugar) for hours, soaking up the sun. It was a time when I felt fortunate to be from the USA, as the dollar goes a long way in Rio. We went to Baraca Sonja (I hope I spelled that right) each day, and they treated us like royalty, carrying umbrellas, chairs, and towels to our preferred spot on the beach, coming by to check on us regularly, allowing us to get refills on our caipirinhas (I learned one phrase in Portuguese to ensure my drinks weren't too sweet: "sem açúcar, por favor"). We would stuble back to our rented apartment positioned perfectly between Ipanema and Copacabana Beaches intent on getting ready for dinner, we'd pass out from the hours of sun and caipirinhas, wake up around 11 p.m., and then it was the perfect time to go out and eat on Brazil time. This was all during Carnaval week in Rio, so it was incredibly lively. Paradise. I would go back again and again.

reviews.text: Excellent beautiful country beautiful people remain very preserved colonial architectureThe men are beautiful, the beach is very nice and very well maintained, the food is very affordable and of good quality, the accommodation is excellent.

reviews.title: Wonderful place!
reviews.text: Wonderful place! We enjoyed the beach in the late afternoon one day and the next we cycled along the coast. The sunset is a spectacle in itself. Take the opportunity to have a mate on the beach and eat a Globo cookie. Well policed beach. But it's worth being very careful with your belongings. Mainly cell phones. On Sunday the seaside streets are closed and you can make the most of the space.

reviews.title: Love it here!
reviews.text: I love this beach and the energy it radiates. Breathtaking sunset. Simply amazing! (: Must visit!

reviews.title: Gorgeous white sand beach
reviews.text: Made famous by Frank Sinatra's beautiful song "The Girl from Ipanema", Ipanema is a beautiful white sand beach where you can sunbathe, play beach volleyball or swim with a view of Sugarloaf Mountain.

reviews.title: Fantastic place
reviews.text: Ipanema beach is like all the beaches in Rio, a long strip of very fine sand with a splendid sea but if it is large it prevents swimming. At the weekend it is packed with people with a display of sellers of everything.

reviews.title: Ipanema beach
reviews.text: It's a wonderful view, in a wonderful city. Friends from RS: the sand is soft and there is no chocolate in RJ. Simple and direct: It's beautiful. I ate some corn and drank a mate ala Larissa Manoela. It was a cloudy day, but that didn't stop us from enjoying the BEAUTY of this beach. As a toast, I saw Renato Gaúcho playing a footvolley, quite well.

reviews.title: Best sunset!
reviews.text: The end of the day was incredible and we were treated to this wonder of twilight, what a wonderful energy!

reviews.title: golden sands
reviews.text: Stunning beach , which we had the fortune to have a hotel looking over  every day and night. Its more quite than Cococabana beach a few places to eat and drink near by , and lovely for a walk along the beach or walkway, floodlit at night for volley ball and football . people actually on this beach running and doing exercise very early in the morning.

reviews.title: Not so great
reviews.text: After visiting the hippie market, I wanted to spend a relaxing afternoon here. Unfortunately, I didn't like the beach very much. Lots of stones and the waves brought a lot of rubbish to the beach. I wouldn't recommend it

reviews.title: Many nice waves seen.
reviews.text: Nice beach; with many waves like the entire coast of Rio de Janeiro. Beach service at a cost of $8 for 2 chairs and an umbrella daily. Many food stalls on the beach. Pleasant atmosphere; quite safe.

reviews.title: Alright
reviews.text: very pretty beach, much less people than at copacabana and much fewer touts which is pleasant. equipped with sports structures.

reviews.title: Brazil......we have to go back
reviews.text: The warmth of the Brazilians, the beaches, the weather... they are always happy. You always have to come back. Unique and unmissable destination. Best time in February for the carnival.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach and ideal for swimming
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, and very nice for swimming as there are no high waves.Ideal for walking and with many options of kiosks and restaurants.

reviews.title: Excellent beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. Wide white sand. The water beautiful, fresh and transparent. Some important waves

reviews.title: It's great to walk in the morning
reviews.text: I’m a morning person and I walk there early in the morning; apart from the zodiacs and surfers, there aren’t really any people there, the merchants haven’t become particularly active yet, and you can calmly chill, run or read a book. It’s probably busier during the day, but as a social phobe I just don’t come during rush hours

reviews.title: Beautiful and quiet
reviews.text: We did it running, it is windy and bathing may not be as appealing. The atmosphere is more residential. It is presided over by the statue of Tom Jobim, so you have to go. Authentic river.

reviews.title: In love with Ipanema
reviews.text: The best place in Rio to stay. Near Leblon, Barra, Copacabana, the center, Cristo. All. We had already stopped in Copacabana but Ipanema is the place.

reviews.title: Unique
reviews.text: Unique beach, completely free, surrounded by unique views in the world. They offer you drinks, umbrellas, deckchairs, fish skewers and ice creams for a few royalties.

reviews.title: The coconut water, the environment, the smell, the girl from Ipanema will come back one day
reviews.text: I loved it Great spot for a beautiful sunset and the spectacular spirit, the bars and the great joy of the people of Rio de Janeiro, the wonderful city

reviews.title: The Paradise!
reviews.text: River as always of the Best!The beach is UNIQUE!I would return a thousand times!The city is beautiful, the people are nice, the Night is amazing!

reviews.title: A nice city beach
reviews.text: This is a lovely city beach, nicer than Copacabana as it is less busy (still really busy though). Sea is a bit rough and no swimming zones so take care if you enter. Lots of people selling things. Sunbeds or space to relax on the sand. Very pretty with the sea, beach and mountain backdrop, quite unusual.

reviews.title: Practically by the sea
reviews.text: Excellent Taranto-style mussels, spicy at the right point and super fish starter on a cool terrace by the sea

reviews.title: No visit to Rio is complete without a visit here
reviews.text: No visit to Rio is complete without at least one afternoon on the beach at Ipanema. The one where the girl's from is a feast for the eyes. the glorious two brothers mountains to the west and the rocky outcrop of Arpoador luring sunset viewers to its east frame a paradise, conveniently labeled for your taste. Each kilometer has a numbered lifeguard stand: posto 8 is more families, posto 9 has the boys that generally arent interested in the girls from Ipanema, further up you'll find lots of football circles etc.Ipanema's not as developed as Copacabana so don't expect a zillion fast restaurants but there are enough kiosques plus folks strolling the beach hawking drinks and snacks so that you don't need to lug it all with you. Likewise chair and umbrella rentals are inexpensive.The biggest surprise you'll get is when you decide to cool off by taking a dip. The water is cold!

reviews.title: Outstanding food, views, and service! Alex was fantastic!
reviews.text: We had an absolutely outstanding dinner at Ipanema. In fact, it was so great we ate there twice in our short west end stay. Alan was our server, and his attitude was fantastic. He made it a fun experience. Our table was out on the patio, and the views cannot be surpassed elsewhere. The food was spectacular, and the sunset was amazing. Thank you Alex! We'll be back!

reviews.title: Ipanema beach is still beautiful!
reviews.text: RIO DE JANEIRO - I was a little worried about safety, but the beach was clean and well maintained and quite crowded considering it was a weekday. Near Posto 8, a craft fair became an attraction due to the excellent quality of the products. Some great restaurants on the coast and in Arpoador the excellent ARP, which is the only beach on that stretch.

reviews.title: A Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: An excellent beach for relaxing or for engaging in beach sports. We arrived around 10am and it was not busy. The beach had been cleaned so that there was no rubbish or seaweed to be seen. There were a number of ‘Pop Up’ bars close by, not to mention the many beach sellers who will approach you, but leave when you say NO!We did make some purchases of Sunglasses, sweetcorn and drinks. I had the best ever Pina Colada in a pineapple followed by a massage on the beach. A lovely beach which has so much to offer and more preferable than Copacabana beach!

reviews.title: Mythical !!!
reviews.text: Mythical and pleasant beach.Fewer people than in Copacabana.Recommendation for cabin 65, run by a Frenchman who will recommend places in Rio and tell you about his Carioca experience.

reviews.title: Ipanema beach
reviews.text: beautiful beach. wide. to settle in and enjoy. Like all beaches, it has inns with toilets. Very nice to explore the coast on foot or by bicycle

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: The promenade provides a lovely walk and the beach itself starts off narrow at the Arpoador and widens a lot as you head towards Leblon.  Not as busy as Copacabana but still busy enough.

reviews.title: Beautiful beah
reviews.text: Amazing scenario with sea, mountains and at sunny days a kind of sun light that is unique at Rio de Janeiro

reviews.title: THE GIRL FROM IPANEMA BEACH
reviews.text: Lovely beach. Food available. But we're from south Florida, which has miles upon miles of beautiful beaches. We came here because of the song about the girl from Ipanema.

reviews.title: Well it would be rude to not visit…..
reviews.text: Well it would be rude not to visit after hearing it in a song from when I was a child. Clean looking with nice pedestrian walkway next to it. It was great watching all the hand-gliders making there way down from the mountain.Sadly we didn’t stop long as we were part of a group.

reviews.title: Best beach in the world ?
reviews.text: Safe , beautiful. Nice hot dogs . Relax on the beach and drink milk from a coconut with the best scenery imaginable

reviews.title: Tour group stop
reviews.text: We visited this beach on our tour with Do Brazil Right. We did not swim, just took a walk along the promenade, and stopped in a few shops along the way. If we had more time and were staying in Rio longer, we would have planned a beach day.

reviews.title: The one in the song
reviews.text: We stopped here as it was made famous by the song. There are so many famous beaches most beaches in the area are well maintained. You could spend a day here just people watching.

reviews.title: Top beach in the whole world
reviews.text: The Beach i quite famous world wide, but that is not fair enough. Ipanema beach is not only beautiful, but exiting with strong waves, clear water and pleasant temperature.I would classify it as the best beach in the world.I lived for a year  2 blocks away from the beach in 1962-63. Nothing much has changed, it is the still the best beach I have been to.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: A much quieter beach than Copa Cobana.  We visited here only once and found it very relaxing.  Again the sea was quite rough and not swimmable for some. Some great views and back drops from the beach.  Beautiful.

reviews.title: Famous beach
reviews.text: See this world famous beach.  You can also see the bar where the song "The Girl from Ipanema" was written.

reviews.title: Trip to Brasil
reviews.text: Great trip-rained a lot in Rio but Salvador was perfect. Great food good place to stay & some interesting places to visit. Took Ubers everywhere & they were easy & reasonable price.

reviews.title: Iconic beachfront
reviews.text: The beach is narrower than expected but still presents as a must see. Avoid Sunday and Bank Holiday for crowds. Sellers edge the sand. Iconic name so this beach is always popular. Go early or later in the day.

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: Great beach to visit. Lots of food options and space to lounge. Personally found it better than the more famous Copacabana beach

reviews.title: Narrower than Copacabana, but seemingly a bit more ‘up market’.
reviews.text: My hotel overlooked Copacabana, so I preferred there. It’s bigger - longer, deeper, spacious, less crowded.

reviews.title: A walk on the beach!
reviews.text: We walked from our hotel on Copacabana all the way to the far end of Ipanema - it was perfect!  Since it was a weekend the beach was packed but the colorful umbrellas and people watching only made it better!

reviews.title: Nice Walk!
reviews.text: We stopped at this beach at the end of one of the day tours. It was a great experience, but found it crowded.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: This has to be in the top 3 beaches I have ever visited. Clean, an abundance of beach facilities - food, chairs, umbrellas etc, and all reasonably priced.

reviews.title: Best Beach in Rio!
reviews.text: We had visit multiple beaches in Rio de Janeiro. But, no doubt Ipanema was the best. Beautiful view of the mountains, blue water. And friendly staff selling caipirinhas!

reviews.title: Non-stop Entertainment
reviews.text: I have to say I prefer Impanema to Copa because the water is closer and the footpath is higher over the beach giving you a better view.  Most of the action is at the Arproador end with market stalls, food and drink and the outdoor gym.  The sunset can be watched from most of the beach and there is also some nice little spots with great views going up the hill at the other end. Of course volley ball is played all along the beach as well.

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Ipanema is my favorite neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro! It has a lot of commerce, restaurants, fun bars and of course - the gorgeous Ipanema Beach! Make sure to scroll the calçadão and have a cold coconut water!

reviews.title: Ipanema Beach visit
reviews.text: Great beach with a large rock formation that you can climb. Water is clean and many vendors to provide chairs and umbrella.

reviews.title: Disappointing rip off
reviews.text: What a disappointment. Sand and water are dirty. The vendor sellers harass you non stop and are thieves. One agreed to sell me something for a price. When I gave him that size bill he demanded double the price. I refused and he threw something at me. These are average beaches with overinflated reputations. And Al the goods and services are USA and Europe prices.  Skip it.

reviews.title: Very clean, but sea can be treacherous
reviews.text: Very clean and well served. Beware of the sea that can be rough sometimes. There were two instances that the lifeguard helicopter and Seadoos had to intervene to save two bathers.

reviews.title: More local, very fun!
reviews.text: Roaming both Ipanema and Copacabana, this seems to be the more 'local' beach with significantly more exercise opportunities and more focused foot volleyball, regular volleyball, beach tennis and general exercise being the main action.  A lot of fun to stroll and enjoy!!

reviews.title: Stay for the sunset!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with stunning panoramic views of the mountainous shoreline. If you're going during the busy summer months, be sure to get there early and grab your spot. Beach starts filling up quickly, early in the morning. Also, you CANNOT miss the sunset each night. Breathtaking. Also, if you're looking for some fun waves to swim in, this is your beach. Bigger waves than I was expecting, which I loved!

reviews.title: Good beach
reviews.text: Nice beach to go to on your visit to Rio, I personally prefer Copacobana as it's nto as windy as Ipanema.

reviews.title: Great Beach..hum the tune!
reviews.text: A very Brazilian stretch of great sand and water.  It is part of a long stretch of beaches, Ipanema is in the middle.

reviews.title: Ipanema beach is close to Copacabana
reviews.text: Although Ipanema beach is very close to Copacabana (only Arpoador is between them, the view is completely different... but also very nice

reviews.title: We all know the song
reviews.text: What trip to Rio is complete without this beach? A beautiful beach with a more laid back vibe. Also the point is the local surf spot with some decent breaks that reminded me of Santa Cruz CA.  Even though we stayed near the Copacabana we had to go here.

reviews.title: Very good!
reviews.text: Our hotel is right in front of this really nice and popular beach so we thought it would be nice to go. It’s a really lovely beach and the water is a gorgeous blue/turquoise color! Certain parts of the beach don’t smell very nice.

reviews.title: Dangerous in the evening
reviews.text: !danger! Do not walk here in the dark, 2 guys tried to rob my girlfriend and myself at 22:00 pm today.

reviews.title: A must go to beach
reviews.text: Loved this beach, amazing, chilled, lots of families and fantastic views! Totally recommend this location during your Rio visit!

reviews.title: borning, no good food
reviews.text: We went there a couple of times, but there were bit many people and places to eat and drink. Also less people but way more boring.

reviews.title: Definitely the safest beach in Rio
reviews.text: We visited a few beaches in Rio de Janeiro, but we found Ipanema the safest and most tourist friendly. The beach sellers seem a little more polite and less intrusive. Beautiful sunsets, quieter than cobacabana settings.
I had a great time in Brazil Rio de Janeiro I injoy the cruses and the boats ride, and the beaches and sight seeing was nice I would like to return someday

reviews.title: Good but place is dirty.
reviews.text: The sea was lovely, big waves and lively vibe. It's just disappointing how you see people just leave trash everywhere and the beach is littered. Bins are provided but they need to step up and take care of this beautiful place. Plastic getting washed out to the waters. It's a disaster in the making.

reviews.title: Copa is better
reviews.text: Worth only a little walk just to see a new place but i don't see any value added on this beach compared to Copa

reviews.title: Beech beautifull
reviews.text: Beautifull city filled with colors and peeople. Really cool place. Amazing experience like no other placed I go to. Very interesting! A place where you are feeling welcome. Food close is good to ate.

reviews.title: Amazing views - hard to enjoy with so many street vendors
reviews.text: If you can find a patch on the beach to relax - Tops, how ever it gets a little tiring having to constantly say "Noa abrigado" every few minutes for hats, sunglasses, wrist bands etc.Don't get me wrong, I love the availability of someone selling cold beer on the beach and hot chips etc but sometimes I just want to relax in the sun.Also the surf always seems to be very rough not sure if its a safe beach to swim?All and all, still a nice place to sit and relax

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: Really cool. Amazing experience like no other. Very interesting! A place where you are always welcome

reviews.title: The best beach
reviews.text: Ipanema is much cleaner and quieter than Copacabana. I do not know if the lodging is comparable but suspect it is.

reviews.title: Super Fun
reviews.text: Hard to go wrong with some of the best looking people on the planet running around half naked lol   When in Rio stay away from the sketchy Copacabana Beach and spend time in Ipanema and Leblon.

reviews.title: Loved this
reviews.text: Our hotel was right on the beach rood.  We loved walking this beach and seeing the view of the brothers (?) mountains.

reviews.title: Tasha
reviews.text: Tasha at the front desk made our experience delightful. Even on her first day working she had a great attitude and accommodated  out needs.

reviews.title: Great Beach & Best Sunset
reviews.text: Best Beach, clean water, nice people, white sand and the best sunset of my life! Ipanema beach is one of my favorite spot in Rio

reviews.title: Posto 9
reviews.text: Posto 9 barraca de Sonia will look after you go enjoy with the beautiful beach people. Busy at weekends and in the summertime

reviews.title: Less hectic than Copacabana beach
reviews.text: Clear sand nice waves and beautiful people walking along the beach. Many activities to do alone the road. Also the sales people are not pushy.

reviews.title: Wonderful beach!
reviews.text: Wonderful beach. Light thin sand. Scenery just lovely on both sides. Great for a walk, not to long. A much if you are in RJ, even if just for a quick weekend.

reviews.title: Beats Copacabana 10-1
reviews.text: Ipanema beach is much more beautiful, quiet and safe than Copacabana. The neighborhood is full of beautiful places to walk, eat or have a drink.

reviews.title: Place to be
reviews.text: We had wanted to see the myth of Ipanéma and copacabanna beach, we had been able to see the very beautiful girls and the very beautiful Brazilian boys, so muscular and so tanned

reviews.title: Beautiful and relax
reviews.text: My preference versus Capacobana, much quiet, better waves, lots of nice beach bars, relaxing atmosphere.

reviews.title: Overrated ...
reviews.text: One of the many beaches.   Not particular special or better than the others.  Go for a walk, enjoy all the sports

reviews.title: Dangerous-do not bring any belongs!
reviews.text: Definitely not what they see it is. Went there on a January weekend and it was busy! You couldn’t even walk. There was a very dangerous feel to it as people were hawk eying me left and right. 3 kids tried to tackle me and steel my phone. Beach isn’t so clean. I could have went on the wrong time but I definitely would only go to copacabana beach as it is much better if you are staying in that area. LEAVE ALL BELONGINGS IN ROOM.

reviews.title: Boardwalk fun
reviews.text: This is the beach to visit just before sunset if you're lucky enough to get an evening that isn't raining. we had to try on several occasions before we finally saw what all the fuss was about. And yes it's worth it.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach 🌺 😎
reviews.text: It's next to Copacabana less crowded Monday...beach full when Saturday and Sunday, beautiful Sunday visible in the area

reviews.title: Go Becuase you must ! But only once !
reviews.text: This is the height of overpriced tourist Brazil, Of course you must go, but dont expect anything other than a tiourist overpriced experience! If you want the real Brazil spend £15 on uber and go to Barra or Recreio, see the real Brazil and get you taxi fare back on the cost of the first 4 Beers ! Also if  a weekend you will see the beautiful, young people of legend, which you will not at Ipamena!

reviews.title: Crowded but beautiful beach
reviews.text: Get a caipirinha and enjoy the sunset! I also enjoyed a morning walk on the beach with less crowds. Keep close track of your surroundings. I was taking lots of photos up on the boardwalk and someone I had pegged earlier as a shady character came up close to me from behind and I think was making an attempt at my bag but I had already turned. Basically just be hyper aware of your surroundings and trust your instincts. I was taking photos with a camera as a solo female so prime target. I felt very comfortable down on the beach. The views are just amazing. I preferred Ipanema to Copacabana for the views.

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: Nice beach with plenty of food venues within a few blocks of the beach and wonderful place to walk after a good meal

reviews.title: Stay in Rio
reviews.text: What a beautiful day from a distance but the beach itself is very filthy and the water area is polluted and terrible

reviews.title: Many sun
reviews.text: Sea very cal, restaurants goods, special site, sea very fresh, foods trucks, city calm, people funny.

reviews.title: White Sand
reviews.text: Great beach to chill out in the sunshine for a few hours.  The is an abundant supply of food and drinks from the many street vendors walking alone the beach.Keep you bags close and don’t leave anything unattended. Try the many bars, which offer a great selection of food and drinks.

reviews.title: Beautiful Water
reviews.text: This beach to me is prettier than Copacabana but I was unable to really enjoy it because it's always jammed pack! Due to Covid, I stayed away from the large crowds and just walked by.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, great crowd and wonderful scenery.  This is the best beach in Rio in my opinion. The beach is surrounded by mountains where you can watch the beautiful sunset. Also, plenty of vendors with food and beverages including alcoholic beverages. It also has food ve do that walk the beach along with outdoor bars/restaurants on the beach. Great place to spend your days.

reviews.title: One of the Better Beaches
reviews.text: This is a much nicer and cleaner beach than Copacabana. I don't understand why it isn't more famous but I guess Copacabana has a song about the hotel so it gets more publicity. Most of the ex-pat community and locals will tell you this is a great area to visit and stay in if you can find a place. I recommend it as a beach you should visit while in Rio.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, beautiful Brasil
reviews.text: I loved this beach! It wasn’t that crowded in the morning when I visited. The waves and sunlight were perfect. ☀️

reviews.title: Melhor lugar do mundo
reviews.text: What can I say about Ipanema beach ? Been there ally life and will be to the remainder ofit. Beautiful setting, amazing city vibe.

reviews.title: Ipanema!
reviews.text: I loved this beach, all types of people gather here, people exercising, volleyball, food and drink stalls and vendors passing by, chairs are hired for the day

reviews.title: Beautiful Ipanema!
reviews.text: We had some wild waves one of the days we visited here. Beautiful beach with whiter sands than the Copacabana, but only around the corner! This beach leads straight into Leblon Beach. You have the Copacabana not far, only around the corner and Leblon Beach on the other side.There are cycle lane's the whole length of this beach from both directions and you can rent scooter or bikes. Its a great way to see the beach if your not a sit on the beach person.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Amazing urban beach. Clean and very nice. Great views. Safe specially in the morning. Kids loved it. Posto 9 or 10

reviews.title: A real surprise
reviews.text: Walked along the expanse and have picked where I will be staying on my return. So much better and cleaner than Cococabana.

reviews.title: Beautiful nice beach big waves 🌊
reviews.text: There are lots of selling drinks caipirinha , coconut,there's a lots of people so extra careful of your belongings, and yes the beach so beautiful to swim 👙 just big waves 🌊 beautiful beach indeed 🥰

reviews.title: Quiet little gem
reviews.text: Slightly posher than the touristy coco beach and quieter too . Nice but if piece and quiet while watching the gliders land on the end of the beach .

reviews.title: Our dream
reviews.text: We had wanted to come to this beautiful beach for a long time, everything was clean, nice sporty atmosphere, few foreign tourists

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
