reviews.text: This is a truly lovely beach.  Crowded but not quite so much as Copa Cabana Beach.  Both beaches are beautiful.

reviews.title: Famous beach of rio de Janeiro.
reviews.text: An emblematic place in Rio de Janeiro, the beach is beautiful, I loved it, always warm water with large beaches, lots of people at all times, very safe and clean, 100% recommended to visit it.

reviews.title: best beach of Rio
reviews.text: calmer than Copacabana, classier and in my opinion nicer, with lovely restaurants within 5 min walk.

reviews.title: Clean and Beautiful
reviews.text: Loved coming to this beach early in the morning when it is quieter and all you hear is the sound of the waves against the sand. It was nice taking a stroll along the beach while watching people taking their dogs out for a run on the beach. The sand is so fine and cool to the feet in the morning. And you ca see a mountain on the right hand side of the beach.

reviews.title: Clean and clear
reviews.text: The beach is very nice and white with lots of tourists and people creating sand statues.  Interesting place to visit.

reviews.title: My kinda place
reviews.text: Oh the beaches, the sunsets, the boys playing soccer, the music... so many cute boutique stores and beautiful bars... Live bossa nova and other music... Ipanema is totally my kind of place. Love love love it.

reviews.title: Girl(s) of Ipanema
reviews.text: Ipanema and Leblon are the top level areas of Rio. The view on the Two Brothers Hills is a dream. Strictly obey the swimming signals flags. The ocean is dangerous with currents very close to the seashore. The small snacks alont the beach are very pleasent for a snack or a fresh coconut if not a caipirinha or beer. They are more expensive than inland places because of their location. Very early in the morning (thanks jetlag), children under 5, barefoot, train to play football with their coach. Amazing. Beware pickpockets. Bring minimum staff on the beach. Absolutely no jewelry !!!!

reviews.title: Massive beach
reviews.text: Very clean beach, lots of umbrella and chair renters, very crowded at the weekend. Lots of surfing to watch

reviews.title: one of the many beaches
reviews.text: I can see that this beach is just as popular as any of the others in Rio. We had a nice Promenade to walk by and enjoy the sights. We were not prepared to go swimming that day but there were many people taking advantage .

reviews.title: Take me back to Ipanema
reviews.text: Worthy of its fame, the beautiful people, the gorgeous water, the view, and in general the Rio de Janeiro experience. This was my favorite beach in all of Rio. You truly feel like you are there in all its surreal appeal the incredible city of Rio de Janeiro.

reviews.title: Ipanema is classy and clean !
reviews.text: Ipanema beach is a classy and upscale beach in Rio . It is smaller than Copa but we liked it better because of the upscale ambience . Loved Ipanema !!

reviews.title: Nice Clean Beach
reviews.text: I found this beach very clean. It was very busy but still enjoyable. Convenient location. Lots of showers to clean off afterwards.

reviews.title: Another beach on my list
reviews.text: It stretches for miles and very well used.As you see in magazines and holiday brouchers volleyball,football in abundance being played and there are plenty cafes on the front to watch them perform with a nice cold beer and good food.lots of local wares being sold along the sea front at knockdown prices.

reviews.title: Beautiful sunsets
reviews.text: Walked the beach which was very crowded.  Sat on the rocks to take pictures and view the sunset over the mountains.  Judging by the number of people sitting with us, this is a popular time to visit the beach.

reviews.title: Good beach, lots of space to chill.
reviews.text: Good beach, lots of space to chill. Too much vendors that are always shouting to sell their goods, I understand they need to make a living, so this is an observation not a judgement. Water was cool and the waves are medium. Lots of beach activities and beautiful people.

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach
reviews.text: I was unprepared for the beauty of this beach. Be sure to wander toward the north end, and climb the rocks to get a great view in both directions. I was not expecting to see cactus that was taller than I. It is a gorgeous complement to the pure white sand.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: The lesser known Ipanema to Copacabana. Just as lovely - probably better swimming as in not getting thrown around by the waves. Best place to watch the sun go down in one of the beach bars. The sand is stunning - clean and white. We felt really safe and walked along the shoreline at 11 pmLoved Rio’s beaches 👍👍

reviews.title: Went to Rio.......
reviews.text: ........and didn't go to Ipanema Beach?? NOOO. This would be a travesty. We enjoyed the cool waters and the warm beach. Lots to see. We took the metro to the station that was pretty much equidistant from Ipanema and Copacabana. Two beaches for one metro ride!  Highly Recommended

reviews.title: Ipanema Beach
reviews.text: My favourite beach in Rio. Cheap and easy to get a taxi to take and collect after a few hours on the beach. Chairs and umbrellas very reasonable, with friendly sellers.  Not pushy but helpful. We didn’t pay til we left the beach. Beautiful clean beach and shallows in front of the choppy sea. A much less crowded beach than Copacabana.

reviews.title: Fantastic beach
reviews.text: Ipanema beach is smaller than Copacabana and the surf a little more gentle. - but care still needed and many lifeguards there to keep you safe. Lots of chiringuitos on beach with food/drink/ deck chairs. Lots of  beach vendors too but all good spirited and none too pushy. An amazing  each to visit.

reviews.title: Best urban beach in the world
reviews.text: Staying at Posto 9, excellent position and one of the most spectacular views in the world. Here the water is crystal clear and it’s like swimming in remote Bahia... incredible views of two sisters mountains

reviews.title: Whats to say!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, beautiful landscape and beautiful people. A lovely wide promanade and several bars and eateries so you can sit and watch a game of volleyball or simply watch the world go by. Less busy than Copacabana. The whole area is more upmarket with some excellent shops nearby. Perfectly safe.

reviews.title: Probably brililant in the '60's
reviews.text: Well you have to visit Ipanema if you come to Rio! The song we've all listened to since the 1960's make it compulsory and in truth it would probably have been a fabulous experience had we not been unfortunate enough to visit on one of the few periods where the weather was, not to put too fine a point on it, rubbish! I'm sure that the beach and the whole area comes alive and shines when the sun is also shining but on a very overcast and muggy day sadly, you see that this is an area that peaked in popularity in the '60's and the architecture hasn't changed much since then. However, only the weather was disappointing and it was still a great experience to walk along the promenade and dip our toes in the ocean as we walked along the beach.

reviews.title: Brazil
reviews.text: Little more action here.  Beautiful, clean.  Places to eat shop.  Volleyball all aroundTake a walk enjoy the weather

reviews.title: Beach front
reviews.text: While we did not get out of the van, we drove past the famed Ipanema Beach.  We were in Rio during Carnaval, and the beachfront was extremely crowded with dancing, singing and beach goers.   Plenty of food and drink available.

reviews.title: Beach is beach is beach is beach
reviews.text: Spent more time day before on Copacabana beach but went to ipanema 2nd day. Overcast, so lots less beachy things going on. Still, if you were blindfolded and unmasked here or at Coba or Leblon(?) beaches could you really tell the difference? Nearby shopping a bit more upscale, maybe???

reviews.title: Nice but prefer Copacabana
reviews.text: The beach is great and would probably look amazing if not so close to Copacabana. Compared to Copacabana it feels narrower and more congested. It also feels a bit less safe. Visually thought it's still an amazing beach!

reviews.title: Amazing Beach, but a little more crowded than Copacabana
reviews.text: Ipanema had a different feel than Copacabana. Initially, it seemed more upscale. We walked the beach for a while and took some pictures. We sent a picture to my mom because she likes the song “Girl From Ipanema”. There were lots of street vendors and lots of people around. Ipanema Beach isn’t as deep as Copacabana so it seems like it is more crowded. Before going to Brazil, I read that Copacabana was more rowdy that Ipanema but we felt it was the other way around. There were a lot of young people drinking and being very loud. We preferred Copacabana and were glad we chose a hotel there.

reviews.title: Wonderful beach
reviews.text: This beach is recomended for surfing. Some place are dangerous for little childrens. It’s difficult find a public shower

reviews.title: Ipanema Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful view, the way they design the floor it's great. Believe it or not the best time to visit is in the evening and night because the parties never stop. If you want to have fun visit at night you will not regret it .

reviews.title: Xx
reviews.text: The famous beach Ipanema do continuing great. Clean beach and water. Welcoming atmosphere. The view from beach excellent

reviews.title: Another great Beach
reviews.text: Ipanama beach is a beautiful beach. It’s a little quieter than Copacabana beach. A lot of things happen in the evening here. When I was there they had a stage and in the evening there was a big beach party. It was a lot of fun and there was police everywhere to keep it secure. Highly recommended to visit. I have now fallen in love with Brazil and would return in a heartbeat.

reviews.title: Overcrowded so not very pleasant
reviews.text: I was staying at Copacabana and I heard this beach was much nicer so I decided to visit for a change of scenery. However I found this beach to a lot busier with just too many people for my liking. Although you do get wonderful views of the two brothers in the background. I did return on a cloudy day and the difference was huge and then it was pleasant to walk along the prom. From my point of view I just thought there was more going on in Copacabana.

reviews.title: Big powerful waves
reviews.text: This I think is more a surfers beach due to the more powerful waves. Here we saw lifeguards,  that to me is an indication of powerful water. Walk up along the prom. It is busy with local artists selling their wares.  It is smaller than Cocacoba. It is still a must do.

reviews.title: Lovely Walk
reviews.text: For us this was a really lovely walk, it was a lovely day and the beach is beautiful, scenery very attractive, the red flag was flying whilst we were there so people were only paddling, there are nice little snack bars and public conveniences all the way along, you cannot walk directly from Copacabana beach to Ipanema beach, you need to take a little detour to the right, and then left, we cut through a little park, not the best of ideas given the recent rain, but I am sure there is a road a little further up that takes you there as well. Note: I am a slow walker and for us to walk both ways it took about two and a half to three hours.

reviews.title: Nice beach but not much else
reviews.text: This is a nice beach, but you do get some hassle from the locals trying to sell you goods.  There is not much else to do here apart from sunbathe.

reviews.title: Our favourite
reviews.text: Very nice beach with amazing views. Very busy with people and vendors. Nice sand, ocean and surrounding scenery

reviews.title: Lovely sandy beach but ugly metal fences protecting the flora - disappointing
reviews.text: We walked 2 miles along this beach which would have been lovely if it were not for the metal fences around the flora along the length of the beach. Really ruined the walk.

reviews.title: Ipanema Beach
reviews.text: Just like in many pictures, Ipanema Beach in Rio De Janeiro is a beautiful white sand beach.  Even in the rain, it was lovely.

reviews.title: Popular  beach
reviews.text: Like all of Rio breaches, this is a popular nice beach, lots of charrs and umbrellas to hire out.  Big waves and lots of vendors trying too sell you everything.

reviews.title: Best beach in the world
reviews.text: It's been said "as a joke" that if a couple travels to Rio de Janeiro they will end up in divorce haha...the perception by many who have never traveled to Brazil is that the woman are so beautiful and drop dead gorgeous that the guys can't stop drooling. Well that may be true however no-one mentions that most of the men at those very same beaches (posto 8, 9, 10, 11) are equally perfectly sculptured and perfectly manicured from top to bottom. So yes, my point is there's eye candy for everyone :-) Tip: if you are in a relationship where either one or both partners are extremely jealous, possessive and insecure, then maybe Brazil is not for you 😂Anyway, Ipanema beach is my favourite when compared to Copacabana. Take nothing away from Copacabana beach as I enjoy it too but I do feel a little safer at Ipanema beach and let's be honest, it so much sexier. Ipanema beach is well known for where all the "who's who" in Rio go to and all the hottest and sexiest men, woman and celebrities hang out. Just be careful to not go with your valuables to the beach or leave them unattended as crime unfortunately is still rampant on the beach as kids target foreigners. So best when going to the beach, don't stand out like a foreigner. Make sure you leave your western swimming costume at home (that goes for male and female) - rather purchase a Brazilian swimming costume when you get there, men: sunga and woman: Brazilian bikini. Also DON'T bring a towel or take a beach towel on your trip or take one to the beach...rather purchase a beautiful canga (sarong) along the beach. Read about Brazilian beach etiquette.Bonus: You can drink beer and cocktails all day served on the beach. What you need for the beach is money for your beers, eats, chair or umbrella. Havaianas, Brazilian swimming costume, canga, sunglasses, sunscreen and drawstring back pack. If you really want to fit in like a Carioca, add a book or bluetooth speaker to play your favorite beats.

reviews.title: A Hard Pass
reviews.text: We went here because its supposed to be nicer than Copa and the trendy place to go. I was very disappointed. This beach is packed! We couldnt get a spot any where. We ended up walking in the water trying to find a spot. It was not ideal. Even the water was crowded. The only good thing about this beach is the beach vendors sell more variety of things compared to Copa. It wasnt worth it to us and we ended up going back to the peaceful, fun, spacious Copacoban beach.

reviews.title: Holiday in Brazil
reviews.text: Ipanema is famous... Not just because of the girl from the song but its beach which stroll for 4 km.Perfect sand, pleasant waves and even more merchandiser who sell everything from food to hammock.Girls, boys are beautiful, you can play beach games or just sit and watch.You can be relaxed and enjoy your beer or cocktail whole day. But be always concerned and don't let alone your belongings even for a minute. As a matter of fact it is better to get there in your swimming clothes, with a towel and some small amount of money to buy drink and chair.No credit card, no fancy phone or ID card needed there which you were very sorry if it was stolen.

reviews.title: Looking for "The Girl from Ipanema"....
reviews.text: The famous song by Antonio Carlos Jobim is just one of many inspirations for a visit to Ipanema Beach. Facing the Atlantic Ocean to the South, you may start your day with a refreshing sunrise beach walk and close it with a spectacular sunset, with a cold beer or a Caipirinha in your hand. What a life!

reviews.title: Lovely!
reviews.text: Incredible beach and experience: the sea and the beach itself but also the incredible variety of colourful beach vendors and tourists,

reviews.title: Fun at the beach
reviews.text: No better way to pass a sunny afternoon in Ipanema. It can get crowded, but the beach provides an excellent opportunity to people watch. And yes, people wear the bare minimum. There are barracas along the beach, stands that will rent you chairs and umbrellas.  They'll also serve you caipirinhas and other drinks. Some have food and showers. The water was clean.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: A beautiful long sandy beach made famous by the Frank Sinatra song and it’s distinctive paving tiles. You will find hundreds of tourists and locals alike flocking here daily to enjoy the cooler air and the sea. Loads of places to stop and have a cold drink or coconut.

reviews.title: Head to the rocks at the Copacabana beach end at dusk to enjoy the sunset party
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, quieter than Copacabana and usually calmer sea too. There are always plenty of people selling drinks and snacks, so no need to take much. We were warned to be very careful of pickpockets/thieves but found Rio no different to any other place, and everyone very kind and friendly. Just be humble and don't flash your wealth, We donned flip-flops and shorts and sun tops and in spite of our milky skins we found we just fitted in. In spite of our total lack of Portuguese we had no problem communicating - if people didn't speak English then they worked really hard to make sure that we were served what we wanted by double checking everything. We absolutely loved the party atmosphere each night at sunset.

reviews.title: Nice beach with Sunset and Island views.
reviews.text: Narrower than Copa beach with more locals.  Still a lot of beach/vendors, but not as aggressive as on Copacabana beach.  Beware of your belongings!  The neighborhoods nearby are neat to walk through as well

reviews.title: Very different to Copacabana Beach
reviews.text: We visited Ipanema Beach at the end of a tour for the day and walked there not knowing what to expect but being told it's worth a look for the sunset. What we expected was a spectacularly sunset, what we weren't prepared for was the magnitude of people there to watch it, apparently this is a daily ritual for many Rio residents and visitors. We arrived about 45 minutes before the sunset and it was already packed, the best view point appeared to be a very large rock overlooking the bay that was already well covered in people. Whilst finding a spot to watch the sunset on the rock, we watched people having lots of fun, music, swimming, dive bombing into the ocean, and working out at the concrete gym. The sunset was stunning but we weren't prepared for the applause as it went down, which again is a common occurrence in Rio. Once the sun set, we made our way to dinner near Ipanema Beach, be prepared to see flamboyancy at its best there.

reviews.title: Best place to stay in rio
reviews.text: We stayed at Ipanema for one week and found it the best place to stay in the city. It feels very safe and has lots of good restaurants and bars. Plus the metro makes getting to other parts of the city easy.

reviews.title: Fabulous Beach
reviews.text: That's were the locals go.  the beaches are clean and there are lots of activities going on.  Look for a game for Footvolley.  What an amazing sport.  Would love to see it played in the Olympics.

reviews.title: Less crowded than Copacabana
reviews.text: Still a busy spot, but much less hectic than Copacabana. Lots of places to eat and drink. Sand beautiful. The Girl from Ipanema really swam here (she's a grandmother now), and the tune was written in a bar a couple blocks back rom the sand. Worth checking out.

reviews.title: A Lovely Local Beach!
reviews.text: We decided to stay in Ipanema rather than the more commercial Copacabana and just love this beach. The quality of the sand is excellent and the locals are super friendly. The waves are of a decent height but not so big so easy to enjoy. It’s really peaceful here and well worth a visit!

reviews.title: Happening place for millennials
reviews.text: Lots of activity on this beach which was packed. We went there for the flea market a couple blocks away and ended up walking to the rock north of the beach. Enjoyed the energy of the area. The artists market was well worth the trip.

reviews.title: Beach  trip
reviews.text: Paid  for  beach  chairs and parasol, had  to wait  for  drinks  which were  expensive..clean and no problems  with beach  sellers, great  atm osphere in evenings  with  small bands and artists..highky  recommended

reviews.title: Beautiful, slower paced beach
reviews.text: We stayed at Praia Ipanema Hotel, and had the beach on our front step. We thoroughly enjoyed this area!

reviews.title: Beatiful!
reviews.text: All the beaches in Rio are beatiful. And a lot of people out in the evening. Visiting Rio, my recommendation is to visit Ipanema

reviews.title: It’s a beach!
reviews.text: Many many people on beach obviously, reminded us of Spain.....At the far end there is a piece of land jutting out which lots of people watched the sunset from,to be brutally honest when we were there it stunk of urine, presumably this is a feature of this particulararea.....

reviews.title: Beautiful.
reviews.text: Don't believe what any 'haters' are writing, this is about as sweet as a big-picture-beach-destination gets!!Why? Here you go:i. it's clean; the water, the sand, and all around are pretty much spotless (esp. considering this is the key beach in a city of 6 million+,ii. services abound all around! Excellent restaurants, grocery stores, bars, and other sights are all within a 5-30 minute walk,iii. the view from the beach is spectacular in various directions,iv. vendors come to you (politely) offering everything, including: bathing suits, cocktails, fire-grilled cheese, fresh fruit, cold beer/water/ice, sarongs, sunglasses, and more!Go!

reviews.title: Ipanema Beach
reviews.text: We stayed in Ipanema for our first few days. So this was the first beach we visited.We knew Ipanema was a more upscale area than Copacabana. This is in between Leblon and Copacabana.It is less hectic, we walked around the area in the evening and it was certainly quieter than Copacabana although it is still wise to be careful.In the daytime we saw a little people working out and playing various games on the beach.

reviews.title: The most beautiful and charming beach in Rio, ever!
reviews.text: Just stroll along the beach enjoying the scenery! Or swim in the warm waters! That’s what I’ve been doing since I was born.

reviews.title: Better than Copacabana
reviews.text: I truly believe that Ipanema beach is better for you if you enjoy a slightly quieter day on the beach. Copacabana has much more to do and it is for that reason, a whole lot more popular, however Ipanema is quieter a bit more intimate. Still, there is plenty to do at Ipanema and it is nonetheless another huge beach.

reviews.title: Best beach in Rio
reviews.text: Better beach than Copacabana. Very safe and nice neighborhood close by. Several stands where you can find everything

reviews.title: Packed
reviews.text: The beaches in Rio get a little crowded. Lots of panhandlers on the beach. Caipirinhas flow from all directions and they are delicious. The water is not clear and definitely not swimmable. The waves can get pretty intense.

reviews.title: For us, just the best
reviews.text: We have stayed in Ipanema on a previous visit, several years ago.We booked again without hesitation.  Having visited Copacobana, this is so much better - more up-market, more sophisticated, more entertaining, less tourist-orientated.Of course the beach is packed on a good weekend - but that is part of the atmosphere and part of the experience.Our hotel (Sol Ipanema) just across the road from the beach provided parasol, chairs and towels to take to the beach.  Without that facility, there are plenty of places to rent these from the many providers on the beach.We were extraordinarily lucky to be on the beach when we had one of the perfect sunsets that can be so magnificent in Rio de Janeiro.  It was a moving experience to be surrounded by many hundreds of people on the beach who all applauded as the sun dropped below the sea on the horizon.  A memorable experience.If you wish to swim, be warned - the waves can the big and the under-tow strong.  A surfers paradise.

reviews.title: Ipanema beach. Posto 10
reviews.text: Caesar palace hotel has now closed which has left this area of beach to be open market for various beach vendors. We used the team from 101 (Leandro) twice and we found their service very good. They charged a fair rate for drinks, chairs and umbrellas. They also were seen to be proactively protecting their clients goods if they left them unattended. I’d use them again for sure. I plan to return with my family and stay on this area of the beach. Posto 9 is frequented mostly by males and posto 8 was busier, probably because it is a shorter walk from the metro.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Ipanema is a beautiful beach about a fifteen minute walk from Copacabana. It’s a bit quieter and less hectic. It’s worth experiencing and spending a day there.

reviews.title: Plenty to do and see
reviews.text: I spent 5 day’s staying just off the Ipanema Beach, it’s a great location, nowhere is far away and it felt very safe day or night.

reviews.title: Very beautiful beach to visit...
reviews.text: Not as big and long as Copacabana, but it is more classy i guess. Streets are w/ cobblestone, beaches very clean, people classy and tranquil.

reviews.title: Not worth visiting
reviews.text: The only reason to go is so that you can say that you have been there.  The is really no other reason to go.  It can be a little dangerous there and you will have people trying to scam you.

reviews.title: Mostly clean with tough waves
reviews.text: Beautiful with lots of vendors and chair/umbrellas. Everything to make you comfortable is around. Would love to see people cleaning up after themselves.

reviews.title: Best Beach
reviews.text: My husband and I spent our honeymoon in Rio and went to Copacabana and Ipanema. We preferred Ipanema over Copa because of the beach itself. The water was clearer, the beach overall was better with a different vibe than the hustle and bustle of Copa.

reviews.title: Almost As Famous As Copacabana
reviews.text: Almost as famous as Copacabana, this white sand beach stretches for  1.2 miles in the south zone of Rio between Jardim de Alah and Arpoador, the big stone separating it from Copacabana.Ipanema shot into the limelight in the 1960s with the globally famous song "The Girl From Ipanema." Today, Ipanema and neighboring Leblon are considered the most desirable places to live in Rio.While my spouse and I stayed at Copacabana in late October 2019 during a private tour of Brazil, our guide/driver took us to visit almost all the beaches along Rio's shoreline on the Atlantic Ocean. This one was definitely more stylish.

reviews.title: Clean, not too crowded and we didn't feel unsafe.
reviews.text: We were warned repeatedly about pickpockets and scammers but experienced no problems. There were fewer hawkers than expected and it was a pleasant visit

reviews.title: Great beach! Very LGTBQ friendly!
reviews.text: Amazing beach! It gets super busy on Saturdays and Sundays and it is very LGTBQ friendly. My boyfriend and I went to a gay area (in between post 8 and 9) and it was full of gay people. We felt very safe! Really recommend getting Caipirinhas from the stands, friendly people and great prices!

reviews.title: Ipanema Beach is for All Seasons
reviews.text: Ipanema beach is a place difficult to describe because is associated with the history of "bossa nova" and the bohemian life of the 60s! Nowadays it preserves the fundamental features that stretches from Leblon to Arpoador and it is place for living on holiday at all seasons!

reviews.title: So beautiful
reviews.text: I highly recommend this beach. Its a beautiful place full of stores and restaurants. Very save and elegant. The beach is very nice and the water great.

reviews.title: Like sitting in the middle of a Sunday market.
reviews.text: Beach very busy. People pitch right up next too you. Beach vendors zoom in and out of sunbathers selling drinks, food, bikinis, dresses, hats etc etc all shouting - it s like sitting in the middle of a Sunday market. Shame as lovely soft sand beach. Big waves, surfers. Not really for swimming as currents and waves really strong. Few beach bars. Warm 30 degrees in December

reviews.title: Beautiful beach and nice park
reviews.text: I have been to the beach twice for sunset during my recent 4-day stay in Rio. It's one of my favorite places and I wish I could have spent more time there. Amazing place for soft sand, clean water, and some surfers were great.

reviews.title: Great beach - watch the tides
reviews.text: A beautiful beach that can get very crowded, but when not, a place to sit, stroll and read for hours.

reviews.title: In Rio de Janeiro, Ipanema Beach is the place to be!
reviews.text: In Rio de Janeiro, Ipanema Beach is the place to be! The world-famous beach is legendary as the place for people watching and it has a large pleasant lagoon to enjoy walks and bike rides with large beautiful gardens and parks. Many of Rio de Janeiro’s best restaurants, open-air cafes & bars, and shops abound on the streets of Ipanema Beach. Ipanema Beach’s main shopping street is Rua Visconde de Piraja with upscale and bargain shops. We found the prices in Rio de Janeiro very reasonable for fashions, food, and drinks. Rua Vinicius de Moraes has some very nice restaurants and cafes. See below for more great things to do in Ipanema Beach.Don’t miss the Sunday Open Air Market (Feira de Arte de Ipenama) in Praca General Osorio - named hippie fair for its bohemian but nice fashion and gift bargains. More upscale restaurants in Ipanema Beach are closer to Leblon Beach while more affordable (as well as more affordable accommodations) are closer to Rio de Janeiro’s Copacabana Beach.

reviews.title: Just as good as Copacabana but with bigger waves
reviews.text: Rio is all about the beach life and we couldn’t split Copacabana and Ipanema.....even the two songs are both great!! Just hire some bikes and cruise down both beaches, enjoy a few drinks in the huge array of Quiosque but choose one with live music. Catch some rays (but be careful the suns strong here even through clouds!) and make sure you cool off in the sea.......and on some days those waves are strong.....but great fun (check the flags)

reviews.title: Legendary Rio Beach
reviews.text: Very busy and a little more upmarket than Copacobana, the sea is surprisingly clean and the waterline litter free. The Rio Beaches are well run, there is an excellent system in place that makes this beach simply iconic if you dont mind having a lot of people around

reviews.title: Great at Ipanema
reviews.text: Ipanema beach won’t disappoint you! The clean white send and the great length and livelihood will draw you to come back! Keep an eye on your stuff when going into the water.

reviews.title: Okay
reviews.text: Clean nice beach but strong waves that does not invite to swim that much. Sellers are mostly okay and leave you alone soon.

reviews.title: Ipanema Dreamin' !!!!!!
reviews.text: Ipanema Ipanema Ipanema...........lived there for a year on the main drag Visconde de Piraja  next to Pato Bar. Absolutley the most incredible part of Rio !!! Two blocks from the beach at Post 10 which IMO is the best beach around. You can strike out and be in Leblon shopping in five minutes and enjoy all the night life there. Copacabana is a little further but tons of fun there too and away from some of the tourism. You are just right smack in the middle of the best places around and where the action is. Oh yeah two minute walk to Lagoa as well. I never wanted to leave and you won't either !!!!!!!!! Most beautiful girls in the world !!!

reviews.title: Watch out for the bartenders- try to rip you off
reviews.text: Had a few beers on Ipanama beach at the local kiosks.One kiosk charged correctly whereas another tried to charge me three times the amount. So be careful and insist on a bill and that it is correct. The beach itself is ok but the surf is not worth mentioning. More of a shore dump. The water however in October is refreshing. You will not find the locals swimming. Do not take any jewellery down on the beach as you will loose it. Be extra careful.

reviews.title: Very nice beach with a beautiful ocean
reviews.text: Great to be in. In my opinion nicer and slightly safer than Copacabana. The hotels are nicer here too.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: beautiful beach, sea is full of strong waves, beautiful people everywhere , loads of place to hire a chair and a sun umbrella

reviews.title: Better in the 60’s
reviews.text: Beach is lovely but abuts high end residential with few bars or restaurants. Saw a picture of the beautiful “girl from Ipanema”, yes she is a real person and still is lovely and appears with her daughter occasionally.
Beautiful beach even on a cloudy windy day! A lot of activity from surfers, vendors, beer stands. I can only imagine what it looks like in the middle of summer!

reviews.title: Great day on this famous beach
reviews.text: Our hotel had partnership with a cabana on the beach so we could use their chairs and umbrellas for free. It is a nice beach, and it was good to walk along the boulevard. Just a shame that the water us freezing. We were also advised that, because none of the bars are open after dark, it wouldn't be very safe to go walking there in the evening. But Copacabana is safe because the beachbars there are open for dinner.

reviews.title: It looks so fabulous I just wish the weather was better
reviews.text: On our tour we drove by and stopped at Ipanema beach. It has been raining for weeks here so no one was on the beach and the ocean was a bit murky because of storms.

reviews.title: Great beach!!
reviews.text: We stayed on Copacabana beach, but on the far left side which was near Ipanema Beach and went there often. In November the waters were somewhat cold so not much swimming, but it has a really fine and clean white sand which is nice to walk on. Looks like its mostly residential area, and i think hotels are a little bit more expensive in this area. It is more high end though, with much better quality shops and restaurants on parallel streets.

reviews.title: The most beautiful beach in Rio
reviews.text: I visited Ipanema beach at the end of October with my family. We loved to walk on the sand and swim in the water. It is a wonderful place, posto 9 is the best spot to relax and near the restaurants and pubs.Unforgettable...

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Nice place to visit and relax for the day. The water and the sand are clean. I could not ask for more.

reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text: More residential with a few beach bars but nothing much in the evening. Worth the walk during the day, certainly a nicer beach than its famous neighbour.

reviews.title: Large Sandy Beach With A Famous Name
reviews.text: It is a  famous beach with a famous name and it has wide sand  and lots of activity. The streets back of the beach are a little tacky and  not that good despite the fashionable tag that Epanema gets.A little better than Copacabana but falls short of many beachs around the world but worthy of a walk and watch what happens along this long stretch of sand.

reviews.title: Day trip
reviews.text: Beech was clean with white powdery sand. You can sit and drink coconut water whilst watching the world go by. Views of Christ the Redeemer from the beach 🏖

reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.text: Lots to see and do on this beach. It is really super lively 24/7. You will like it and you can see the differences with Copacabana easily.

reviews.title: "More so" than Copacabana :)
reviews.text: Both "lively & vibrant" beaches crowded with plenty of people & colorful umbrellas (and also with quite a number of souvenir vendors & food kiosks along the sidewalk right alongside the length of each of the two beaches), it was yes even "more so" actually on this beach than on the more famous Copacabana Beach which is just to the east of this beach (with a distance of just about a 5-minute walk between the south end of that beach & the east end of this) just by the general count of about "three times" as many umbrellas on this beach compared to the number seen on Copacabana, and yes the reason just might be a "calmer water" on this side (from my personal experience of getting hit by some sizeable waves near Copacabana Palace Hotel not far from the north end of Copacabana Beach although the water on that side seems to get calmer too to the south as I noticed more & more people in the water while heading south along that beach towards this beach).  And also, seen along this beach was something "kind of unique" (which I don't recall having seen at any other beach) which are these "sandbag stairways" (sandbags stacked in the shape of a stairway) at some short intervals along the sidewalk since its quite a bit higher than the beach itself (but just for about halfway I would say as you start from the east end near Arpoador Rock, with just a "level ground" along the western half where you can easily go back & forth between the sidewalk & the beach).  Also, if you're looking for "coconut water", you may only find it at the food kiosks along this beach, specifically at those near Post 9 or 10 (those "vertical structures" along both Copacabana & this beach at about every 500 meters apart with facilities such as washrooms & ATMs), and not at those along Copacabana which are likely just for regular food. From near Copacabana Palace Hotel (a beautiful heritage building of about 7 stories), I just walked at a "quite leisure" pace for about 2 km along Copacabana Beach heading south to Forte de Copacabana (definitely a "must site" to stop by for its great military museum with "life-like" models & the big fortification structure at the back where you can both enter underground and go up above the rampart for some "breathtaking views" of the area around) on the south end of Copacabana Beach followed by a short break at a gas station (with a nice corner area to eat inside) then continued my day with the walk along this beach (after just a short stretch of street from the south end of Copacabana Beach to the east end of this beach) for about 2 km of its length of about 3 km, stopping at Post 11 (just about 1 km short to its west end Mirante Leblon) where I finally left the "long beachfront" (after a total walk of about 4 km with 2 along Copacabana & 2 along this beach) and took a taxi to Jardim Botanico.

reviews.title: Waves, vendors and lots to see
reviews.text: The two beaches we needed to see while in Rio was the Copacabana and Ipanema Beaches. Not realizing they were right next to each other made it easy to walk to both. There are even great sand art along the way.

reviews.title: Ipanema Beach! 👙☀️
reviews.text: This was the first beach we went to in Rio, after going to the Copacabana you can really see the differences.It’s smaller and quieter in comparison to the Copacabana, and the surrounding areas is less built up. When on the beach there are lots of street vendors that are trying to see drinks, food, sunglasses, jewellery etc but after you tell them no they move on.The part of the sea we went into had a bit of a dip and slanted up. At night time the beach is not lit up but the bars and restaurants are still open along the beach. All in all the beach was good and a quieter option to the Copacabana! But I would suggest going to all the local beaches 😎⛱

reviews.title: a great beach but now unsure to best.............
reviews.text: stayed in Rio for 2 weeks and at first we were at Arpoador between the main two beaches in Rio which is perfect.  After walking along Copacabana on a Saturday we thought much better to stay at Ipanema as Copacabana too intense and commercial, however, after the second week and experiencing Copacabana and some of the live music and, sorry to use this but only thing that works 'vibe' not so sure?  you can walk between the two so doesnt really matter - and the walks fun - but would say the weekend changes both.  (much busier) completely safe and dont worry about that but dont wear jewellery etc. and be a tourist as plenty of people struggling and the only thing didnt like in Rio (no different in most other places) plenty of poverty and privilege side by side :( but great people getting on with how life should be led mainly regardless of colour etc.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Ipanema is the most beautiful Beach I saw in Rio. Especially the sunset on the mountains nearbye give quite a stunning lansdcape. Pay attention to the currents in the sea, they can be very strong...

reviews.title: My favourite beach in the world
reviews.text: I just love the vibes, the waves... Posto 9 is great place for gays but also straight, lots of beautiful, fit, and active people.

reviews.title: The best !!!
reviews.text: A melhor praia urbana do mundo !!!The best urban beach in the world !!!La mejor playa urbana del mundo !!!世界最高の都会のビーチ

reviews.title: Nice beach with beautiful view
reviews.text: Ipanema beach was across from my hotel.  It has a wide cross section of people and bathing suit coverage.  There are people selling food and drinks on the beach.  It is considered best to purchase what you need from them.  Also bring only the cash you will need to the beach (bottle of water runs about R$5) and leave anything important or expensive in your hotel room. It is unlikely that your things will be disturbed if you keep it minimal.  Nice way to spend an afternoon between the warm sun and cool waters of the Atlantic with a great view!

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: It's a really safe and clean beach but I'm not a fan of big waves.However there's no salesman bothering you like on Copacabana.

reviews.title: Absolutely Fabulous!
reviews.text: This was our favourite beach even though we were staying in Copacabana, Ipanema is a little more laid back with a different kind of vibe. It's trendy with surfers gliding the Atlantic waves, Caipirinha's close at hand and vendors selling everything from skewered beef and chicken to coconuts filled with bottled water. My little boy loved playing in the ocean and we were able to play games on the sand. It's really active, some opting for football, others taking advantage of the rays, people wandering the promenade and well, it has that whole 'California' thing going on! What do I mean?  It's chilled, it's cool, like anywhere on the planet where you find 'surf dudes'. Be sure to grab a Brazil shirt or some souvenirs that won't prove too expensive. If you're staying in Copacabana, head to the fort, follow the road round and cut through the park.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Ipanema is a beautiful beach. It gets a little crowded, especially nearing the summer months, but you would be hard to pressed to find a good beach that ISN'T crowded. You can get everything you want without getting out of the sand. People will come around selling drinks, food, sunglasses, and more. They're good people just trying to make a living, so if you don't want anything just say "No, Obrigada" and they'll be on their way (there's no reason to be mean!). I definitely recommend trying the cheese! If you find yourself in Rio de Janeiro, definitely go and see Ipanema Beach.

reviews.title: Clean and great waves
reviews.text: We sat on Ipanema beach for the afternoon. The little chair, umbrella and drink vendors make your trip to the beach easy. Two chairs and an umbrella was 20 reals. (£4). They will also ask you if you want drinks or food. But you don’t have to take it. We had two diet cokes for 10 reals, which is £1, so very reasonable.Lovely clean beach with great waves. They are strong though so not suitable for young children or non swimmers. Don’t forget the sun lotion as the sun is so strong, especially when it is windy and you don’t realise you are burning.

reviews.title: Nice beach but lots of people selling stuff
reviews.text: Really lovely beach and nice sand however constantly hassled by people trying f to sell stuff to us and couldn’t rest for a second without another one bothering us This is why I have given it an average rating  as it was every 30 seconds

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful sand, great sea, friendly, atmospheric, and hassle free. Plenty of beach sellers but are polite at all times. Good variety of kiosks to choose from.

reviews.title: Famous beach in Rio
reviews.text: Rio has different beaches, but Ipanema is one of the most famous. There’s plenty of space to stretch out and this is a difference with the crowded Copacabana beach just around the corner. Here you get a taste of the Real Rio. Enjoy!

reviews.title: STAY ALERT
reviews.text: We did have a whirlwind trip in Rio but had not visited Ipanema yet. So on the last day thought that we would drop by to have a walk on the beach in the afternoon. We took the normal precautions before and during this trip keeping our bags close, not taking cash and phones without another person on the look out etc. So i guess we had our guard down since it was our last day. We took off all our gold jewelery before leaving home but completely forgot my dad's chain which has a protective charm on it. Long story short, a bunch of locals tried to snatch the chain. The pavement between the cycle track and the beach is not as wide as in Copacabana so we walked quite close to the track. They were on bikes, while one guy drove in front to distract us another guy came up behind us and grabbed my dad's chain. There were 3 of us but none of us notice ANYTHING till this guys hand was wrapped around my dads chain. Luckily my dad grabbed his charm from the front so the chain snapped and fell into his shirt and didn't end up in some no gooder's pocket. It all happening in a matter of seconds. We just kinda went into shock and disbelief while the guys rode coolly away as if they hadnt just tried to rob us! Unfortunately there weren't any police cars or officers to report to and we were just 2 hours away from our departure.our singular thought was to get out of there. It has me a bit duped that in such a tourist rich area there aren't any officers specially with the worries that visitors have with crimes in Rio. Granted it was partly our fault as we forgot about the chain, if it had not been saved it would have ruined the entire trip for us.I was actually thinking of writing a 100% good review of our time in Rio just that morning. Unfortunately. But it is still a really good place to visit.The beach is such a pretty blue and beautiful. But just half an hour in Ipanema had me wishing to be back in Copacabana. The smell along the pavement is also not pleasant. Anyone who is visiting just be more careful than we were and stay safe. And stay away from the bike tracks.

reviews.title: Beautiful blue ocean
reviews.text: We loved the beach and especially the large rocks around the end of the beach. You can easily climb up the rocks for a great view. There are even locals selling cold drinks on top. Probably the best part of the beach. Great crashing blue and white waves. Stop and have a cool drink at one of the stands. We didn't really go swimming, it looked a bit rough and we just wanted to experience the area without the hassle carrying beach stuff. Much nicer than  Copacabana. Nicer area around the beach too.

reviews.title: Beach time
reviews.text: Very good social space. Sometimes it too crowded. Always better to be at the beach with some local guys to be sure that you buy right and fresh drinks and food. Also be careful with your own things since many guys walk around with fast fingers.

reviews.title: A Must in Rio
reviews.text: If you are family, visit one day, if you are single, go every day. Ipanema is where the beautiful young people in Rio hang out. Not easy to park, as any other place in Rio. If you want to drive go early, if you can go uber. Dont forget to drink the iced tea MATE LEAO they traditionally sell on huge cans. Delicious and clean.

reviews.title: Best beach I have ever visited
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning, pay close attention your personal belongings. The sea can get quite rough great for surfing. You can buy beers, cold drinks and food all the way along .

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Great views and great location to bars and restaurants, also feels very safe opposed to Copacabana! Can’t wait to go back

reviews.title: Iconic, pretty to look at,smelly sewage outlet
reviews.text: Weekend, could not see that sand, whole beach canopy of umbrellas.Weekdays better.This is a polluted sea, from swimmers ( there are no toilets)  and an outlet.Rio needs to sort their sewage issue.

reviews.title: definitely nicer than Copacabana
reviews.text: beautiful beach, less crowded and more charming than Copacabana. Nice bars to have a drink or lunch on the beach. Felt very safe.

reviews.title: Better than Copacabana!
reviews.text: We stayed in Copacabana and visited Ipanema on two occasions during our visit.The beach has the same golden sand and plenty of decent waves for surfers and toe-dippers alike; but without the constant peddlers on the beach trying to sell their wares every couple of minutes.Ipanema beach has a much more chilled out vibe and the beachfront bars are reasonably priced and very easy going.I didn't manage to reach Ipanema to catch a sunset, but I am told that people are often seen applauding the sunset.The statue of Jobim is also worth a look.

reviews.title: Unique white fine sand !
reviews.text: Ipanema beach is unique not only due to its wonderful setting between two rock outcrops that fixed this sand barrier enclosing a lagoon, its has unique white fine sand that ensures a smooth slope and nice breaking waves. Copacabana beach was enlarged in the 70's with slightly courser sand pumped across the tunnel from Guanabara Bay in Botafogo. Due to this, Copacabana beach waves break much sharper and closer to the beach witch is not as nice.

reviews.title: Great place for a swim or to chill
reviews.text: Great place for a swim or to chill. I recommend staying near posto 9, the "Gay" post. A "safer" area. Always be wary of your surroundings and always go to the beach with a friend. Looters are a plentiful. I have never had an incident there but it does happen, especially around Carnival Period.

reviews.title: A good visit
reviews.text: We passed through the beach front as part of our tour and the guide played the Frank Sinatra classic song to us and related the story of the actual girl in the song. A very moving moment as the huge waves crashed onto the beach. A memorable experience.

reviews.title: So fun, but cold water.
reviews.text: There are a lot of restaurants and things to do and its very well cared for. Water was so cold. We loved sitting on beach at night. Bring a windbreaker.

reviews.title: World famous
reviews.text: If you go to Rio, you have to go to Ipanema Beach.  Walk along the iconic sidewalk (different/distinct sidewalk design than Copacabana), and there is a lot to see, a lot of vendors to grab a drink or souvenir.  Pretty views of the coast and the islands offshore.

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: Great bars and restaurants to stop for a bite or have a quick drink. The views are amazing and people are so friendly.The weather was perfect!

reviews.title: Wonderful Rio beach
reviews.text: This is arguably the best beach in Rio. It's quieter than the neighbouring Copacabana and more family oriented. It's also safer. If you want to stay in Rio Ipanema, with it's beautiful beach is the place to stay.

reviews.title: Of course
reviews.text: It is a great place to walk or be on the beach if you are so inclined. It is all there-- you can rent chairs and umbrellas. Buy food, hats and even swim suits.

reviews.title: Nice Beach
reviews.text: Its seems like a continuation of Copacabana beach. There are plenty of beach chairs with umbrellas (I imagine you hire them from the closest hut). Nice wide sandy beach and stalls selling food and drinks line the boardwalk. We sat and watched the police arrest someone who must have been stealing peoples belongings, the cops were digging in the sand looking for stuff, pretty large police presence, I felt safe the entire time. Great spot for a swim, drink and a little people watching.

reviews.title: Visit Ipanema Beach
reviews.text: One of the good beaches in the world. We had a long walk from Copacabana to Leblon which was amazing, had fresh coconut water, and excellent food. There are lots of restaurants. Very busy but safe, good & reasonable rates in restaurant, very tasty sea food. There is mini market on both sides of the road,overall enjoyable Beach.

reviews.title: Fun beach with lots of people
reviews.text: We rented bikes to go from Copacabana to Ipanema. As we arrived, we noticed that Ipanema tends to be more crowded than Copacabana. We rented a couple of chairs and bought a bucket of beer. It was fun.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Lots of families on the beach and nets set up for games. Swell can be high when windy. Beach was spotless and plenty of places to get food and drinks on the promenade.

reviews.title: Amazing precinct
reviews.text: Lived in a hotel just two blocks from the Ipanema beach. Great bars and restaurants in walking distance.

reviews.title: Fantastic location
reviews.text: The hotel is situated opposite the beach so if you are a beach lover or just want to “people watch” it is a fantastic location. It isn’t really a shopping area but there are bars and restaurants around.The staff at the hotel desk are extremely helpful and courteous and there is always at least one on the desk who can speak English.My room was clean, modern and very nice with a balcony that overlooked the beach.....amazing the activity in that area 24 hours of the day. Brazilian hotels do not supply tea and coffee making facilities and the plumbing is always a bit of a problem. You do not flush toilet paper down the bowl...if you do the bowl fills up and overflows onto the floor! This is not just a problem for this hotel as I had the same issue everywhere else.There is a safe in the room which was great and the bed was comfortable. Breakfast was good - Brazilians like cake for breakfast. The selection was quite good.The food in the restaurant was also good.

reviews.title: Ipanema Beach
reviews.text: Fabulous beach. Clean warm water. We found a lovely quiet area to sit near the Uber drop of point in the Sunset Rock side. A few of us did a lovely open water mile swim there and really enjoyed it. Highly recommended

reviews.title: Best beach in Rio
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach with stunning views. Less seedy than Copacabana beach, in my opinion, and a little less active. Fewer vendors and restaurants and more locals, which was a plus for me. But also close enough to Copa if you want to ride bikes or scooter there (there are tons of these rentals available).

reviews.title: Most famous beach in Brazil.
reviews.text: One of the most famous beach in Brazil, located in the heart of city next Copacabana, very good service on the beach, most crowded during the weekend.

reviews.title: "The Girl From Ipanema"
reviews.text: Our Guide played the song.."Tall and tan and young and lovely The girl from Ipanema goes walking ..." and we all look for her (1964)...yes..This is a great beach to enjoy..fro lovers!!

reviews.title: The most famous beach
reviews.text: Our visit to the beach was a real surprise, the place is controlled by a lot of police, every 100 meters at least to policemen from the city, the army the police department......You feel secure at day time I don’t know about late hours.During weekends the place is crowded with local people giving an special atmosphere not to be missed.On top of it yellow sand and clean sea water make this place UNIQUE.

reviews.title: Great besxh
reviews.text: Great, Long Beach. During the week there were very few people and you could come any time. It got a little more crowded during the weekend

reviews.title: Fun beach
reviews.text: Loved this beach. Stayed at a condo on the beach. Sand was soft and there were plenty of food vendors serving you. You could sit there and never move off the beach. Clean!

reviews.title: Amazing nice long beach
reviews.text: Nice long beach with many people but have to be careful of pick pocket. There is nice clean sand and good view

reviews.title: Worth the walk
reviews.text: Really pretty beach less commercial than Copacabana with lovely beach bars.    Scenic and easy to walk to from Copacabana with lots of bars/shops along the way.   Really clean and well maintained.

reviews.title: This is Rio!
reviews.text: Just beautiful!! Ipanema and Copacabana are the heart of Rio. Any time of the year. Full  of life and people

reviews.title: DANGEROUS PLACE
reviews.text: Very dangerous in weekends,Many thiefs strolling on the road without any security to protect the tourists.You never can show cameras, cellphones ,watches, nothing of value.

reviews.title: Great beach to enjoy!
reviews.text: Nice place to visit but be beware of petty theft anytime of the day. Like all the city of Rio de Janeiro, the sights are the most dangerous to visit. But with some caution, disguising your appearance as a tourist, there will be no problems ... there is much speculation about the violence itself.

reviews.title: The best beach in rio
reviews.text: This is definitely one off my favorite beaches in rio. The neighborhood is so cute and you can walk all the way to the Arpoador to see best sunset in Rio de Janeiro. If you want to eat something healthy go to “delírio tropical” it’s very close to Ipanema beach.

reviews.title: Decent beach
reviews.text: Plenty of facilities and street hawkers. Busier and more commercial than Leme. For young families we preferred Leme as it was more peaceful.

reviews.title: Great time playing and walking on the beach
reviews.text: I really enjoyed walking on the beach.  The scenery and water were beautiful.  I was able to play in the water, even though it was a little chilly.  Nice people serving drinks on the beach.  Recommend for sure.

reviews.title: The view is amazing
reviews.text: I absolutely loved the view at Ipanema beach. We took a bicycle ride and met the sunset on Ipanema. Always overcrowded though.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Very famous and a must see in Rio. Cleaner and less dangerous than copacabana beach, can always buy alcohol on beach and there's also outdoor gym equipment you can use too

reviews.title: Just like the postcards
reviews.text: The famous Ipanema beach appears on many Brazilian postcards and travel guides. It’s a perfect place for a stroll especially during the day which is well patrolled by local police. Along the sidewalk there’re souvenir sellers and food tents. The water is clear and crisp. Lots of action on the soft sand ranging from passive sunbathing to beach to soccer and volleyball.

reviews.title: Always a pleasure
reviews.text: Ipanema 🏖 Beach is where the rich,chic & beautiful people hang out. At any time of day...Though regular folks are there mostly to peddle the ware & 🥘 food. You get coconut 🥥 water 💧 out of the coconut 🌴...Grilled 🧀 cheese off the barbie grill...Heads up do not buy 💦 water from vendors buy the water with gas...The vendor have been known to refill with local tap 💦 water...It may cause you to be 😷 ill....Also there is local WiFi along the beaches 🏝🏝🏝..Some free some you 💰 pay..Inquire at the tourist kiosks.

reviews.title: Best beach ever
reviews.text: My hotel is located right at the beach front. Very peaceful beach. Less crowded and touristic than copacabana. Convenient to run without any distractions or human roadblock. Most of the people there are locals who workout. And it's much more beautiful and cleaner.

reviews.title: Better than Copacabana?
reviews.text: I read in reviews that this beach and surrounds were cleaner and nicer than Copacabana Beach.  Not to me:  it is much smaller in terms of sandy area, and if you set up, you are very close to the busy road.  I found the restaurants and shops no better than the Copacabana/Leme area.  But, each visitor should see the highlights of Rio, and this is certainly one of them.

reviews.title: Very nice beach
reviews.text: The best in Rio, very beautiful. I’m biased, I grew up going there. It’s crowded on weekends. I like to go early in the morning. Don’t go after dark for security reasons (true for every beach in Rio).

reviews.title: Beauty and diversity
reviews.text: The view from this iconic beach is uniquely beautiful. The experience of staying here is very different depending on what time of day you go here from early morning to late afternoon, and what kind of weather wind, clouds or humidity offers. Some days the waves are too dangerous for swimming, but the sight of the mountain surrounded ocean alone makes it worth staying at the beach. Don’t bring expensive or valuable stuff. If you wear swimsuit under some cheap cloth, little cash and a towel You are fully equipped for a wonderful day. My photo is taken from a building because I didn’t bring my phone or camera to the beach at all.

reviews.title: Better than Copacabana
reviews.text: Much better than the Copacabana Beach. No skyscrapers casting shadows after 3PM. Better view of the mountains to the right. Amazing! Can’t really swim though.

reviews.title: Srunning
reviews.text: I stayed here with my sister and cousin and it is beautiful. Very safe area and the restaurants and shops in this area are brilliant. The beach itself is very clean, very safe and beautiful. A great area to stay in, would recommend it to anyone visiting Rio.

reviews.title: Day at the beach
reviews.text: it is safer than Copacabana, waves vize, but pickpokets are everywhere. Waves are calmer, you can make amazing photos there.

reviews.title: Another beautiful beach
reviews.text: Rio is probably the envy of almost every oceanfront city in the world.  Not only does it have one world class beach, but two.  Both Copacabana and Ipanema are among the best beaches that we have ever visited.  We spent most of our time on Copacabana because our hotel was there, but Ipanema may well be the better of the two.  You can't lose no matter which one you choose.

reviews.title: THE beach to be
reviews.text: I’ve been there three times already and the view on the two brothers has no comparison in the world!

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: We were staying in Leme which is at the northern end of Cococabana but walked down to Ipanema Beach for the day.  It is well worth the effort.  The water is magnificent.  Got a couple of chairs and an umbrella for R30 which is about 10 dollars. Beers are cheap and it’s easy to get something to eat should you want to. There are a lot of beach vendors walking around but you just politely wave them off if you don’t want to purchase anything.  Great day.

reviews.title: A True Gem
reviews.text: I've been to many tropical locations with my family and due to my aversion to heat I rarely enjoy the beaches. Ipanema is the exception. Clean, white beaches that are full of vendors and cheap places to rent chairs and umbrellas (most of which have wifi) and people drinking coconut water out of coconuts is a common sight. The sand was unlike any sand I've come across, easy to pack down like brown sugar, so it's ideal for sand castles and beach sports. The only thing is that someone told my father not to bring fancy phones, credit cards or leave even your basics unattended. Also, since our hotel happened to be equidistant to Copacabana, I'd say that Ipanema is much more enjoyable.

reviews.title: A must do thing if you’re visiting Rio
reviews.text: An iconic beach and a bit more upscale that Copabacana. There’s lots going on - people doing sport, people selling all sorts of food and beach necessities, people asking if you want drinks which didn’t seem too unreasonably priced. A polite “no thanks” gets them to move on and if you buy something, they’re your friend for life. The sand is very clean, no rocks etc and the sea is warm enough to swim in and with quite big waves which make it fun but it’s still safe. The toilets are in the life guard buildings. Apparently the closer to posto 9 you get, the trendier you are!

reviews.title: Postcard worthy
reviews.text: This is a great beach. Good for swimming most of the time. Be careful with your things. We stayed beachfront between post 9 and 10. Absolutely wonderful. Evening run was amazing. What inspiration. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, great surfing and waves and variety. Spoiled only by the constant beach sellers shouting and badgering all day

reviews.title: Best beach of Rio
reviews.text: Clean, beautiful and the people are even more beautiful. It's a very nice people to take your kids, they will nuts, for sure. People will try to sell you everything, but evenwhile doing so, cariocas are the coolest people ever.

reviews.title: Preferred it over copacabana beach
reviews.text: For me this was a nicer experience than the copocabanna beach. It is much deeper and seems therefore less cluttered. I also found that you are hassled a lot less here by sellers which was a welcome distraction after copacabana. Lush golden sand with the perfect view, not much more you could ask for!

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach in Rio de Janeiro
reviews.text: Beautiful Beach in Rio de Janeiro, located in a nice neighborhood that includes a large modern multilevel shopping center. Similar to Copacabana, long beach with large sidewalks and a principal avenue. Adjacent to Leblon neighborhood where the big shopping center is located. This is a large open, public beach that includes the Ipanema and Leblon neighborhoods.

reviews.title: I come here to admire my crush
reviews.text: There is a girl that I see there and she is so gorgeous and graceful but I spaghetti out every time I see her and I can never think of a way to go over there and start a conversation with her. I'm pretty sure she doesn't even notice me. Ah well. Cool beach though.

reviews.title: Best Sunset you will see on your life!
reviews.text: Ipanema beach is know worldwide for having one of the most amazing views. The Two Brothers Hill at the end of the beach set the scenery for one of the best, most instagramable, sunsets in town! If you decide to come early to enjoy sometime at the beach, be sure to taste Mate Gelado (Iced Mate Tea) and have a Biscoito Globo from one of the many vendors that walk by on the beach.If you need any help during your stay, I'm Vinny from @BrazilExperienceTours get in touch with us through any social media and we'll gladly help you on your stay in Rio.

reviews.title: A gorgeous beach
reviews.text: Like its sister beach, Copacabana, this is an iconic Rio MUST DO. Beautiful soft sand, gorgeous bronzed bodies and a warm sea. Different from Copacabana in that the waves seem bigger. Stroll along the promenade or hire a motorized scooter and just enjoy.

reviews.title: Great place to surf, swim exercise or hang out
reviews.text: Spent time here every day of our stay in Rio. On the Sunday morning the roads along Ipanema and Copacabana beaches were closed to traffic, and we joined a great crowd of runners and cyclists getting some exercise in the sun. Plenty of space (and company) to run on other days too. Nice sunsets (though over the land, not the sea). And it seemed pretty safe.

reviews.title: Spent one afternoon on Ipanema Beach
reviews.text: A friend of ours lives in a condo on ocean front on Ipanema Beach.  We visited him one afternoon our first day in Rio.  This beach is a great place to stay.   View from his ocean front patio was absolutely beautiful.  We only spent a few hours at Ipanema Beach, but highly recommend the area.   There are a lot of nice restaurants to walk to in the area.   Every place we went to in Brazil had fresh squeezed juices.  Also, every place we went to in Brazil took our American MasterCard.

reviews.title: Only in Rio
reviews.text: Only in Rio could you be offered illicit drugs as well as a cold beer as you lounge on the golden sand. With the waves crashing into the shore my mate and I were twice offered illegal drugs and we sipped on a cold frothy after completing the Rio Marathon. No thanks mate I said to them and the other fifty pedlars of various good from hat and sunglasses to massages and watches. Thank goodness for the surf at Ipanema which was absolutely fantastic. The waves were vicious! It was great rehab after the run and it was a truly beautiful setting. The hawkers did ruin it a bit but when in Rio.....

reviews.title: beautiful but unsafe!!
reviews.text: I loved ipanema beach, specially the walk path but it is a bit unsafe.. if you are going for swim don't leave your stuff alone.. you might be robbed !!!! the rest its spectacular !!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Very nice beach, visited by all ages and nationalities.Many nice little bars and cheap comfortable chairs with or without umbrella.

reviews.title: Bucket list tick!
reviews.text: Just couldn't be in Rio and not stop for a short while to view Ipanema beach. yes it was a Sunday so beach very busy but we were still able to appreciate it's beauty.

reviews.title: Too touristy?
reviews.text: Too touristy?Well, if sells Caipirinhas on the beach (a good thing in my eyes) but you do get hassled a fair amount as a tourist, with locals pushing drinks, deck chairs, jewellery etc on you regularly Great views though,  and cleaner than I had feared. We got there just in time for sunset,  and watched the view change completely in 15 minutes (see photos), which I would recommend. Not sure I would want to stay long after dark, mind.

reviews.title: Praia Ipanema got my heart forever!
reviews.text: Amazing beach, clean, safe, tourists friendly, I even lost 5 Kg (seeing Brazilians so driven by sports, I got myself a PT and got back in shape), overall I left Rio...in love with Rio! We'll be back sooner than later!

reviews.title: Gotta go to the white sand beach
reviews.text: We went very early in the morning and the beach was all ours.  You must go, it's incredibly beautiful.

reviews.title: Beautiful and fun beach
reviews.text: White and beach with beautiful views of the mountains to the south and three island right inf front of you, that make it very ubique. The sunset in this area is to die for because the sun hides behind the mountains that has a very exotic shape, so that in itself is already pretty. As any other public beach they have the good and bad, tons of you people playin volleyball or foot ball, music, people running and of course street vendors.The sell the famous female swim suits, and also a delicious grilled cheese, they do it right in from of you and they sell the as an skewer, They also sell cold coconuts and grilled shrimps. It is cheap to get chairs and umbrella, some hotels give it to you.

reviews.title: Great place to chill!
reviews.text: Ipanema beach is a post card of Rio de Janeiro! The beach is beautiful and a mandatory place to go! As a "Carioca da Gema" I would recommend visiting Ipanema`s Beache on a week day, once in the weekends it is too crowded! But if you only have the weekend you can go there early in the morning or in the last ours of the sun, just don't leave Rio without this experience!

reviews.title: It could be better
reviews.text: Ipanema is a very expensive place but the beach wasn’t cleaned enough to get more than three stars. I saw trash on the streets every where I went.

reviews.title: Nice beach, good eateries and fun shopping in Ipanema
reviews.text: It is fun to stroll around Ipanema Beach, clean beach, lot of restaurants and shops around the beach and in the Ipanema area. You can easily spend half a day just strolling around the area. orth a visit.

reviews.title: Nice views!
reviews.text: The best is use a scooter and troll from copacabana all the way to Ipanema and back! Awesome experience!

reviews.title: WOW!  Just wow!
reviews.text: Everything that you could ever want from a beach is here!  Beautiful sand, food, jewelry, local goods, beach showers....just amazing!

reviews.title: Very disappointing
reviews.text: We walked for a while from copacobana beach to here as have always wanted to visit this. What a let down - the beach is small and crowded with no refreshment areas. Not worth the walk - copacobana is superior in many ways.

reviews.title: Nice , but should improve the infrastructure
reviews.text: In general it’s a nice beach , but the infrastructure to be improved , not enough toilets, an access to the beach from the road is very difficult and it’s seems like the municipality had no desire to improve the maintenance of the area around.

reviews.title: Beautiful and clean!!
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach....clear blue waters and golden sand..great for families...sunday morning stroll was very nice and safe... al ot of top notch hotels in this area!!

reviews.title: Awesome beach, dangerous water tho
reviews.text: The beach lives up to the hype, its beautiful, so clean and a great place to spend the day.The vender can get annoying on the beach but not to bad. Be careful swimming as the waves can get big and the current is strong

reviews.title: Ipanema baby..
reviews.text: The famous Ipanema Beach. Beautiful beach much better and quiter than Copa. Big and clean with the most beautiful people of Rio. Every where they play football and have more  tourists.arpoador Ipanema and leblon is one beach in reality and the walking street on the beach is something special. This is the place to be in Rio de janeiro

reviews.title: Just what we expected and no disappointment
reviews.text: If you are in Rio you HAVE to walk on this beach. It's just a nice beach with beach cafes along it and atmospheric because it is an iconic location.

reviews.title: A girl at Ipanema
reviews.text: The place to go for local brasileiros2nd most famous beach in BrazilExpect a quite different athmosphere.

reviews.title: Wonderful beach
reviews.text: My husband and I spent most of our sunbathing here at Ipanema beach, while there were many vendors, we found it to be less crowded and more relaxing than Copacabana beach. You can get everything you want at the comfort of your beach towel or chair from beer, cocktails, shrimp skewers, coconut juice, empanadas, etc. We also went back to Marcelo, the chair and umbrella vendor right by Post 9, he was very nice and accommodating and always checked up on us to see if we needed anything more to drink.

reviews.title: Less crowded than Copacabana
reviews.text: We walked to Ipanema Beach after our lunch at Copacabana. It took us about 20 minutes walk from Posto 5. Ipanema Beach was less crowded and cleaner compare to Copacabana. There were less street vendors selling things to you and less restaurants on the beach. I have been told by a local to avoid Posto 8 and 9 as it is not safe especially at night.

reviews.title: beachin out..
reviews.text: muito bom!worth seeing for. recommending to everyone. worth your time. relaxing and beatiful. chill😁

reviews.title: A very good and clean beach
reviews.text: It was a Sunday and our first day in Rio. We visited both Copacabana and ipenema beach. Both were very busy but Ipanema had class. It appeared much cleaner and the crowd better. The white sands and the deep blue sea add to the charm of this place. The atmosphere was great .This beach is worth visiting.

reviews.title: Just go!
reviews.text: It's not a trip to Rio unless to stop by to see the "girl from Ipanema"! Great waves, beautiful sand and Brazilian people abound. Put on your swimsuit and spend the afternoon here. Enjoy!

reviews.title: dream
reviews.text: Nice place to swim. Behave isa ocean beach, can be brought, in which case they put red flags along the beach

reviews.title: Nicest beach I have come across
reviews.text: Lovely white sand.. maybe 100m in depth.  Lovely atmosphere.. stunning scenery. Also it felt quite safe but of course as anywhere, keep an eye on your stuff!

reviews.title: Best beach in Rio
reviews.text: Although I stayed in copacabana, I must say ipanema has better views and is less crowded.  The hotel and restaurant prices are higher which probably makes this beach more exclusive for tourists.  It’s really only about half an hour away from copacabana by foot.

reviews.title: Girl of Ipanema
reviews.text: If you want crowded beach, with many famous places in Rio (Girl of Ipanema, Posto 9 (GLS), Farme de Amoedo, General Osório Square etc). Watch out because during the weekend there are many pickpockets around!

reviews.title: Young and free
reviews.text: Had kots of fun here, definitely seems like where the younger Brazilians hang out. Never felt unsafe at any point.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Much nicer than copacabanna beach....area is full of legs to shopping nearby.  This time of year is great in that it’s not crowded and still warm

reviews.title: Sandy, very sandy
reviews.text: Great beach, white sand, clear sea, coconuts and cocktails. What else do you need. Also, its a pretty safe beach just dont leave your phone or valubles unattended, which sounds obvious but as we all know, people are stupid.

reviews.title: World famous beach 🏝
reviews.text: World famous beach, facilities are okay but local people claim the showers and make tourist pay to use it. Pay attention!

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach, but just that, a beach.
reviews.text: I tend to give really realistic reviews, so I won't change it up for this. The beach is really pretty and of course being on the ocean is nice, however, it is only a beach. A very crowded one at that. Bring comfortable walking shoes and avoid the street food vendors. They don't always wash their hands and you're not meant to drink tap water in Brasil which they often use to wash the fruit for the drinks.

reviews.title: So much beautiful sand.
reviews.text: We walked along the side of the beach which was a lovely expanse of clean sand with lots of beds and umbrellas for hire. There were also vendors continually offering food and cool drinks to the sun worshippers. If water sports are for you there were a number of activities to participate in.Yet another iconic place well worth visiting.

reviews.title: relaxing beach with lots of food options
reviews.text: wonderful place to enjoy the sunshine and all the food options that are available. the vendors come to you so no need to walk around looking for food and drink, that's nice. there are no change rooms so go in your swimwear when you're planning on a beach day.

reviews.title: Classic
reviews.text: A beautiful and world renowned beach, just be sure to stay safe. People will try to sell you drugs at certain parts of the beach, and the cops don't care.

reviews.title: Go to this part of the beach for "me" time
reviews.text: Ipanema beach is quieter and you get space from other people.
