There are still some let's say "unique" people on the beach like the white trustafarians (rich western hippies) sleeping in a binbag but that's not Brazil's fault, blame the parents (and if those parents are reading, I think you should give me your kids' trust fund money and I will make good use of it).The sand was lovely (hot!) and the water lovely. It's the more peaceful stretch of the beach. I will refrain from using the word "boring" but it's sitting there in the subconscious. I will however use the word "middle class". It's less lively.

reviews.title: The girl from Manchester hits ipanema
reviews.text: Great beach, not threatening and good shops two streets back. We were told to go to the fasano hotel end from our hotel in Barra great tip. Nice bars and restaurants.

reviews.title: Walking with the girl and the boy and the people from Ipanema
reviews.text: Sunday mornings the motor traffic along Ipanema is rerouted and the street is given over to walkers, runners, skaters and bicyclists to enjoy the sun and breeze along the beach. A wonderful pageant of young and old.

reviews.title: STUNNING
reviews.text: It is a lovely, but very touristy place. The beach bars along here and Copacabana are great for a light snack and drink during the day. If you are lucky (like me) you may get involved in a game of football or volley-ball with the locals. If not, its easy enough to spend a day or evening here in the sun or water (it is beautiful clear). Well worth a visit as beaches go it is easily one of the most beautiful I have seen.

reviews.title: Cleaner and Peaceful version to Copacabana
reviews.text: Sand:Whiter sands than compared to Copacabana; and softer.Water:Seemed cleaner and more clear. Tides weren't as strong as CopacabanaAmbiance:Had more of a hippy, artsy, peaceful vibe. Copa was more lively and energetic.Less vendors on the beach and restaurants on the strip; but still had a handful to address invidual needs.  Distance:From Windsor Martinique (Copacabana area); it is more accurately 20-25 mins with a normal pace of walking to Ipanema Beach. Hotel said it would be just 5-10 mins. I don't thinks so but maybe if you are a fast walker. Then again, things often seem like a shorter distance when you are familiar with the neighbourhood. I timed it to get a general reading of distance vs time so that I know for the next time I visit.There is the main beach. Behind it is another smaller beach; it is more secluded and has a nice view of the Rio landscapes. At the end of the main beach is rocky cliff where you can sit to enjoy the mountain views and the stretch of the full beach; you can also tan here and absorb the sun rays, as I did without getting wet or sand in my shorts. Definitely a more quiet alternative to Copacabana. And in general, Ipanema and its neighbourhood is suppose to be a lot more chic and higher class than the copacabana  area.

reviews.title: great beach
reviews.text: Upscale beach in an upscale neighborhood. Some levels up from Copacabana beach in a sense that it is just more touristy. Cannot get to this part of town easily by public transportation: taxi or rental car only. Great upscale shops, restaurants around. Very pleasant and pleasing. And very relaxing. Copacabana is happening and hopping by contrast.

reviews.title: Beautiful wide beach
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful wide, white sand beach. Good for an early morning walk. By 11 am you cannot see the water with the many merchants setting up shop in front of you.

reviews.title: Great Beach!
reviews.text: We Love Ipanema beach!Great water to swim in with a fantastic beach vibe!Many vendors with food, drink & bikinis!

reviews.title: Ipanema FASHION
reviews.text: The best beach in Rio, south zone. Not only regarding the clear water but also the updated people who usualy to go there to practise sports like " altinha", frescoball, volleyball and sunbathing with the most fashion beach wear. Vendors go back and for selling all sort of stuff. Big view of Vidigal favela and best sunset ever from Arpoador rockstone on one side of the beach. Do not leave your belongin alone in the sand while swimming.

reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text: I really liked this beach! The government has provided lots of sport facilities such as football courts, volleyball nets and training equipment. There are many "barracas" ( tents or huts) where vendors sell drinks and food. I enjoyed taking a walk along this beach.. I had a surf lesson at Arpoador as well.

reviews.title: A spectacular view!
reviews.text: Ipanema Beach is one of the most amazing places you'll ever have a chance to experience. It has a unique blend of nature&cosmopolitan flair, that kind of gets under your skin, and you're instantly overwhelmed by it. You can spend the whole day or just a few hours, but don't miss: going into the sea, having a splash in the waves; drinking some "Caipirinha" (from the kiosks at the sidewalk); just sit by the sidewalk and watch how the Brazilians enjoyed the beach, the "calcadao", as they call it, and finally don't miss the sunset from The Arpoador point.

reviews.title: Always wonderful
reviews.text: Going to Ipanema beach during the week is great as the crowds are there in general in the weekends. I did stand up paddle last time in Posto 8, and it was awsome! Loved it! The water was crystal clear!

reviews.title: The beach is relaxing
reviews.text: We had some chairs for 10 r each and went into the sea to jump the waves . There is great scenery around and sport going on everywhere on the beach . The sea isn’t cold and the beach is sandy but the can shower off the sand . There are many sellers of food and drink plus clothes . Could become annoying after a while .

reviews.title: One of Rio's iconic beaches.
reviews.text: This is one of the special locations to visit when in Rio. Particularly during the Southern Hemisphere summer months. When there you will see loads of local people enjoying their beautiful beach. They will be doing all kinds of things particularly playing ball. And you will see plenty of the iconic tanga swimming costumes. On the subject of personal safety and security - the rules of common sense apply. Thus try not to look like an obvious tourist. Dress down. Don't wear flashy expensive clothing nor jewelery. No expensive cameras to be visible. Don't do anything stupid. Then you should be OK. You are sure to enjoy this beautiful beach. We can't wait to go back in early 2020.

reviews.title: Love this beach
reviews.text: Full of locals and the best vibes all day long! Great for people watching and watching the world go by! Cheap to rent chairs and a umbrella

reviews.title: Prettier and more chilled
reviews.text: I found this beach more chilled and nicer than copacabana. There are also plenty of places to eat, drink etc nearby

reviews.title: One of the best
reviews.text: If you ask me which is better Ipenema or Copacabana, I prefer Ipenema, less crowded, better athmosphere.

reviews.title: One of my favorite city beaches in the world. So far at least (~;
reviews.text: One of my favorite city beaches in the world. So far at least (~;The water looked clean, the beach sand was soft and pretty darn clean all considered. We stayed in front of Posto 8 and had the best view of a double rainbow our second day. Unforgettable.

reviews.title: Not as busy
reviews.text: Ipanema is a more upmarket area of Rio , so if you want to escape the tourist masses of Copacabana beach then this is definitely the option , it's quieter but still has a great beach with football & volleyball "matches" on the go all the time. Next to Arpoador Rock , which is famous for sunsets. Also numerous vendors selling their refreshments & souvenirs on/along the beachfront

reviews.title: The song beach
reviews.text: Ipanema beach is quite better than Copacabana if you want to swim and maybe this is the reason why the famous song speaks about a girl on this beach and not on another one. Fabulous place but take always care about personal belongs.

reviews.title: Beautifu, Clean and Sereal Place
reviews.text: I was staying in Copacabana Beach. I took a a subway metro to Ipanema just to lazz around the beach and also to shop around. The beach is more cleaner and less populated than Copacabana. It is a must visit in your list of places to visit in Rio.

reviews.title: Amazing Views and Big Waves
reviews.text: We went to Ipanema Beach when it was hot outside, and the cold water was just what we needed. We didn't even need to ease into it; it felt that great. The waves are enormous sometimes, and they will bring you under. I recommend staying close to shore if possible. The beach was very clean, white sandy beach and clear waters.  The views of the mountains are breathtaking. You can rent chairs and umbrella if need be, and there are places to get a drink or food nearby. This beach is just a 10-minute walk give or take from Copa Cabana Beach. Going to Ipanema was one of the most memorable and fun times I had in Rio.

reviews.title: Second best beach
reviews.text: Sorry Ipanema but we prefer Copacabana! This is still a lovely beach but somehow not quite as vibrant.

reviews.title: It's a beach
reviews.text: The beach area is quite expansive. There is a lot of development along this stretch of coastline taking in Copacabana and Ipanema.  I did notice a very sensible thing - water was being sprayed along parts of the beach to allow beachgoers to walk on the otherwise very hot sand.  For us we're not great sun-worshippers so it was a matter of just walking along and having a look.

reviews.title: Tall and tan and young and lovely....maybe
reviews.text: Even though Not tall, tan, young I LOVED Ipanema Beach. Especially loved the unique walkway the length of the beach. It was a hot, humid day and we had just finished shopping in the Ipanema Hippie Market. What a great day in Rio!

reviews.title: Best beach ever
reviews.text: I have been to a lot of beaches but none hold a candle to Ipanema. The water is warm. The waves are strong. The sand is clean and fine. And there is nothing floating around in the water. No seaweed like you get on the California beaches. Plus anything you need to eat or drink is brought to you.

reviews.title: Beautiful but a lot of thievery.
reviews.text: Please, please, please do go to Ipanema Beach if you go to Rio, but don't take much with you. Don't flaunt cell-phones or a lot of money or other expensive stuff. Don't wear expensive jewellery or any jewellery. ALWAYS rent a chair and probably an umbrella from one of the baraccas lining the sidewalk and keep your things in a beach bag and tie it to your chair or umbrella he baracca workers will often keep an eye out for your stuff, but don't count on it. If you or both of you or all of you leave your spot to go in the ocean ask someone close by to keep an eye on your things. I have witnessed stealing every day this trip. Its very bad, the worst I have seen in 8 years. The main culprits are the cigarette sellers who wander the beaches scouting out careless people. They work in gangs and keep in touch with each other on cell-phones. THEY ARE DANGEROUS. They swarm like piranha when they have spotted a chair that has some-one's things on it and one by one they will swoop in until they get what they want. It all happens very subtly and very quickly. Usually all the people around don't see a thing. Just be careful! Evidently (on hear-say) the favela chiefs have made a deal with the police that they have free reign of the beach and the police stay up on the sidewalks.

reviews.title: Nice beach but horrible people
reviews.text: We visited Ipanema beach on a weekend with local people and it was terrible it's dangerous you have to be very careful of your stuff otherwise it's 100% sure the will rob you and the people there was horrible seems like the people from the favelas come to the beach...anyway the beach is nice  but i didn't like the people and there were many vendors selling whatever you can imagine it's fine because you don't have to bring anything but your presence and you can eat and drink as much as you want for good prices.

reviews.title: Great beach with big waves
reviews.text: All of the beaches have people who will get you chairs, umbrellas, drinks etc and they are very reasonably priced. As there are lots of people who do it the prices are very standard. Some of them offer wifi and will watch your things when you go for a swim. The waves can be large and the rip currents can be dangerous so not the best for small children.

reviews.title: Ipanema beautiful beach
reviews.text: Very nice place to stay. Manu hotel..restaurants...shopping...and tua beautiful beach of Ipanema. One of the best

reviews.title: Horrid
reviews.text: This is awful non stop vendors beggars no decent beach restaurants no way to relax on this beachViews are beautiful but better go elsewhere

reviews.title: Ipanema Stay
reviews.text: If you visit Rio I recommend staying in Ipanema - the beaches are clean, the location is central and safe.

reviews.title: one of the best in the world
reviews.text: Ipanema is quite calming and less lively than copacabana but you really get to enjoy the beach and the calm here. The hotels like sofitel provide their own cabanas and the beach is beautiful. The sands are fine, waters are warm, this is the ideal beach.

reviews.title: Iconic Beach
reviews.text: Try the green coconut water for a very refreshing break when the weather is really warm. Sand is lovely.

reviews.title: Nice but fairly unsafe
reviews.text: Perhaps the nicest beach in Rio de Janeiro. Wavy sea, not suited for kids. Fairly clean water. One of the costliest neighborhoods in Brazil. But beware of thieves, especially on weekends. A pity!

reviews.title: It’s a beach...
reviews.text: Went for a look at Ipanema beach and a bit of a walk around. Lots of blokes renting umbrellas and beach chairs, selling drinks etc. There is no doubt it is a lovely beach but when all is said and done, it’s just a beach.

reviews.title: Great way to spend an afternoon or two!
reviews.text: Our hotel was literally around the corner so we visited the beach quite a bit over the week. A great place to watch people! Lots of local ‘tents’ offering you chairs, parasols for not too much money.....great caipirinhas! We enjoyed the area between posts 9 & 10....you can buy endless drinks, snacks, sandwiches and even sunglasses, lotion & bikinis. The surf is fun but take care of the undertow. Beach is fairly clean and there is a fresh water shower hose. Weekends get busy.

reviews.title: Relax
reviews.text: Take time to rest and sun in this beach. Just take care, don´t use anything made by gold or something that looks like, maybe a boy running can take it from you.

reviews.title: great beach !
reviews.text: Not only is this a great clean beach but the vendors are great! you can by all kinds of handmade gifts and art directly from the local artists. Take note of the mosaic sidewalks, awesome!

reviews.title: Very nice beach with friendly Brasilians
reviews.text: If body culture is a statement, than you have to be here. Well shaped young girls AND guys are parading none stop on the beach and the pavement. But also people of all ages with not such great bodies walk around without caring at all: everybody is relaxed and happy.

reviews.title: Better than Copacabana
reviews.text: We were staying in Copacabana, not far from Ipanema. I thought Ipanema beach was a better beach to visit; it was cleaner, less busy, a bit more vibrant and the area seemed overall a bit "classier". I think that is down to the fact it's slightly more residential that touristy. We walked along the beach a few times (not really the type to sit there for hours) and it was always pleasant and enjoyable.

reviews.title: Great time!!
reviews.text: I love Brazil. Ipanema was just great. The beach was clean and water fresh. Just the waves were quite big. I’m not sure if I would take my kids with me. We always hired little chairs on the beach, the drinks are very cheap and the staff look after you. We only met friendly people ... We had a great time!

reviews.title: Dull
reviews.text: The beach was quite and nice enough, not much entertainment in this area. Found that it was more suited to retired older folk.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: It was a little over cast the day we walked along the beach but we stopped for a tall boy (473mL Brahma Beer for $6R) and enjoyed the scenery. There were a lot of people starting to crowd in and they had nets up for FootVolley (very cool to watch)

reviews.title: Wish I had stayed here
reviews.text: Only drove through Ipanema because we were staying back at Copacabana. It looks great - clean and tidy much better on the eye than Copa.

reviews.title: Ipanema is THE BEST!!
reviews.text: There are 4 beaches in the main tourist area of Rio:  Leme, Copacabana, Ipanema, and Leblon in that order (with Leme at the furthest edge, followed by Copa, etc.).  My favorite beach is Ipanema.Copacabana and Ipanema beaches meet at a point.  For example, consider the left side of this page Copa beach, and the top edge of this page Ipanema beach.  Leblon is then to the right of Ipanema, meaning Ipanema is in the middle.  So, it's very easy to travel to other beaches when you're in the middle.Copa seems to be more for older adults and families, whereas Ipanema had a younger, hipper vibe and is where folks play a lot of beach volleyball.  Additionally, if you want to see some of the most beautiful people in the world, Ipanema would be it in my opinion.Copacabana has a small shopping strip where local vendors sell souvenirs, etc., but again, you can get there by being at Ipanema.  TIPS:- Rent a bike or electric scooter and you can ride all along the coast and see all 4 beaches.- If possible, stay at a place overlooking the tip of Copa and Ipanema with a view of the water.  You'll get to see both beaches and some amazing sites.  Otherwise, stay in Leblon.  Tons to do there.- While on Ipanema, be sure to stop at a local stand and drink directly from a cold coconut.  It's the best coconut water in the world!

reviews.title: Nice view at sunset
reviews.text: If you can make it here in time for the sunset on a good day, then it's worth it. I took some memorable pictures here. Worth the walk from Copacabana.

reviews.title: The up-and-coming beach area
reviews.text: I think the Copacabana beach and corniche is nicer. But get off the main drag and Ipanema offers better shopping, food, etc.

reviews.title: head here for the evening Rio sunshine
reviews.text: a beautiful stretch of beach with island views and it keeps the sun after it goes behind the buildings at Copacabana

reviews.title: Best beach in Rio
reviews.text: The Ipanema beach is much better than Copacabana beach, just 10 minutes away.There are different secions.

reviews.title: Just a beach
reviews.text: If you come from a country that doesnt have beaches it would be good.   Australia has excellent beaches and to be excited about a beach in another country they have to be world class to beat our average beaches, especially if you have to pay for a spot on the beach. (sorry to sound a bit arrogant but its the truth)  The best part was the stalls where they served the Caipirinhas (local drink)  Fantastic.

reviews.title: Nice beach!
reviews.text: Go to the beach in the morning, in the afternoon it get's very busy. Rent umbrella and chairs for the beach at the vendor's. Very nice beach.

reviews.title: Day at the beach
reviews.text: Nice sunny day, clean and warm waters. Lots of vendors decent food and drinks available, would highly recommend

reviews.title: Great beach for perfect sunset photos
reviews.text: Ipanema is one of the places where you can take the most beautiful sunset photos.  There are a lot kiosks line up on the pretty mosaic lined sidewalk, and you can grab a cold drink and watch people from all ages, sizes and shapes enjoying themselves. Do be careful at nighttime because there is crime in the area, stay off the beach late night and rather walk on the promenade side where it I safer.

reviews.title: Ipanema Girl
reviews.text: Beautiful beach.   So many gorgeous looking young people on the beach. Also families with children.  A bit sophisticated crowd than Copacabana Beach.  I could stay here longer time just chilling.

reviews.title: Gorgeous Beach
reviews.text: One of the most famous beaches in the world and it is very beautiful. Plenty of activities to see and do on the beach. Run along the coast line or street that borders this coastline is a great run as well. There are games of all sorts being played on the beach as well. Amazing pictures to be taken here as well. Disclaimer I  came in 2016 when I visited Brazil for the 2016 Olympics

reviews.title: Ipanema in the sun and the rain
reviews.text: Certainly the beaches in Rio are very special and the number of people and beauty depends on the weather.The tides and surf are not for the faint hearted and can be very strong, with dangerously high waves.Great for photography, but less so for swimming.Others commented on trash on the beach - that wasn’t too noticeable, but the pavements needed some repair. But that is the same throughout most of the city.Did like the use of spraying water along strips of the beach to walk on, keeping feet cool and giving a firm base to walk on - very sensible.A must see if the are Rio, with good weather.Not much to see or photograph in the rain.

reviews.title: wide beach with great sane,  lots of trash on the beach
reviews.text: Excellent beach from other beaches.  very hot but the water was cool.  Dangerous rip tides.  Disappointed with the amount of trash on the beach

reviews.title: Fantastic beach
reviews.text: This beach is quieter than copacabana but still beautiful. Nice breeze as well to help with the heat.

reviews.title: A pale shadow of the beach that inspired the song
reviews.text: The maior seems to have abandoned the city and the beach suffers from it.The sidewalks have huge holes, the dirt is everywhere and you don’t feel safeBut nature can’t be changed and the beach is still beautiful

reviews.title: The best beach in south zone
reviews.text: The best beach in  souh zone area in Rio de Janeiro city. Beautiful people, good kiosks and excellent Caipirinha.

reviews.title: Iconic beach!
reviews.text: We hired bikes and spent the morning cycling up and down Ipanema. We loved it and found it a bit more upmarket than Copacabana!

reviews.title: Fantastic beach, amazing sunset
reviews.text: Ipanema beach is a very famous place in Rio and very worthwhile visiting. Around the corner from the famous Copacabana, Ipanema beach is even more beautiful. Prices are slightly higher here then in Copacabana, and if you are clearly a tourist, be aware local sellers will definitely charge you a higher price (potentially twice as much) as they would a local for something like a beach towel. The most amazing thing about Ipanema is the sunset. This is a review, but there are barely words to describe the beauty of this sunset, with the backdrop of the mountains and the buskers filling the air with music as you stroll along the pristine sands of Ipanema.

reviews.title: Best one in Rio!
reviews.text: Definitely enjoyed it more than Copacabana. The sand is white and the water is turquoise. There was a beautiful sunset! Many places to eat too!

reviews.title: Must see it but there are better places for a beach day
reviews.text: We went during Carnaval so it’s probably different at other times. It was a great beach but a lot of people and vendors aggressively approaching everywhere. We found that Flamengo Beach was much more enjoyable.

reviews.title: best beach in Rio
reviews.text: Very nice beach. Not so narrow as Copacabana, but with Cleaner water and not so crowded. there was a lot of people on beach during Carnival, however it was possible to find place near sea.

reviews.title: Beautiful beaches and sights everywhere
reviews.text: We lucked out with the gorgeous weather to see this beach and Copacabana. People everywhere. The water and waves were quite nice as well. There were a lot of vendors selling anything from food and drinks to sunglasses and smokes. The boardwalk is as cool as you see in the pictures. Btw - If you're from the USA or Canada be prepared for a lot of skin.

reviews.title: A new kid in town
reviews.text: This beautiful beach is taking over from Copacabana,  it is becoming more trendy and more upscale catering for more modern clientele...

reviews.title: One of the many things you must see when visiting Rio
reviews.text: Beautiful clean beach with many places to stop for drinks and souvenir shopping. Just keep your bags firmly in your hands as there are pickpockets

reviews.title: Beautiful stunning views and amazing clear water!
reviews.text: I recently visited this amazing  beach made famous by Antonio Carlos Jobim a Brazilian singer who wrote the song about The girl on Ipanema that was made internationally famous by Santana, the Brazilians are so proud they named the international airport in Rio after him 🎼The beach is really clean lots of space to soak up the sun and swim and take some time to climb up the rocks and soak in the amazing views. Definately one to visit!

reviews.title: Worthy alternative to Copa
reviews.text: Really nice beach and definitely quieter than Copacabana. Plenty of shops etc along the front too. Slightly cleaner than Copa I thought too.

reviews.title: Anorthe great place by the beach.
reviews.text: Stayed at my favourite flat service hotel at Adagio apart hotel. They have all comforts of home!best of all, you can cook at any time,

reviews.title: Ipanema is nicer than Copacabana
reviews.text: Ipanema is a beautiful beach but after traveling around the world it is not as spectacular as I had expected

reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: Just another beautiful beach in Rio, clean sand, a little surf and plenty of sunshine,  and all the usual facilities of course.

reviews.title: Amazing beach, with good views.
reviews.text: Amazing beach with good views. Easily accessible by road. A must go in Rio. And not too crowded when we went there.

reviews.title: Unique Beach
reviews.text: For me, one of the most beautiful beaches in Rio. Besides the beauty reminds me the music: Garota de Ipanema (Girl from Ipanema)For those who like it, this is a place to admire, not just the sea, but to admire the most beautiful silhouettes both male and female. Not a place to harass, quite the opposite. Respect is good anywhere, but surely, here you will not have to fail to see, both men and women worthy of admirationThe water is generally a little cold for most of the year, but nothing to be discouraged to experience the sea, to feel the waves and to admire, from the sea, the beauty of this city so exhilaratingThe strip of sand, white and fine is good both in width and in extent.There are many street vendors, who selling everything. Particularly I do not recommend anyone to anything except drinks, because as the heat here, it is usually very intense and since it is not possible to know for sure the level of hygiene in the handling and the preservation of the products sold here, it is better to be limited to beverages, preferably industrialized ones. If you wish to eat something, there are several good restaurants nearby, where you can eat more peacefullySecurity here is better than other beaches in the city, which is not to say that you should not be aware of your belongings, especially your cell phone. Today there are waterproof protections for mobile, where you can also put small values or even copy of documents; this makes your life on the beach easier. There are chairs usually accompanied by umbrellas. If you are a visitor in the city, I think they are worth it even when they may seem a bit too expensive. They give you protect yourself from the sun and it also allows you to better protect your belongings.Coming to Rio, do not forget to visit this marvel of Rio

reviews.title: Another iconic beach
reviews.text: Walked along this beach and watched a local street party ( bloko) taking place lots of dancing ,drinking eating and music

reviews.title: perfect beach and people
reviews.text: no relaxation though as food/drinks vendors walk and shout non stop.. Still amazing :)its among the liveliest beaches i have been to.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Ipanema Beach is more upscale than Copacabana Beach which we also enjoyed. More people seem to flock to Ipanema - the place was packed. We rented two Beach chairs and an umbrella for only 30 real, for an unlimited time period. There are many vendors walking the Beach selling food and drink, bathing suits, sun screen, etc...

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: While away a few hours here - soak up the sun, watch the mad surfers. Less hectic than Copacabana and make sure you see the TomJobin statue.

reviews.title: Large Beach with Lots of Action
reviews.text: Nice clean, light sand beach. The beach was very active during our weekend plus stay: souvenir and food booths, a modern music evening concert, sunsets and muchas personas. The ocean water temperature was in the 70’s F. /22 C. The waves are powerful because of the beach’s sharp drop off. Showers are available. Water is dripped on the path from the street to the beach to keep you feet cool?  Palm trees are close to the street in case you have forgotten your umbrella; the sun is really hot. Copacabana Beach is walkable, about 2 miles/3+ km to the east.

reviews.title: Top of the list in rio
reviews.text: The first place to go in rio. Beautiful beach, beautiful people relax with some drinks and food from a kiosk or grab a chair and umbrella either way you can spend hours on this beach. When you done spend the rest of the day wondering around Ipanema itself

reviews.title: Stayed at Sofitel Hotel
reviews.text: We are now moving down the coast and will do sight seeing tours from our next hotel as part of a planned tour

reviews.title: Sun, sand, sea & people watching in a beautiful location
reviews.text: We took a walk along Ipanema beach and found it a beautiful place to appreciate the mountain views, sun, sea and warm sea. The beach has a really relaxed vibe and there is plenty of space to relax despite this being a city centre beach. There are plenty of places to rent a sun lounger and you can readily get drinks from the sales people who ply the beach carrying drinks or from the beach stalls. We stopped for a coconut (through a paper straw) at the end of the  beach which was a wonderul thing to do to stop and people watch.

reviews.title: Easy to rent umbrellas
reviews.text: And chairs. Sea is lovely right there. Vendors sell all that you would need, drinks, bikinis, snacks...vendors are helpful, not annoying.

reviews.title: Cool Vibe at Ipanema
reviews.text: Really enjoyed our time at Ipanema Beach!! Spent many days here during our stay in Rio. It is much quieter than Copacabana Beach but it provides a really cool, laid-back, artsy vibe. Something to definitely experience. The views are beautiful.

reviews.title: Well you have to, don’t you?
reviews.text: Walked round from Copacabana. Much quieter and far less commercial. Waves more powerful. People were actually surfing. Not such good waves as the west coast of France though!Iconic beach. Iconic place

reviews.title: Rubbish
reviews.text: Better than Copacabana but we still saw loads of rubbish in the sand . Wish people respected the environment more . It costs nothing to pick up your rubbish and put it in the bin instead of throwing it in the ocean or leaving it on the beach:(

reviews.title: Ioabena beach
reviews.text: A beautiful beach but you could not see the sand from all the umbrellas and people on the beach. Miles of beach with umbrellas.If you love the sand and water then you will love this beach.

reviews.title: Iconic Venue!
reviews.text: Who hasn't heard of this famous beach?  Take a stroll.  Enjoy an empanada and a beer.  Remember the Girl from Impanema?  Visit the bar where the song's composers sat an actually watched the young girl walk back and forth to the beach.  It's just a couple of blocks off the beach.

reviews.title: Ipanema over Copacabana!
reviews.text: Get the beach snacks! Don't bring a beach towel. Enjoy the radiant Brazilian sunshine and stroll along the endless stretch of beach.

reviews.title: The Girl from Ipanema Does Live Here at this Gorgeous Beach
reviews.text: Like the Bossa Nova song, you will see many beautiful people, with their skimpy bathing suits on this urban beach. It definitely attracts the upscale sunbathers and their hangers on. Many restaurants nearby and other  options.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: We stayed at a hotel walking distance to this beach. It was clean and really nice. It was great to sit on the sand and go into the water. It was crowded but not too crowded. We were very happy there.

reviews.title: J’adore!!!
reviews.text: I visited Río de Janeiro with my friend, Ipanema it’s very clean and safe, more than Copacabana. I love it and I want to come back!!

reviews.title: Really good beach
reviews.text: I visited this beach with my friend, and we liked it, very clean and safe. Water was perfect and you can see a beautiful sunset.

reviews.title: Fluffy sand of an agreeable temperature
reviews.text: The sand at Ipanema Beach is of the most fluffy variety, and its temperature also most agreeable, ideal to sit on in the evening without getting a cold bottom.

reviews.title: Sunday in Ipanema!
reviews.text: If you can chose deffinitely visit Ipanema on Sunday! It becomes pedestrian ! Plenty of acai sellers! Souvenirs sellers! Music! And people everywhere! It is nice to see all the brasilian beach life here on sunday!

reviews.title: Ipanema Beach
reviews.text: Nice beach- I liked this beach better than Copacabana beach.Only 10 min walk from Copacabana beach. I liked the area here as well- we walked into the neighborhood, found a nice coffee shop, stores, local market happening. It was nice.The beach is clean and the waves are very powerful here. The views are good. You can kind of see the favelas at the tip of the beach. The beach is long and stretches far. You can see christ the redeemer as well.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Between Copacabana and Leblon, very popular beach, long and bread, nice water colours. Look for the popular girls f Ipanema.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: A great beach. Very clean but waves very powerful. We walked from Copacabana beach which is only 5 to 10 mins walk.  First day very windy and cloudy but still beautiful.  From the beach you can see Christ the redeemer in the mountain. Locals selling on the beach.

reviews.title: Just for the view....
reviews.text: When in Rio, Ipanema Beach is obviously a must do... well I would rather say a must see, not necessary  do.Sure, the view is great, and if you want to feel the Rio vibe it is nice place.Besides that I would not recommend going there anymore...First, there is no one second, (not one really) where you do not hear one of the hundreds of beach vendors yelling... after a few hours it becomes really annoying.Second, just be careful on your personnal belongings : I was laying on my sunbed when some child tried to steal my necklace by behind. He did not succeed but he did stole my flip-flop....(yes my flip-flop..)...I went, I saw, I won't come back.

reviews.title: Great day at the beach!
reviews.text: Overall this is your typical tourist beach. There are umbrella rental options and people who walk the beach selling food/drinks, souvenirs, etc...You have to cross the street from any hotel for beach access. This is the one thing I did not like. On the other hand, it was an enjoyable atmosphere with an adjacent promenade for biking and jogging. Everyone was friendly and not too pushy when trying to sell you things. I’m not sure if any hotels accommodate for food/drink service while you are on the beach, but there are a lot of independent people who will approach you to buy cold drinks and hot food. The empanadas and cheese on a stick are delicious!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Prefer this beach to Copacabana. In a more residential area. The nicest area is in Lebron on the north end. Few high-rise hotels.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Great beach, just avoid weekends if you don't like the crowd (but it also can be an experience!). Don't take any valuable with you, ie remove ALL jewels and watch. Also perfect for a jogging on the promenade. Don't walk alone on the beach early morning or at night when it is desert. Completely ok during the day but stay where there are people... many tourists but never forget where you are!

reviews.title: Nice to see
reviews.text: We came to see the beach which we found it very clean. Went during the day on the advice of locals.Well worth a visit.

reviews.title: Great sunset at Arpoador's rock
reviews.text: Praia de Ipamena is a thriving beach located on Rio's Southern District, which has a well-known beachfront promenade and a famous scenic view over the Two-Brother's hill (morro dos Dois Irmaos) and it's favela Vidigal. On top of that, make sure not to miss the sunset at Arpoador's Rock, which is truely romantic, even if it tends to get really crowded all around at that time of the day.  Next to it is a small park where you can enjoy music and even open-air dance performing during weekend evenings. A great experience to live among Cariocas, Rio's locals.

reviews.title: Ipanema boy :)
reviews.text: I have been to many such famous beaches world wide which are famous for weather , crowd and the crowd.. Ipanema ranks towards the top... it's just pure bliss - get a cycle and bike the whole loop - something totally worth doing it - looking forward to going again !

reviews.title: Beautiful beach and beautiful people
reviews.text: Large expanse of clean white sand crowded with young people have a good time. The ocean can be a bit rough but a must see in Rio.

reviews.title: Great beach, not too overcrowded
reviews.text: We spent our first morning in Rio at this lovely beach sitting under our rented umbrella and fold-up chairs, basking in the hot baking Rio sun and drinking Vodka-caipirinhas and beers, served to us by some very attentative and good-looking waiters!With Sugar loaf mountain on our right and the busier Copacabana beach to our left, we had a fun time in the sun, interspersed with heat-relieving dips in the sea, buying sun hats, bluetooth speakers, Brazilian soccer shirts and surf bracelets from the beach hawkers that constantly crawl the beaches, looking for a sale, but are not annoying at all. I reluctantly packed up my bags after 4 hours in the sun, and was pleasantly surprised at the very reasonable rate of our rented gear and drinks tab at the end!

reviews.title: Beatiful beach, nice people
reviews.text: Don´t forget to visit Ipanema beach, maybe you could meet the girl of the famous song, hahah, if not, the beach is full of beatiful girls

reviews.title: Nothing special
reviews.text: Like Copacabana, Ipanema beaches have a great name (marketing) but in reality are so disappointing. Sea water has no clarity and seems dirty, beach is crowed with people the one next - and sometimes on the top- of the other, plus all these who sell from sun glasses to fish, lol. Difficult to find a nice spot for you under an umbrella. There are so many other much better beaches, Pepino, Itaipu, Grumari.

reviews.title: Great Sand, Clean Water
reviews.text: Ipanema beach is really pretty - the sand is soft and the water is clear. Definitely worth going because there is so much happening besides just sitting on the beach - the kids kicking soccer balls, sand volleyball and soccer ball are all interesting to watch. The negatives are: you can't leave ANYTHING in site and go to swim - it will be stolen, and there are too many vendors walking around with merchandise and food/drinks - it's non-stop yelling which gets annoying.

reviews.title: Ripped off
reviews.text: I am clearly a gringo and I ordered one pineapple caipirinha in Portuguese and the guy gave me two, second one with passion fruit. I refused to take the second one and he tried to force me to buy it till my Brazilian fiancé stepped in. Every 30seconds-1minute people walk by yelling at you to buy water, beer, food or clothes. That gets really annoying after 2 minutes and the beach is like a rubbish dump and the water had plastic in it. Too unsafe to leave your belongings on the beach and go for a swim so what’s the point?

reviews.title: Stunning but too crowded for me
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach but not easy to relax. Lots of people around and lots of sellers calling out. Beautiful beach with stunning views. Small bars on the walkway to get beers and coconuts.

reviews.title: The Sofitel has free private beds on Ipanema Beach with supervision
reviews.text: Ipanema clearly is a world class beach from the perspective of setting, sunshine, sand, surf and sea, but safety remains a concern. After sunset the mood quickly changes, we were offered drink and drugs by some of the seat vending people. During the busiest part of the day pick pockets are allegedly active - for sure there are a lot of beach boys selling stuff. We henceforth enjoyed the services of the Sofitel offering free beds with some supervision and also water bottles. They are located in the hippest area between Posto 9 and 10.

reviews.title: Pretty amazing
reviews.text: Beautiful long beach with many beach vendors. The waves can be a bit big, especially for small children, and the beach is very very very crowded (we are here in the summer). Staying at a hotel on the beach affords you a little security with the lounge chairs, umbrellas, towels and attendants all included. If you don't have that expect to pay for anything you'd like and then be very aware of what you leave on the beach while you go cavort in the water. Better to have someone always with your belongings (and don't bring anything of real value).

reviews.title: Ipanema beach
reviews.text: Well what can I say the place is packed with locals and tourists alike but beware don’t leave anything valuable with you if you are going swimming just bring you’re bare essentials like sun cream and swimsuits,plenty of vendors at the beach to sell you cool drinks on hand

reviews.title: nice beach
reviews.text: Not cool as the Copacabana Beach but still very nice. Here You find more local families and somewhat less turists. services are therefor also bit more limited.

reviews.title: Great beach, especially at sunset
reviews.text: In my view Ipanema ia a cut above Copacobana, primrily in that it is that little bit more classy.It s well worth being at the copacabana end of the beach at sunset, where there are spectacular views if you climb up on the rocks.

reviews.title: Nice stay
reviews.text: Ipanema is one of the most iconic place in Rio. It is not very different to Copacabana though. When there, get ready for the brazilian atmosphere: crowdy, happiness, football on the beach, music and of course a lot od direct sales on the beach. Enjoy them all, cause Rio is a unique place in the world.

reviews.title: Very popular
reviews.text: My observation, way too crowded.  There is a surfing school, but they keep to the side.  So you hopefully won't get hurt.

reviews.title: crowded but this added to the atmosphere
reviews.text: we visited end of december when it was really crowded, but personally liked this and added to the basic Rio experience.

reviews.title: Great Service Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: We were located on the part of the beach that is across from the Sofitel Ipanerma. the service that the beach attendants provided was great, they had a menu for food and drinks and it was reasonable priced. We enjoyed our experience so much we went back to the same spot. Their are a lot of vendors walking around but they have great deals better than the deals on the Copacabana walkway and never take the first price you can always make a deal

reviews.title: Beautiful People
reviews.text: Brazilians seem to be very comfortable in their bodies and wear what is comfortable but not necessarily attractive.  Dental floss bikinis abound.  Hot sand is sprayed with water to make it bearable for walking or playing soccer volley ball -- no hands.

reviews.title: Better sea than Copacabana
reviews.text: Better sea then Copacabana, nice colour, smaller beach than Copacabana.Nice rock on the side to take a nice photo-view

reviews.title: Best beach
reviews.text: I heard that this beach is the most popular place to see the sunset. I went every single evening to see the espectacular show . Unique experience when the sunset happens people clap . I didn’t understand why but through the time I understood that people thanked to the sun . Beach is very clean and safe.

reviews.title: Must see and enjoy
reviews.text: This is one of the top attractions in Rio.  Still along the beach and see the beautiful people from all over the world. Beware of smart young thief's.

reviews.title: Crowded beach! The Brazilian hang outs! Everybody loves this place.
reviews.text: If I loved the COPACABANA, I love this beach even more... A perfect place for family to chill... The water here is much better than that of COPACABANA and the vendors here is twice as many as that of Copa. Crowded and beautiful people around...

reviews.title: the next time I would stay close to this beach
reviews.text: Ipanema beach was on of the more confortable beachs, for me was no the best one beacuse there were a lot of people but its so confortable, there are restaurants, good people, good drink, good vibe!

reviews.title: Gay Beach Delight
reviews.text: Miriam 53 is the best location to watch the boys and maybe meet one.  The team that work at this location are trustworthy people who will attach your bag to your chair so you can enjoy the water.  Learn a little Portuguese before you go so you can engage with people.  (this beach is also affiliated with the Best Western Fashion Hotel and guests receive a chair, umbrella and towel gratis)

reviews.title: Nice beach near Copacabana
reviews.text: I'd say it's worth walking from Copacabana to Ipanema to see this place as well. it's not as busy and well known as Copacabana, but it's equally nice. It can be a better option, especially if Copacabana is crowded. it's only 15 mins walk from Copacabana

reviews.title: The place to be in the Summer
reviews.text: Best beach in the world, period. Has it all, beautiful people, music, fun, liberty, great weather, fancy places, relaxed ambient. Rio is a magical place and the meeting point for New Years. Sunset is magic and you could spend all dats relaxing in that beach and meeting new people.

reviews.title: SUNSET!!!!
reviews.text: Nice to swim but the sunset view is amazing!  Easy subway ride from Copacabana. Good restaurants in the area. Can grab a beach Pisco Sour as you watch. Hiking to The Rocks isn't necessary.

reviews.title: Beach - Sun - People
reviews.text: I like Ipanema more than Copacabana, the beach is more relaxing and with less vendors, so you can enjoy the time on the beach without people walking selling everything.

reviews.title: Only famous
reviews.text: It is not what you see in pictures.If you go for the beautiful women with exhuberantes body maybe you can see three or four but that is it.Anyway was an amazing day.Restaurants are very expensive and seafood expensive and hard to find being at the coast.It is incredible.

reviews.title: Awesome beach!
reviews.text: Much more better then Copacabana, beautiful view, a little bit crowded. If you want to see amazing sunset, you need to be there!

reviews.title: Go at Sunset
reviews.text: While copacabana gets a lot of attention, in my opinion, Ipanema is a nicer beach. The water is less wavey, you have gorgeous views and the sunset is incredible. Everyone stops to watch and applauds as the sun sets.

reviews.title: Crowded as always and too loud
reviews.text: Crowded as always and too loud Someone stole my flip flopsApparently he/she needed it CKrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrClose too 100 digits now .

reviews.title: Another famous place
reviews.text: Probably everyone has heard about this beach, but if you wanna take a rest, this is not the best place.

reviews.title: Tall and tan...The Girl from Ipanema
reviews.text: The girls from Ipanema was my father’s favorite song and this beach gave me the flavor that the song portrays. It is beautiful - more upscale than Copacabana and probably a little safer. More residents and less tourists. But not as pretty as Copacabana.

reviews.title: Copacabana’s little sister
reviews.text: Smaller, calmer and less crowded than Copacabana. The water is usually cleaner because further away from downtown.

reviews.title: Busy busy
reviews.text: Busy but better than Copacabana. We visited in the busy season after new years and Rio was packed. It's nice in the morning before 10am but then gets really crowded. Fun to people watch though. Lots of interesting characters. Beware your jewelry on the streets surrounding, I got my necklace yanked off me by a passer-by on a bike. I don't really have any other beaches besides Aus to compare it too (Aus beaches are amazing btw) but ensure u sit on something as the sand is littered with little bits of rubbish.

reviews.title: Very busy but buzzing
reviews.text: This beach is buzzing all the time, it's a gorgeous beach to walk along and enjoy a coconut at one of the beach side vendors.

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: This beach lives up to its name, it has real nice sand lovely sea however be careful the sea can be rough. The venders that provide chairs are very helpful however the chairs could do with updating as they seem old. There are a million sales people in the beach selling everything. However we couldn’t find any food to eat that we liked nerby.

reviews.title: Nice area
reviews.text: The next beach besides copacabana on walking distance. The 2 beaches have a different presenting style.

reviews.title: Awesome Beach
reviews.text: Beach was beautiful with a park nearby. Awesome views and surfing available.  More locals here than Copacabana Beach. I recommend a day out of your vacation or business trip for a quick visit to Ipanema Beach

reviews.title: Sunset on the rocks at Ipanema
reviews.text: Preferred this beach to Copacabana. Watching the sunset from the rocks that separates Ipanema and Copacabana is a must part of the trip. Felt safe on both beaches and as long as you stay in the first part of the strips do not worry about some of the things that put others off coming, very polite helpful people everywhere

reviews.title: My Happy Place
reviews.text: This is a very busy stretch of beach beside Copacabana. It’s divided into lifeguard station sections. Posto 9 is my favorite. Very eclectic and diverse. Water is quick and rough at times, but lots of fun. Basically choose the barraca you wish to serve you and they’ll place a chair and umbrella in the spot you need and bring you food and beer as you watch the parade of fit bodies stroll past. Lots of extra vendors coming by too but not pushy, some are quite entertaining. Intense sun. I wish bathrooms were more readily accessible, they appear to only be at the lifeguard station itself. Ipanema doesn’t have as many hotels lining the beach as Copacabana dies but it’s just as nice if not better.

reviews.title: Ipanema Beach Review
reviews.text: Miles and miles of beautiful sandy beach.  Well marked lifeguard stations (numbered for easy locations).   Tons of vendors for food and drink near the sidewalks.  Amazing sand sculptures also near the sidewalks. A must to visit.

reviews.title: Nice Beach
reviews.text: I am not a big beach person so I just walked by a few times to look.  Lots of people seem to love it.

reviews.title: The best beach in Rio
reviews.text: The beautiful colored umbrellas that provide needed shade also make up perhaps the most exclusive beach in the area.  Surrounding residential areas are relatively quiet but the beach is hopping!

reviews.title: Love this beach
reviews.text: Ipanema beach is the place to be during the day in Rio. It's a fab place to spend the day. So many different foods and drinks on offer and I even bought a decent bikini. The waves can get quite intense during tides, if you're into surfing then it's a bonus!

reviews.title: Another great beach
reviews.text: Great beach but as others very crowded. Epanema beach is only an easy walk to the best haviannas shop that has the best range.

reviews.title: Lovely stretch of beach more up-market than Copacabana
reviews.text: This being said, travellers need to be aware of the various "posts" starting at copacabana and stretching to the end of ipanaema as post 8 slap bang in the middle is that favoured by the favella locals and as such is very busy and prone to scams. Passers by are besieged to rent chairs, sit on the beach etc. I would head to post 9 and rent a chair if possible. The beach is narrower than copacabana and there are fewer kiosks here where you can buy eats and drinks. For us, we stayed in a copacabana hotel and stayed by the hotel pool for the sun.

reviews.title: Amazing beach but full to the brim with hawkers
reviews.text: I love this beach. The sand is white, the sea azure blue, the waves amazing but it is full of hawkers selling everything and they are very loud. At times there were as many as 10 around me all shouting their sales. so, I don't wish to put you off coming here because it is lovely but bring a good set of noise cancelling headphones with you.Many of the hotels have areas on the beach with chairs and sunshades for their guests so check with your reception before paying for these things.Ipanema beach is less touristy than Copacabana, more for the local residents but both beaches get very busy.

reviews.title: Second icon of Rio
reviews.text: Not far from Copacabana beach, can just walk or ride to get there, takes 5 minutes Probably just as good as Copacabana

reviews.title: Great place to take a stroll and for people watching
reviews.text: Nice sandy beach... great for taking a stroll and people watching.  Of course there are the beautiful people but more interesting were the athletes of various ages, shapes and sizes... some playing soccer (on disrupted sand), beach volleyball, and more impressively the new foot volleyball (where players do not use their hands but skillfully use their heads, chest, shoulders, legs, and feet.  Even saw one player make a bicycle kick at the net.Truly amazing!!!

reviews.title: Cracking beach!
reviews.text: Nice, wide, long strip of light sand. great, powerful waves (a bit too dangerous as I nearly drowned having gone in when I shouldn't have - my fault) beautiful surroundings and a great place to laze around. Loved it!

reviews.title: Crowded and dangerous
reviews.text: Just like Copacabana, crowded and dangerous, military police everywhere, Scary, best sunset, go when it gets dark.

reviews.title: More crowded than Copa
reviews.text: Ipanema has a completely different vibe than Copa Cabana. It was much more crowded on a sunny day, and felt less touristy and much more local-which is nice. It was a sea of different colored umbrellas today.

reviews.title: Love Ipanema
reviews.text: It's our favorite beach, less touristic than Copacabana. Love Posto 9, onwards. In the morning or late afternoon, watching volley ball and "fute volley". Ice cold beers and caipirinhas. On Sunday Avenida Atlantica closes down for traffic. Joggers, skateboarding, strollers,bicicles etc. Fabulous energy and entertainment.

reviews.title: Far from the madding crowd
reviews.text: We found Ipanema beach to be much less crowded than neighbouring Copacabana beach. Plus the beach & sea level was much more even.

reviews.title: Girl from Impanema
reviews.text: Walked through Impanema beach on the way back from Copacabana beach.  Found the restaurant/ bar where the song Irl from Impanema was written.  Stopped in fir a drink Beach is quite busy. Water was fairly calm today.  Lots of people swimming Definitely worth the trip to see

reviews.title: Just another busy beach
reviews.text: Having walked Copacabana beach, Ipanema was much the same, except for the absence of beach front bars and restaurants, except at the far end, where a couple of small units sold beers and some food items, more ‘snack shacks’. Within the confines of the beach itself, nestled in the sand, were numerous cabins selling things, including I assume refreshments and the like. Since you have to walk across the sand to reach them they are really only useful for the beach goers. Even on the opposite side of the road there appeared to be a complete absence of road side restaurants. As with Copacabana beach, lots of sun worshipers, some hiding under a sea of parasols.

reviews.title: The best beach in the city of Rio
reviews.text: Very nice water and sand with lots of tents to buy cold drinks. Umbrellas and chairs are available for all, but be aware that if you are not local they may charge you a lot more. Always negotiate with the owners. Also be attentive with thieves, they are everywhere in the city... a shame!

reviews.title: While a day away at this hedonistic beach
reviews.text: Ipanema is an institution. You havent been to rio without a sunday at a beach and why not pick the iconic ipanema one. Well organized postos with chairs and food vendors. There a lot of entertainment here just go and chill

reviews.title: Great beach, wonderful local sights, one of the reasons for going to Rio
reviews.text: Firstly, over 60's can use the facilities at the various Points for free with photo id. Becomes more important as I get older! Fabulous sandy beach in its own right, felt that Ipanema was a little more up market than Copacabana. Amazing beach cocktail bars that offer wicked caipirinhas at very reasonable rates (5 reals) whilst offering free wi fi and the ability to pay by card, very good beach side cafes offering incredible steak meals at cheap prices, and a popular surfing area. However, the best part for us was to just promenade from one end of the beach to the other, watching a very colorful beach life. Loved it.Personally, I would book any break to include a weekend in Rio when the beaches just come alive. The beach is a lot quieter mid-week. We also felt very safe here, There was a strong police presence during the weekend but we did not feel hassled or threatened during the day. Would not be so confident at night.

reviews.title: Excellent place to visit
reviews.text: Ipanema beach is the right place to find the locals and enjoy one of the best part of Rio. Relaxing and taking a caipirinha on this beach is something you must do in Rio.

reviews.title: Lovely beach!
reviews.text: Surfing potential is evident, Lovely waves and great people watching. Just plainly a beautiful location. Lots of activity .

reviews.title: Look this Nice and Beautiful place
reviews.text: Ipanema is the land of Vinicius de Moraes and Tom Jobim. Ipanema Beach is a most beautiful place to go to see the sunset. The water of the sea is good, the temperature is good, the sand is very soft and the people are nice. Everything is good. If you want to relax it is the appropriate place to go. As in many parts of the world you have to pay attention and do not wear jewelry.

reviews.title: Natural beauty not well kept
reviews.text: This beach is situated in the richest neighborhood in Rj, one of the most expensive in the country. However, in spite of its natural beauty, it has been neglected by the public administration and its not safe nor clean enough. Beware with pickpockets, especially in weekends. Many times polluted waters and dirty sand. A shame! Rio de Janeiro deserved a better destiny!

reviews.title: A must visit when in Rio
reviews.text: A lovely beach with white sands and lots going on. You can have surfing lessons or just watch the world go by. Whilst there are no beds to hire, the common theme is beach chairs and umbrellas. The sea as you would expect is cold to begin with and some big waves so if your not a strong swimmer keep a look out for the flags to see if it is safe to swim. Lots of hawkers seeing their wears, but they are not forceful in any sense - lovely local people wanting to make some money.

reviews.title: Famous Beach worth visiting!
reviews.text: We typically stay in a high rise hotel in Leblon overlooking Ipanema.  Ipanema is an expensive area but very popular with its beach, restaurants, hotels, bars, etc.  It’s more laid back than the very active Copacabana Beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach walk
reviews.text: A clean, long, white sand beach.  Especially enjoyed watching the surf school.  There are areas where they sell you beach chairs, wifi, water, drinks.

reviews.title: Each beach in Rio has it's own style. Ipanema is crowded but enjoyable
reviews.text: Looking for a crowded beach but kind of more upscale than Copacabana, it's the way. Posto 8 to 9 is the gay spot. Posto 9 is mixed and you can watch volley ball games on some evenings ; best spot for Sunset is just opposing the Sofitel building. If you want the more quiet location, upscale, go to Leblon

reviews.title: vey nice beach
reviews.text: Very nice beach to relax. A few stalls all along the promenade with tables outside to enjoy a snack or drink.  We had a whole coconut each and just relaxed and enjoyed watching everybody just doing what they were doing playing sport swimming or just relaxing. Similar to Copacabana beach lots of condominiums along the promenade. We did explore the town area down one of the side streets and found a lovely little market selling all sorts of things. Also found a café and had breakfast there which we enjoyed. A lot of people walk from Copacabana but we just took a taxi both ways cost around 25 Reals.

reviews.title: A eeekend must
reviews.text: The amount of people on the beach is amazing and it’s got a fantastic vibe going on. Also on a Sunday there is a hippy market in the square by the subway station.

reviews.title: another shopping area
reviews.text: a regular shopping precinct, you will find the ipanema bar & restaurant made famous by "the girl from ipanema" song here, & a bikini shop next door now being run by her daughter. There are havianas sandals outlets in the area

reviews.title: Just as pictured
reviews.text: I walked the length of Ipanema Beach, just to say I did it!  The site was beautiful, the experience excellent.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful clean beach and crystal clear sea, although lots of high waves with a very strong current. The beach is dog friendly and so if you are a dog lover lots of dogs to watch enjoying the sea. You will he constantly bothered by people trying to sell you rubbish but if you ignore them they just walk on by.You can hire two chairs and umbrellas for R$20 not the most comfortable but the umbrella was a must as was sooo hot. The man also sold water, coconuts and such like.

reviews.title: The Rio you want to see
reviews.text: The Ipanema Beach is one of the two famous beaches of Rio de Janeiro, the other being Copacabana.Unlike its more crowded neighbour Copacabana, Ipanema feels less crowded and looks cleaner. There are less sellers on the street and they sell handcrafted goods instead of cheap souvenirs. The place feels pricey and rightfully so, since most of the luxury hotels of Rio are located on this beach. It has more policeman walking around it than in Copacabana and you can look over the whole beach from the Pedra do Arpoador.In short, this is a highly suggested spot for visiting and to spend some lazy hours under the scorching sun or learning how to surf.

reviews.title: Beautiful and famous people
reviews.text: Enjoy the sun the sea and the waves of one of the most beautiful beaches of Rio de Janeiro. Go at ease, wear Hawaiian sandals and step on the sands of Ipanema beach and enjoy the sun with beautiful and famous people. Do not forget to take an ice cream mate and eat Globo cookies so typical of Cariocas.

reviews.title: Amazing hotel, staff and location
reviews.text: This Hotel and staff are awesome. The staff went the extra mile to make our trip very special indeed. The secretly arranged a romantic boat trip for 2, great tickets for the football at the Maracana and some very useful help and advice of getting around Rio. Hotel was clean and room was huge.Breakfast was very nice with lots to eat.

reviews.title: Beautiful but crowded
reviews.text: One of the two classic beaches in Rio (also Copacabana).  This one is a bit cleaner and seemed to be a friendlier vibe.  Immediately adjacent to LeBlon's Beach to the West. There are shops and places to eat across the road from the sand, but a bit pricey.  We looked everywhere, but never found "the girl from Ipanema".

reviews.title: Best beach in the south zone
reviews.text: Best beach in the south zone, but can get very crowded on weekends and vacations. Better arrive early in these days (before 9am ou in the afternoon, after 3pm)

reviews.title: Surprisingly dirty
reviews.text: We walked along the beach and there was a lot of trash.  This was surprising since I read that this was the most expensive beach.  Copacabana was much cleaner.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach - rammed when sunny
reviews.text: Of the two big beaches I prefer Ipanema. Be sure to bring a towel and a cooler full of beer and chill away the day. In the streets behind there are a few great, but pricey, restaurants and boutiques.

reviews.title: Timeless Beach Culture
reviews.text: I was told that Ipanema Beach is safer than Copacabana Beach... and I was fortunate enough to live across the street at the Sofitel Ipanema.   I went on the beach both Sat and Sun.  The vibes were just wonderful.  People were very friendly, especially on Sunday.  I was able to walk around and took pictures and participated in the beach culture.   I found the water colder than the pacific but it was bearable.  The waves were much bigger than expected so I was very careful as to not go too deep...watched out for those undertows.  The water was really clean and the atmosphere was just timeless.

reviews.title: Very awesome!
reviews.text: Amazingly beautiful beach and a must see if your in Rio!  Love the wall with all the graffiti on it.  Lots of open space to lay out on the sand.  Lots of food and drink vendors walking the beach.

reviews.title: Best beach in Rio - don't visit during the night
reviews.text: It's an amazing beach - located between Copacabana and Leblon. Very safe during the day. It doesn't have as many beach shacks or live music joints as Copacabana - it's a place you come to for relaxationIdeally, don't visit after 7:30 PM as everything shuts down by then and the place is completely deserted

reviews.title: Rio Beach
reviews.text: White sandy beach with beautiful bodies makes for great people watching, however, other than eye candy on the surface, the beach is NOT CLEAN.

reviews.title: What a Beach!
reviews.text: One of the truly must see sights in Rio. Beach was really crowded and was really being utilized by the locals.

reviews.title: Ipanema Beach
reviews.text: Ipanema Beach is a very beautiful, and, quite large in size, 3.5 km. of pure white sand.  It is a very active beach with many activities going on, like volleyball, vendors selling souvenirs, it appears to be a much younger crowd, more locals than tourists, and,  more crowded than Copacabana Beach.   Go and spend a day a day at Ipanema Beach and feel the vibe!  It will not disappoint you!

reviews.title: another famous and wonderful beach
reviews.text: it has to be on your 'cannot miss' list. Everyone knows the famous song - 'the girl from Ipanema'. If you've never listened to it make it a point to do so.

reviews.title: Ipanema & Leblon best city beaches
reviews.text: While most tourists stay in hotels in and therefore go to Copacabana / Leme beach, locals prefer the beach of Ipanema / Leblon. In reality one 3.5km stretch of beach, with the canal of Jardim de Allah dividing Ipanema from Leblon. Arpoador is surfer oriented and has the best sunset view. Beach references are the Postos,  lifeguard stations at each km. Posto 9 in Ipanema and Leblon’s 11 and 12 are most popular, with Ipanema more ‘seen and be seen’, and between Postos 8 and 9 is mostly gay popular. Leblon is more laid back and families. All four Ipanema and Leblon metro stations are 2 blocks walking distance from the beach. Advice from a 9-year resident.

reviews.title: LOVELY BEACH. NOT AS LIVELY AS COPACABANA BEACH
reviews.text: I took a walk from Copacabana Beach to this one and this beach is not as big or as lively as copacabana.   Its a lovely stretch of soft sand and if you like a bit more peace and quiet this would be for you. Has a few kiosks along the way, toilets and the vendors trying to sell their souvenirs. Felt safe if you follow a few basic rules.   Glad to of seen and a lovely walk there. Got a metered taxi back to Copacabana, cost 15rs (£3).

reviews.title: Beautiful sand with lively waves
reviews.text: We swam in both Ipanema and Copacabana and there is nothing much to choose between them. Apart from a headland called Aproador they would really just be one long beach. Aproador is a lovely place to sit and watch the sun set though. The sand on Ipanema beach is beautiful. We found the place not very crowded although we were a little early in the season. Promenade is very pleasant as well. Waves seem to be a feature so swimming might not suit people with a cautious nature. Kiosks along the promenade have drinks at reasonable prices. It is a beautiful place to sit and watch the waves, while the city is just across the road. And of course you are looking out at the vista of a beautiful bay and the Sugar Loaf.

reviews.title: Great Beach - Easy walk from Copacabana
reviews.text: Walked from Copacabana to Ipanema - an easy walk. Ipanema Beach is less crowded than Copacabana, less beach sellers. Beautiful white sand, and wide boardwalk. Worth a stroll or even a swim!

reviews.title: Waves breaking in from the Atlantic
reviews.text: Impressive but don't swim! Nice relatively quiet beach after Copacobana. Good to walk but head inland for bars and restaurants.

reviews.title: Best city beach in the world
reviews.text: Just love to be here. Walking distance from many hotels, beautiful people, sports and whatever you need. My number 1 place in the world.

reviews.title: Girl of Ipanema
reviews.text: It seems the girl of Ipanema still exist, nowadays as a beautiful grandma. However her daughters are stil running wild and charming,  enjoying sun and blue water, for your enjoyment, admiration and strolling and relaxing on the white sands of this marvellous beach.

reviews.title: Really nice beach
reviews.text: What a great setting.  Bluewater, large waves, clean sand and lots of beachgoers.  I never once felt uncomfortable [i.e. rumors of pickpockets, theft, etc]

reviews.title: No Rio without Ipanema
reviews.text: Ipanema is one of the best large beaches in Rio. Despite it is narrower that other beaches, it is nice, clean and safe. I would advise to enjoy Ipanema during week days as weekends can get really populated. It is also very nice for jogging on its tidy running course.

reviews.title: Drive by visit
reviews.text: Rio has a bunch of pick pockets so if you walk go with a pal.  I was on a tour and viewed the beach as we drove by.  I would not make seeing this my main purpose, but I would make The Redeemer Christ a priority.

reviews.title: Must visit on a visit to Rio
reviews.text: Ipanema beach is probably less crowded than Copacabana beach but is definitely worth a visit.We went on a Friday which was also a national holiday and three of the five traffic lanes in addition to the beach, pavement and cycle track  were opened up to joggers, walkers and cyclists.

reviews.title: Most interesting Beach
reviews.text: Stunning! From the fresh coconut drinks to Mojitos on the Beach made by a traveling guy! We teased my daughter that we will come back and wear the dental floss bathing suit bottoms!

reviews.title: Relax and enjoy the sand and sun
reviews.text: With a world renowned reputation, Ipanema beach has a lot to live up to and it does. Beautiful soft fine sand and crashing surf mix with the cries of food and drinks sellers as you enjoy the sunshine. The beach gets busy with locals which adds to the atmosphere. A good tip is to stay at one of the beach front hotels and use their designated chairs and umbrellas for free. We were able to walk out of the hotel on to the beach and relax in a sun lounger without any issues. When on the beach do not miss some of the great, simple food (sweetcorn fresh off the cob and cheese grilled on portable barbecues were our favourites) and, of course, relax with a well made caipirinha.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: great beach, I stayed here 5 days while on business and the beach looks great, I love running and this is superb spot x running. I love the sea breeze.

reviews.title: NICE
reviews.text: nice beach, glad we stayed in Ipanema - beach is very close, it’s huge and so are the waves! Good shops nearby for clothing and also a lot of good places to eat near by

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Unbelievably clean given the number of people there.Officias certainly know the value of a clean beach.

reviews.title: Loved my Visit to Ipanema Beach!
reviews.text: The boardwalk was great - the beach lovely although the ocean was quite rough so beware if you're travelling with children. Perfect for surfing, though!

reviews.title: Beautiful.
reviews.text: We spent almost two weeks on Copacabana but the weather was mostly rainy. On the one nice day we had we took a cab to ipanema. The beach had beautiful people, just like Frank Sinatra said. We noticed hotels were more expensive here and probably meant the people had expensive taste. Definitely got that vibe. Gorgeous water and a bit nicer than copa.

reviews.title: Over hyped
reviews.text: Yes, this is a nice sandy beach. Thats about it. The seas not blue, there are waves, potential security issues from thieves and it abutts a noisy road,. Why bother?i

reviews.title: Clean, beautiful beach with waves to play in and felt very safe!
reviews.text: Our family stayed at a hotel on Copacaba beach, but as beach lovers, we could not pass up the opportunity to see the much talked about Ipanema.  Glad we did!We walked to the right along Copacabana beach from our hotel to Ipanema beach.  Although the waves weren’t super big, there were about 12 surfers waiting to catch a wave.  The beach itself is very clean, the sand is soft and the water is BEAUTIFUL!  Even though the day was cloudy and only mid 70’s, the water was warm.  We all enjoyed playing in the surf before heading back to Copacabana.  Glad we made it a “must do” on our Rio bucket list.

reviews.title: Ipanema Beach
reviews.text: Didn’t visit  the beach due to limited time and inclement weather. Looks very nice but repeated warnings of security issues from our guide and other security personnel didn’t help.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: We stayed at the Copacabana Hotel but wanted to experience both the Copacabana AND Ipanema Beaches.  They're both similar in that they are both beautiful with sand as fine as sugar.  Ipanema felt much safer and we really enjoyed watching all the volleyball games.

reviews.title: The other beach!
reviews.text: After Copacabana you arrive on the otherside to Ipanema which is equally as stunning and far less busy

reviews.title: Worth the hype
reviews.text: Gorgeous, beautiful and nicer than Copacobana.  When we went it was quieter and more enjoyable than Copa.

reviews.title: Nice beach with plenty of service for chairs, umbrellas and drinks.
reviews.text: I saw the girl from Ipanema Beach, but she didn't see me and kept walking. We got a couple of beach chairs and an umbrella and the guy brought us drinks. The water is a bit cold so go all in and you will be fine.

reviews.title: A Crowded Beach
reviews.text: What makes this Beach are the steep hill around it providing a picturesque backdrop. Lots of people crowded onto the beach making the most of it. Certainly have to go and see this. Walk out onto the headland and look back at the beach. Drink a cold coconut n the promenade and just watch the beach in action.

reviews.title: Chilled Out Kinda Beach
reviews.text: A very relaxed and chilled out beach to walk during the day and night.  Full of great seafood cafes and restaurants.

reviews.title: Kangaroo Chris
reviews.text: Must Do! Go to Grotto de Ipanema Beach Great People BEST. The Beach one of the Best Around. Restaurants great assortments and quality food.

reviews.title: The girls of Ipanema are still there ...
reviews.text: The famous song made "Ipanema Beach" known all over the world! And it surely deserves all that fame! A beautiful beach at the  trendy quarter of Ipanema! This is certainly the "place" to be while  in Rio de Janeiro. The beach is fantastic, what doesn't mean it has no problem. Of course, it does. The water and sand are not very clean. The water temperature is generally pretty much on the cold side. Beware of your belongings - cameras, cell phones and backpacks - at all times and avoid the surf area after dark - principally if you are alone. Overcrowded on sunny weekends, many vendors trying to catch your attention ... Just like anywhere else. But it is unmissable! You will certainly fall in love with Ipanema! Enjoy!

reviews.title: THe Girl of Ipanema
reviews.text: I live here, in Ipanema.It is the most beautiful neighbourhood in Rio. It is just caomparable to the adjacent Leblon area. But, it remains more quiet and cozy.The beach itself was better to bathe in the past. Somedays, it gets really polluted. Others, it is very clena and transparent. It depends on the currents and if it has rained recently. After a rainy day, become s a mess. Its waters are a bit cold. And the waves and currents are very dangereous. Do not go far from the beach. The sand is white (nos a Caribbean white, though), and it is cleaned in the mornings. But, after a few hours and depending on the crowd (very uneducated), it can get really dirty. The girls though are gorgeous! Sexy and almost naked. Brazilian bikinis are made to show, not to hide. In fact, you have two sightseeings: the hill& the sea + the girls of Ipanema. Never bring your expensive watch, i-phone, jewelry or excessive belongings to the beach. Specially, during weekends. Tha chance to get robbed is very high. Rio today is literally surrounded by favelas (slums). The largest part of their population is just poor. But, drugdealers have made them their fortresses. And they originate therefore, a lot of violence. Ipanema is, by far, the best place to satay in Rio. Its sidewalks are great to do a bit of exercise, in the mornings. On Sundays, on the street lanes is closed to cars.And families, kids, dogs, bikes, street artists and small vendors are evrywhere. It is like Miami Beach or Santa Monica (LA). The best hotels are the Ceasar Park (****) and the Fasano (*****). The last one is expensive as a fancy resort. It is a beuatiful hotel. But it is not a resort. Nearby, you have the Sheraton. Its location though, at the Nyemaier Highway, after Leblon Beach, is a bit off to get by walking. It is old, but very complete. If you come to Rio, Ipanema Beach is THE place to stay. No doubt. Boa viagem!

reviews.title: great beach in the upscale neightboorhood
