reviews.text: Great beach, looking to the see, try to go to the right or to the extreme left (Arpoador, close to the rocks), the beach is better in this points.  Very easy to get out of the beach and eat in one of the restaurants close to it, if you prefer the sofisticated ones, go to the Anibal de Mendonça or Garcia Davila streets.

reviews.title: Not sure I understand the hype about this beach
reviews.text: Maybe having been to a few other beaches around Rio I was a bit underwhelmed by Ipanema Beach.  It was crowded, less places to have drink or something to eat than say Copacobana but still the same amount of people trying to sell you something.  I am sure this beach will be “liked” by many many people but there are better beaches within easy reach.

reviews.title: Less crowded than Copacabana
reviews.text: Enjoyed a crowd free swim and sun lounge. Surfers, sun lovers & hawkers. Felt safe with Police and security present.

reviews.title: Sort of boring off season
reviews.text: Our hotel was right on the beach and while the beds were comfy, I don't think it's worth paying the extra in the off season.  The beach is just like all beaches.  The life is really over at Copacabana and Ipanema was just quiet and not too many people.  the weather was not great so maybe I'd have a better opinion in nice weather!

reviews.title: Second best beach in town (or maybe third)
reviews.text: Let's be clear: if you have time for one beach only in Rio, then that should be Copacabana, not Ipanema. Said that, then there is nothing wrong in spending a few hours in Ipanema too, especially in the weekend, when the beach is full of lively people and the beach kiosks are in a great mood. Get a chair, enjoy a caipirinha or a beer, a great sandwich at the Uruguay kiosk and do some high quality people watching. Is a smaller beach than Copacabana, similarily smooth and clean, but what makes the experience worse than the more famous neighbor is the promenade, much less large and majestic, and the other side of the road, which has a narrow pavement and is lined by anonymous condos for rich people protected by ugly high fences and armed guards. Not cool. Just stay on the beach!

reviews.title: "The place" to be.
reviews.text: If you are heterosexual or homosexual, this beach caters to everyone. Beach life is the way of life for many Cariocas as well as visitors. For your comfort small restaurants and kiosks are serving drinks and small / fast food and dealers are offering sunblockers, sunscreens, sunglasses and what else one needs for a comfortable and lazy day at the beach.

reviews.title: Winter   Sun! This  is the weather in the winter in Rio.  Nice for a coconut water and a stroll  on the sidewalk.
reviews.text: Today was hot and the sun is still shining at 5pm so you could stay at the beach enjoying a relaxing day, play volleyball, go for a walk on the sidewalk, have a swim in the green pristine water... amazing weather

reviews.title: Stormy, wild and wonderful
reviews.text: If you go out of season like I did, you can’t expect perfect weather. What I got was glorious breakers and fabulous photos on my Pentax, ( this tame shot is with an iPhone), I can only imagine it in the glory of summer

reviews.title: Great beach!
reviews.text: Ipanema beach is walking distance from Copacabana beach.  It is a clean beach, but gets busy over weekends.  Chair and ambrella rentals available at reasonable prices.  Food and drink vendors.

reviews.title: Great cycle ride
reviews.text: As a beach prefer to Copacabana - more intimate, and much better bars and bistros near by. Some genuine great massage services on the beach - total relaxation and then dive back in the sea

reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text: Gorgeous sand and surf waves make this a beach totally living up to the fame it deserves. Felt so delighted to sit and soak up the atmosphere, all the traders (no hassle though) and watch the world go by.  Hired chairs and umbrella, drank caipirinhas and paddled in the surf. What an amazing place.  Couldn’t read as the place was so fabulously busy I was entertained all day long.  Beach beautiful bodies, football, volleyball and a wonderful chicken sandwich from Uruguay (near Posto number 9). I would love to come back one day.

reviews.title: Wow!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach!  I loved Copacabana Beach but I preferred Ipanema!  It's definitely worth spending some time there, and walking between the two beaches.  It's a beautiful scenic walk!  There are rocks which you can climb on Ipanema and which offer amazing views of the beach.  Don't miss them!

reviews.title: As Copacabana, an Icon of the Planet !
reviews.text: Just continue walking out of Copacabana, you'll do a bend and the beach is going to change name in Ipanema.Just beautiful as Copacabana, let me say, choose the beach depending on where are you closer.But if you wanna enjoy both, why not ??

reviews.title: Better side to stay on and visit.
reviews.text: I stayed on the Copacabana side to start my time in Rio but after visiting the Ipanema side I was way more into that zone. Seemed a bit cleaner and not so overrun with tourists. The kiosks are a bit nicer too. Overall Ipanema is just a better, little classier zone that still has a lot going on. More of a local vibe too!

reviews.title: Walk to your Heart's Desire
reviews.text: It seems like this beach never ends.  We walked from Copacabana Beach to Ipanema Beach.  Then we walked along Ipanema beach.  It was beautiful! Lot's of "futbol" players in the sand playing a form of volleyball that somehow included soccer.  It seemed to work for  them!I want to go back....

reviews.title: Awesomely beautiful & trendy beach
reviews.text: I’ve been to Brazil over 40 times and to Rio about 20 times. On my free beach time in Rio, I divide my time between Ipanema Beach and Copacabana Beach. For daytime relaxing by the beach, I prefer Ipanema. I find that it is more relaxing here and that the sand and water are cleaner. I prefer the section of Ipanema Beach which is between  Lifeguard Posts number 8 and 9, which are near the end of Ipanema which is closest to Copacabana Beach. I generally get a spot to relax which is away from those playing beach-volleyball and other games. From the standpoint of “The Girl(s) from Ipanema,” the ladies at both are equally beautiful. I like and respect the great degree of equality I see in Brazil’s large multiracial society. I’ve often worked in our Sao Paulo and Rio offices, I I loved seeing the respect shown between people of different racial heritage. Brazil has a high degree of racial democracy, and one of the best in the world. You’ll get some insight into it by looking at how the Brazilians interact on Ipanema Beach. Get out early in the morning to claim your spot on the beach. The good spots disappear quickly. Don’t take any valuables with you. Although there are very visual police and military presence, thieves thrive on the beaches. Often, I’ll stay at a hotel across from the spot on the beach, where I wish to chill-out Ipanema is considered to be a more hip and trendy beach than the beaches on its two sides, being Copacabana Beach and Leblon Beach. Although Ipanema has many nice cafes and restaurants, for evening dining, I prefer the restaurants in the Copacabana Beach area. My attached photos of Ipanema were taken while we were hang gliding over Ipanema Beach. This was an awesome experience.

reviews.title: Prefer Copacabana
reviews.text: Kiosks on beach are very small and does not offer much food or drink. Think it is more appropriate for locals.

reviews.title: A great beach
reviews.text: A most wonderful beach but be warned the sea in Rio is cold. What's more they don't sell Agua de coco when the temperature is less than 25 degrees

reviews.title: nice beach
reviews.text: nice  beach for people who enjoy playing all kind of sports that involve a  ball, with nice bars around it. The send and the beach in general is better than Copacabana.

reviews.title: Well worth a visit.
reviews.text: Didn’t go during the best weather but there were plenty of surfers riding the waves and plenty of places to stop for refreshments and shelter.

reviews.title: Best of Rio
reviews.text: Ipanema was probably the best area to walk around, and best for restaurants and the beach. Could get crowded on weekends but we were off season and loved it.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: A beautiful beach front lined with good hotels and apartments. Few big  rocks in the sea further beautify the sea line. Lots of clouds all the time. Lot many tourists and locals flock the beach. Outdoor Gyms and outdoor games on the beach. Specific mosaic pattern on the sea side is very specific. On Sundays the beach road is closed for normal trafic and is only open for cyclists skaters and people running and walking creating a feastival like activity on the beach.

reviews.title: All of Rio's beaches are just beautiful and so clean!
reviews.text: The nicest beaches I have ever been to. The water is clear, even though it's quite big waves. The sand is beautiful and not hot under your feet. The beaches are so clean and just wonderful for all ages. The only thing I would say is to watch your bags, as mine did get stolen. There is a lot of people walking around selling things which can be annoying as well.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: We walked over the beach during sunset. The view from the beach to the ocean is lovely. It is worth stopping by.

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: We had enjoyed our stay in hotel nearby this amazing beach. We relaxed on the beach every day. Nice beach and lovely ocean.

reviews.title: Gorgeous but expensive
reviews.text: Ipanema Beach is the best place in Rio for watching beautiful bodies walk, run, cycle, and rollerblade along the path.  The beach features surfing at one end, volleyball and football in the middle, and kiteboarding at the Leblon end.  The prices at Copacabana Beach are much better, though (ie. price of cachaça, etc.).

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: I love this whole area. It’s great to sit back and relax. Lots of little bars who do food and drinks. Very cheap as well . Can’t wait to go back.

reviews.title: Como a garota
reviews.text: Just as beautiful as we hoped, with great views, vibe and folks.  Easy to get a drink and soak up the sun but also good waves to ride.

reviews.title: Great place to hang out if you live in Rio
reviews.text: The beach is pretty crowded and there is a lot of action. It's mainly residential along the beach with a few restaurants and not many hotels. There are bars along the beach.

reviews.title: Oh beach
reviews.text: We stayed at Ipanema Beach at Mangotree Hostel - the beach spirit was unbeatable. The sunset was gorgeous

reviews.title: Beautiful..simple as that
reviews.text: A great place to walk and enjoy all the activities going on in the beach area.The surfers at the Copacabana end of the beach are worth seeing.Also great photos from the rocks at this end of the beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: I enjoyed my time at Ipanema beach. I actually think it is much much better than Copacabana. It seemed way safer and nicer. The water looks better here and i did not feel in danger , no one stoled anything from me and you can rent chairs and umbrellas. The merchants sell you food and drinks that vary but do not miss on the Coco! ;)

reviews.title: Beautiful beach but busy so watch your bags!
reviews.text: We were a family group of seven and visited Ipanema Beach once during a two week holiday in Rio.  All Rio’s beaches are beautiful so your favourite will be down to personal choice - we found Ipanema busy and therefore, very busy with hawkers selling a variety of goods (and possibly looking for unguarded possessions).  We had heard all the warnings and kept our beach bags close at hand but still had a bag stolen - be warned, either use your bag as a pillow or keep it right underneath your subbed! Also, the waves & tide in Rio are powerful so I highly recommend swimming near the lifeguard stations that are located at regular intervals along the beach - we watched the lifeguard assist a swimmer about every 10 minutes!!  So be careful but don’t be put off - definitely worth a visit.

reviews.title: Good service
reviews.text: No need to bring anything, you can rent a chair for 5R, an umbrella for 10R. Choose a vendor that has a full range of services: drinks, food, and you will have a great time.

reviews.title: Good for families
reviews.text: Ipanema has a family feel top it.  The beach is clean and long with plenty of room, except maybe during Carnival.  Enjoy the surf and sun.

reviews.title: Another crazy fun beachfront!!
reviews.text: It's like the whole Rio comes alive on a Sunday.The closed roads is super call and then people just rush out of their apartments.It's just people all over, all shapes and sizes and noby cares about anyone else.Al just go their own way and have fun.Loved it!!

reviews.title: Miles of sand
reviews.text: Anyone visiting Rio needs look no further. Miles of beautiful beach. Though the waves can be very rough the water is refreshing and the caipirinhas are everywhere. Loved it.

reviews.title: Safe and clean
reviews.text: It doesnt have as good view as Copacabana but it's cleaner and safer.Many guys offer there service, you can ask for chairs, umbrellas, drinks, foods. It's little crowde even in the morning, so better to come early.

reviews.title: Busy but beautiful
reviews.text: Lovely warm sand beach - busy but not ludicrously so, was easy to find space to lie down.Lots of people selling food, drinks, towels and bikinis, but they don’t hassle you too much

reviews.title: Our favourite beach in Rio
reviews.text: I thought Ipanema beach was actually nicer than Copacabana. The landscape of the mountains in the distance is very dramatic, the sand is beautiful and there are good waves on the beach. We really enjoyed our time here.

reviews.title: Intense experience,  beaches close by better
reviews.text: I did not know what Ipanema beach is until I visited. During my stay in Brazil I lived by General Osorio just a short walkie to Ipanema. So I used the Bech frequently and spent many sunny hours there. All days are not suitable for swimming, the currents are too strong and this makes also sunbathing almost impossible, you want a dip every now and then, the sun factor being 6+ like Australia. I used 50-60 spf and an umbrella and yet I turned dark brown. And the heat is immense.Now there are so many people you cannot be cooled down by the sea breeze,the most calm times of the day are early mornings after the sand have been shifted, and in the time before sunset. By the way the sunset is magnificent! The beach is crowded, everything have to be paid for, umbrellas, chairs and even space. There are many charming vendors providing you all kinds of services from coconut water to sex. Everything is for sale here. Prices are low and not relevant to discuss, I spent on. Hair and umbrella every day, drank beers, water and coconut waters constantly for no money at all.The bad thing is the loud vendors shouting all times, there were moments I wished for a shotgun, I could not bare hearing all this “ saaanwiches” and stuff, eight hours a day, non stop. People pee on the water. People peel on the beach, and the stench can be evocative. But this is the fine Ipanema still, Copacabana is worse with frothy yellow urine waves. I lived three months in Brazil. My tip to everybody is: walk in the sun, walk towards Leblon beach where the delta wing flyers land. Clean, pristine calmness, no people, no fuss, just Chrystal waters, waves and wind, some occasional passers- by, some bottlers, but why gather on the hysterically overcrowded Ipanema when you have all this at hand.Remember many people are afraid to go somewhere else, and also it seems important to make a statement by being at Ipanema. Coast guard and security holds their eye on the beach and surrounding area, which makes this area secure for tourists.

reviews.title: Busy
reviews.text: Smaller but busier than Copacabana beach. Many restaurants and shops nearby. More beach activities in the evening. Go in the evening to watch the sunset.

reviews.title: Love the Gay Beach
reviews.text: You will recognize this beach due to the rainbow flags!! All stands want you to take a chair at their place... some are  nice some a bit annoying... but all together i liked it!!

reviews.title: Classy
reviews.text: More classy but less to do than copacabana. Less stalls and bars. Breathtaking views. A cool place to spend a half day chilling

reviews.title: World famous Ipanema
reviews.text: This world famous beach is my favorite beach to go in Rio de janeiro. Do not bring more than you need when you go to the beach or any valuables that can be stolen. I have not had any bad experiences beside one time my credit card was scammed when i paid for a pair of sunglasses from a beach salesman. So leave all cards in your room and bring cash only.

reviews.title: Spectacular experience!
reviews.text: Everything is simply Magnifique from traditions to food,nature and amazing people.We really e njoyed all.We will be back❤

reviews.title: Our daily spot
reviews.text: Our daily spot in Rio. We were located near Copacabana, but we immediately felt in love with the Ipanema atmosphere. Close to the Garota (the big rock on the left of the beach) you will not be disturb by the cars and the noisy street activity, not like in Copacabana, who is a beautiful beach with a nice view, but too too close of the trafic in the street !

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: We stayed in Copacabana for a few days and walked to this beach pretty much every day. Safe but you still need to look after your things, great view of the mountains and you can have a lot of capirinhas !

reviews.title: Beautiful place with cute shops, cafes and restaurants
reviews.text: Ipanema is your 'high street' - a little glamorous, a little upscale. Except unlike those elsewhere, this high street isn't extravagantly expensive. Brazil in general is pretty cheap. Ipanema has great shops, such as Melissa (for shoes), as well as interesting food markets. There are great gyms, hotels, cafes, acai shops and more. Plus, you're right by the beach! Make sure you check out the hippie market during the weekends too

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviews.text: We went to Ipanema Beach when we in port in April - it was a beautiful beach and lots of restaurants etc. nearby.

reviews.title: Ipanema delight
reviews.text: Nice beach family oriented in some parts, warm  clear waters, no waves, you can swing, rent some kayaks, water motos etc.,

reviews.title: Nice surf
reviews.text: The beach was beautiful and there were a lot of sand volleyball games going on.  The surf was nice and the sand was very white.  The atmosphere was very festive and fun.

reviews.title: Chic but not pretentious
reviews.text: Nice bars, reataurants, shops and above all beautiful people and beach. Of course you should always be alert.

reviews.title: Clean Beach..
reviews.text: This beach is adjacent to Copacabana beach but less crowded .It's clean and nice to visit .you can find a surfing school and try if you love surfing .

reviews.title: Fastastic exciting beach
reviews.text: Great beach with plenty of room. Chairs and umbressas can be hired and there are lots of places to eat and drink. The beach is a hive of activity so lots to see.

reviews.title: Clean and fun
reviews.text: Fun to walk along.  Lined with volleyball nets with people playing variations on the game.  Lined with small food/beverahe stands.

reviews.title: Nice beach but be careful from thives
reviews.text: Nice place to chill, go there with minimum stuff, don't carry mobiles, much cash and costlier things. I was careful and did not notice any bad incidence. Monger/Sellers are of helping nature, some of them speak little bit English, you can avail Umbrella and Chair there irself.

reviews.title: I guess it's a Must See
reviews.text: If you love Joabim, the composer and love the song-The Girl from Ipanema, go!  Don't bring any type of valuables.  You could find yourself robbed for a cheap purse. Even my friends who live in Brazil are robbed. If you can, go in a group with WISE TRAVELERS that can take off jewelry and blend in as much as possible.

reviews.title: Beatiful Beach
reviews.text: Definitely the best beach, close to the shops and cafes. Few people trying to sell you things which was a little disturbing, but just be polite and firm and say your not interested. Unless you are interested in what they are offering to sell.

reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.text: I visited on a bad day, but its lovely. GNice stretch of sand with vendors selling snacks and drinks.

reviews.title: View of Twin brothers mountain
reviews.text: Located south of Copacabana beach . It is shorter and narrower . The sand is not as white as the Copacabana . Many people watch the sun set with the View of Twin brothers mountain . The wave is stronger than Copacabana There is a song written namely A Girl from Ipanema and made famous by Frank Sinatra .

reviews.title: Good place to visit
reviews.text: Its a good place to visit..if you have felt copagabana beach..then you can go ipanema beach,not far from copagabana ..walking distance,if you being there don’t forget to Cruze over arpoador a small hill..in the end of ipanema beach..for sight seeing and lot’s of photography..

reviews.title: Stunning view from the bike path
reviews.text: Came round the corner from the tranquility of Copacabana to find the waves beating up the beach at Ipanema - spectacular with the scenery behind.

reviews.title: Not a great experience
reviews.text: Coming from a country with excellent beaches I found this one disappointing. I would not leave anything of value on the beach, as there does not seem to be any security at all and lots of people wandering around trying to sell you Chinese junk, though not very aggressively. There were also too many females on the beach wearing bikinis that were often too small - not a problem with adults, but on young pre-teen girls I felt it was a problem as there seemed to be a lot of men there just staring at them.

reviews.title: The girls and boys of Ipanema
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with usually higher surf than Copacabana, but not as wide. Gorgeous beach bodies abound. Dress (less) to impress. Go during the week when it is not as crowded as on the weekends.

reviews.title: Cool but not safe
reviews.text: Very nice beach. Actually liked it more than Copacabana. You can surf there, eat and drinkk cocktails. Two things that annoy a lot: 1. Never ending people who are offering you chinese sun glasses and everything that you can and cannot imagine🙈2. Huge problem with safety. You can’t relax completely because at the moment you will turn your head-someone will still your bag. But in general very cool place with a lot of positive people. I bought amazing swimming suit there as well👏🏻

reviews.title: THE beach
reviews.text: When you are visiting Rio one of the synonymous words that come to your mind is Ipanema Beach. Come and visit and take some time in the afternoon when sun goes down .. breathtaking view

reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: Ipanema Beach is a place I will miss! We went early morning and relaxed before most of the vendors were out. It was quiet and relaxing and perfect beach time.

reviews.title: A lovely Rio beach
reviews.text: We walked from our hotel around here it was a good 30-40 minute but nice walk totally safe during the dayWe found this beautiful beach equally as good and not so busy with lots of cool shops & eateries cheaper then capacabana area Well worth a visit

reviews.title: so much better than copacabana beach
reviews.text: This beach was WAY cleaner, WAY safer and WAY less crowded than CopaCabana beach.  And we were staying at the Copa and still felt crowded and stared at on the beaches.  We felt much safer walking aorund this beach and seemed to be less shifty people about.  The trash level was less, although Brazilian beaches are some of the dirtiest I've seen in the world.  This one was better than many.  Still, lots of tiny crap in the sand, which they clean frequently so it scares you how much would be there if they weren't cleaning.  Anyway, if you are hitting beaches, don't miss this one.  It was my favorite in Rio.

reviews.title: A fantastic place!
reviews.text: It really speaks for itself, the history, the view, the vibe. I would like to add that it is perfectly safe!

reviews.title: Best Beach in Rio
reviews.text: Ipanema is the best beach in Rio (along with Leblon), especially around Life Guard station number 9. It is less crowded that Copacabana beach, and the crowd is more upscale. If staying at the beach any length of time, this is the place to hang out.

reviews.title: A PEOPLE'S BEACH
reviews.text: We did not go there for a swim or to sit on the sand, but mainly to walk and people-watch : compared to Cocacabana Beach, Ipanema is crowded and busy, with a quantity of chair-hirers who all try to rent you a chair. There are people gathering a small groups of friends, people playing football and volleyball without nets ( there are nets and pitches on Cocacabana ) and people just lying in the sun.To get there from Leme beach, as we did, take the 539 bus for 260 R each. We enjoyed a safe walk back along the water's edge all the way back along the beach at dusk. Magical !

reviews.title: Fantastic beach, safe and clean
reviews.text: We were staying near the beach in Ipanema, and so visited here a few times.The beach was very safe, and clean (far better on both counts than Copacabana).Plenty of beach bars nearby as well if you wanted a drink whilst you were sat there.Sun lounger and parasol hire was very inexpensive too.

reviews.title: Nice Beach
reviews.text: Nice beachSafeLGTB +. The place to be.  Posto 8 to 9. You will identify the rainbow flag.Shopping:  good

reviews.title: Better than the rest
reviews.text: The beach is less crowded than copacabana, try it out. For an even better experience walk towards Leblon.

reviews.title: Had to visit
reviews.text: We walked around to Ipanema Beach from Copacabana - it was a very hot day but it was an interesting walk.  We did not actually stay at the beach, took the obligatory photo and then got a cab back to Copacabana, where there were many more options for a cold beer and delicious lunch.

reviews.title: Great Place to relax and enjoy Rio Beach Culture
reviews.text: This is a huge beach and very busy when I visited.  You can buy all sorts on the beach so do take some money for drinks, souvenirs, food etc  You can hire a chair and umbrella for not much money and enjoy the day on the beach.There are lots of places on the Ipanema walkway to sit and eat or have a beer or iced Coconut (coco fredo) which doesnt cost much.  Enjoy the sites of the beach, volleyball, football, swimming and all the people going by.

reviews.title: Gorgeous!
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach, chilled out vibe. Much more relaxed than Copacabana with less vendors. You can still pick up a chair and umbrella and there are plenty of food options though. It is very quiet Monday - Friday but at the weekends and holidays it is packed. Great spot for people watching.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: A much smarter beach and less crowded ,even some sun loungers . Plenty of places to eat and drink. Just nice to walk along the wide pavement and enjoy the view

reviews.title: Feel the vibe
reviews.text: Ipanema Beach counts with one of the most energetic vibes in Rio de Janeiro. The place (and girl) which inspired the song “Girl of Ipanema”, still have its fascinating atmosphere.The beach became one of the preferential “get together” points in any of its posts. The sand is shared by those who are looking for a relaxing day and to the addicts to the sport. We can find a large variety of places to eat or stay comfortable in the chair under the umbrella waiting for your Acai, Mate with lemonade guy to pass by. Don’t forget to stay for the sunset! It is spectacular!

reviews.title: Girl From Ipanema Statue
reviews.text: You gotta get a picture of a babe with the statue of the man who wrote"Girl From Ipanema". The beach is beautiful all along the coast.

reviews.title: Quieter than Copacabana
reviews.text: When walking back from the hippy market, we stayed on Ipanema for a while.  Quieter than Copa beach and not as many sellers... but still a lot.  Nice walk along the promenade.Worth a visit..

reviews.title: Stayed for a week. Fantatic
reviews.text: Lovely clean beach with white sand and a clear blue sea. Quieter than Copacabana. Great views with food and drink from the beach sellers. Sorry to leave.

reviews.title: saturday morning at ipanema
reviews.text: We were at ipanema beach all Saturday morning before lunch, many people enjoying the sun and the sea, also many practiced beach volley ball and football, you can find all kinds of food and drinks, clean public toilets.

reviews.title: Great beach - great experience
reviews.text: This is a very interesting experience - just watching the salespeople on the beach is an event in itself. The beach is clean and although the water is cold in April it is clean and worthy dip. Lots to "see"

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: On a par with Copacabana beach.  Stunning and a bit quieter.  Easy to reach on local bus transport if you're staying more towards the city centre/Copacabana areas.

reviews.title: Stunning scenery
reviews.text: Scenery was stunning.  That includes both the topographical/geological and the physiological.  Nice to see mix of tourists and locals of all incomes levels enjoying themselves side by side.

reviews.title: Famous for a reason
reviews.text: This beach has fabulous soft sand and beautiful water.  There are all kinds of kiosks to buy drinks and snacks.  Many vendors are selling their wares but most are soft sells.  A caipirinha maker tried to con us into giving him a Real $50 tip for his “weak son” and said Real $100 would be better.  He got none from us.  Overall, it was a great place to sit and watch the sunset.  Lots of people there just kicking the ball and having fun!

reviews.title: Trip to Brazil
reviews.text: Long , clean beach  excellent location, friendly local people , fun, sports activities available together with Food & Drinks

reviews.title: A wonderful friendly beach!
reviews.text: Having been to Copacabana beach, we decided to try somewhere different.  So it was off to Ipanema beach, just around the corner from Copacabana. This isn't as wide as Copacabana and wasn't as crowded either. Also the rental costs for chairs and umbrellas was about 1/3 that of Copacabana. The Guy who had the stall was always on hand to keep us topped up with refreshments, and even reserved our places whilst we went for lunch, to a small restaurant that he recommended. A great day out at the beach

reviews.title: Heart of Rio City
reviews.text: Tourist make sure you stay near Ipanema Beach, one can also look alternative to stay at Coppacabana.Beaches safe // walkers delight.Kids/ even adults can cycle for rent as low as 10 real a month.

reviews.title: famous beach
reviews.text: Ipanema Beach is right next to Copacabana Beach, with a wide swath of sand, stands where you can buy drinks and snacks. Others rent beach chairs and umbrellas. And there are street vendors selling tee shirts and other tourist stuff. We also passed a lot of elaborate sand sculptures which you can photograph for a small payment.

reviews.title: Fantastic people watching!
reviews.text: Wasn't sure what to expect from this beach as it was our first time in Rio. It was not relaxing in any way but it was a brilliant experience. You can hire chairs and umbrellas for a really reasonable price as well as ordering drinks. There are so many people walking up and down selling - grilled cheese, prawns, sandwiches, soft drinks, cocktails, sarongs, bikinis, beach dresses, speakers - you name it, you can buy it! The waves were awesome and the view from the beach is beautiful. Well worth a visit!

reviews.title: Girl from Ipanema!
reviews.text: A must visit during your time. It's a nice chilled out beach compared to the hustle and bustle of Copacabana.

reviews.title: Awesome beach
reviews.text: We are a family of 4 and we stayed in Rio for 5 nights. We stayed in Sol Ipanema hotel overlooking the Ipanema beach. We happened to be visiting on the Easter weekend. Although the beach was crowded but added so much color to the beach scene. The view from our hotel window with all the colorful umbrellas was spectacular. We went to the beach all 5 days and we still couldn't get enough of it.This beach is not a kid friendly beach. The waves are high and pretty rough during high tides. Also it is a public beach with no life guards. We got to watch sunset on one day (the other days it was cloudy). The beach is lit in the night and we could see people till late in the night walking or just hanging out on the shore. There is also a walking area just on the side of the road. It goes all the way from beginning of Ipanema till the beginning of Leblon.Ipanema beach is a must visit while in Rio. There are many vendors on the beach selling all kinds of things from Ray bans to bikinis to T-shirts to coconut water. They really add to the colorful scene of the beach.

reviews.title: Ipanema
reviews.text: Chosen the hotel here and didinät regret it. Like it better tha CC for swimming running and bars alike.

reviews.title: Better Than Copacabana, Great For People Watching and Sunning
reviews.text: Ipanema is smaller than Copacabana and has slightly higher class shopping opportunities.  Getting there can be maddening depending on the traffic conditions, but still you gotta see it when in Rio.  The Girl from Ipanema is there, she's just aged a few decades!  Beautiful beach of course to enjoy the sun in.

reviews.title: Not many girls of Ipanema around, if the song is to be believed, but a beautiful beach
reviews.text: Spent a couple of hours here whilst on a trip and had a blast.  A busy and bustling beach with some real characters running around the place.  Loads of beach bars and fast food places around and a very chilled out place or if you want, a mecca for beach volleyball, running, or weight training.

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: Great Beach to walk around and try to find the girl from Ipanema.l ook around im sure you will find one

reviews.title: Nice Beach but Dangerous
reviews.text: Actually Ipanema has upper class shopping area compared to Copacabana, however, I have witnessed two criminal incidents in front of my own eyes here. First a biker snapped a tourist necklace and ran away. 2nd a guy was following us but luckily a Brazilian lady warned us to walk away quickly. All incidents were at Ipanema beach. So.. it was beautiful but be careful..

reviews.title: Nice stroll!
reviews.text: This beach a bit smaller than copacabana and less crowded too, we visited during a public holiday in the morning and was almost deserted and nice to walk! i did not feel unsafe at all though I had taken all precautions to avoid attracting attention to me as a tourist. It was close to my hotel and highly recommend it for a walk!

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: A way better than Copacabana. It’s cleaner and views are a way better. I’d definitely prefer to stay there than in Copacabana, next time!

reviews.title: Ipanema beach: not the same but essential
reviews.text: I was a teenager when started to find my crowd in the Ipanema "posto" number nine, or the "Nove" as we use to call. The beach has different crowds. Depending on the location and day time, they are completely different. Find yours by walking and checking out the different people in each spot. Gays, sportsmen, potheads, they are all there. Just need to do some research. And enjoy!

reviews.title: Best beach for people watching
reviews.text: Rent chairs & umbrella from Elias in front of the Rio Country Club.  Less crowded part of Ipanema because there is less apartments as the club takes up space.  Don’t bring valuable items - we brought an old iPod to take photos and left our phone at home.  Best photo op is just before sunset.

reviews.title: The best beach in Rio
reviews.text: A typical atrractive beach. Suitable basically for swimming instead of playing volleyball etc. Nice waves. Cleaner than Copacabana.

reviews.title: Lovely beaches - comparable to South Africa
reviews.text: I think naming the beaches with beautiful names like Ipanema, not to mention the odd Beach Boys song, makes it a place you really want to see. Not as many waves as there are on the South African coast but lovely for swimming

reviews.title: Best beach scene in the world
reviews.text: It’s Ipanema. The most iconic beach in the world and it lives up to its reputation. It’s the beach scene of all beach scenes. All are welcome.

reviews.title: Best city beach.
reviews.text: What can I say about Ipanema Beach, simply the best place in the world for me. People from all social classes, all places in the worls having fun in the same wonderful place.

reviews.title: A must see
reviews.text: Ipanema is much more lively than other beaches and has some great spots. I was down in the gay area of the beach. My tip is to find a good tent that has good prices on chairs and beers. Sit down and enjoy the view on the beach, have a swim. I found the beach safe, met lots of lovely people and had a great day.

reviews.title: Fun and happy place
reviews.text: Go, enjoy, have a few Caipirinhas. Loved everything about it, beautiful views of the sugarloaf mountain.

reviews.title: Probably Nicest Beach
reviews.text: Smaller than Copacabana but with a nicer feel. As it is smaller it feels busier but also has a nicer atmosphere.

reviews.title: Just like the postcards
reviews.text: This is one of the world's most beatiful beaches.  The scenery is amazing.  Easy walking around.  Even the sand paths are watered to keep the heat down!

reviews.title: Keeping fit in Rio
reviews.text: Amazed at people always out walking, biking ,running, volleyball and of course soccer. On a Sunday they even close one side of the road to accommodate runners.

reviews.title: Very Quiet for when we were there
reviews.text: Such an iconic beach and nearly deserted while we were there. had a great drink of coconut milk from a beach vendor and watched the wind surfers landing in the beach.

reviews.title: Better than the Copacabana
reviews.text: The two famous beaches, maybe the most famous beaches of the world are in RioAfter seeing both the Copacabana was very alive but to be honest Ipanema was so much better..Beautiful sunset and extremely clean.The beaches are so long and wide , a great way to run or to walk along when you’re in a romantic mood.

reviews.title: Great Beach Nicer from above
reviews.text: Huge beach famous all over the world  and somewhat deserving of its fame. Aerial views look beautiful but on the ground this beach becomes a giant seaside city. Generally much safer than some think but sensible safety precautions should be taken, especially at night.There are many opportunities to rent seating and umbrellas as well as to purchase drinksAlways worth a visit.

reviews.title: Packed
reviews.text: The beach is always full and it is not so different than Copacabana Beach, a lot of people selling stuff and at weekends it will be hard to have peace there. If you don't like the smell of marijuana just avoid it and be open minded to see everything there, it is one of the most open-minded beaches that I have been at. Very gay friendly, I love it.

reviews.title: Very cool beach
reviews.text: Made positive impression on me, seems like safe place, at least according to Brazilian standards. Did not see any weird people of homeless begging for money. Of course better to be cautious. Sand and ocean was nice, there is a plenty eating or drinking opportunities at the beach. Multiple “stores” make great juices. There is also free WiFi at sidewalk. Nice place, worth to hang out. I like it much more than Copacabana.

reviews.title: Just lovely, a real icon.
reviews.text: Just be careful if you go swimming here, the wave can get very big and the current can really take you by surprise.

reviews.title: Best beach
reviews.text: I have been to Copacabana several times. This is much better, even though the beach is not as deep or as wide. Seems to be more vibrant and has less beggars around. Loved the views of the mountains.

reviews.title: friendly beach.
reviews.text: great buzz on this beach and friendly always people selling various things and stopping for a friendly chat, watch football dancers surfers and other activities all along beach a must visit.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Went here couple of times with my husband. We went to Copacabana for half a day but it was filthy the eater was a horrible colour and full of rubbish same as the sand. Where this beach it's beautiful the water and sand are very clean. The rips in the water can be quite strong and waves are quite big. But definetly the best beach out the 2! You aren't expensive for chairs to rent out and parasol. There are always venders going by offering a range of food, drinks, clothing and speakers or sunglasses.

reviews.title: Better than Copacabana
reviews.text: This is a much better beach than Copacabana it’s seems to be more chilled laid back people don’t seem to want to rip you off like Copacabana it has a nice feel about it sea is still quite rough though so be careful check my pic out use these people to rent a chair umbrella WiFi cocktails there friendly Down to earth and very honest and reasonably priced

reviews.title: The most beautiful beach of Rio de Janeiro
reviews.text: You have to spend the day on this beautiful beach You have to rent some chairs and drink caipirinha all day So much fun with the music 🎶 You are in BRAZIL baby

reviews.title: Quieter!
reviews.text: As lesser visited so quieter than the more famously named beach next door. All the same very scenic and worth a visit to say you’ve been there.

reviews.title: beautiful beach and place
reviews.text: That is a must go in Rio. This beach is good for leisure and also for surf sometimes. Great restaurants nearby. Beware with your cameras, wallets and cell phones.

reviews.title: Better the copacabana
reviews.text: In my view, this is far more elegant and less crowded beach than copacabana. The shops, restaurants and facilities looked much upmarket. It nice to see both beaches for comparsion

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: In my view Ipanema Beach is far superior to Copacabana. It appears much cleaner and more refined and was definitely worth the walk from our hotel, which was situated at the far end of Copacabana. The waves were fantastic and attracted quite a number of surfers.

reviews.title: Great area
reviews.text: The spectacular sunset is breathtakingly gorgeous. Close to automobiles on Sunday , make it a family friendly beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Some cafes along the beach or go back a couple of roads into Ipanema for a wider range of options.  Can be reached easily by metro.Busiest at weekends and quieter on weekdays.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Loved this beach - there was some much happening here. We didn't swim just sat and watched life, every minute there was something else to see. Such fun.

reviews.title: We missed the gay section!
reviews.text: Apparently there is a gay section of Impanema Beach, though we missed it. It must be at the far south end. We’d walked over from Copacabana beach. It’s not the short 300 metres the signage claims. By the third we got to Impanema we were feeling a bit distant from our hotel and, perhaps because we’d just flown overnight, not that adventurous. After a too-long slog through the dense heavy sand on the beach we turned around to return. Another consideration is that there are a lot more services along Copacabana beach.

reviews.title: Can be rough
reviews.text: The beach was easy to reach from our Arena Hotel and was full of locals swimming and having beach lunches, some Bar B Qs. The beach was very long and kept clean, just be aware of any red flags flying and beware the sun it is very strong even when cloudy.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: If you are in Rio you should visit this beautiful beach. One of the most iconic places in Rio de Janeiro.

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Beautful and clean beach water and waves were perfect felt safe only Downside is too many venders but never felt unsafe would defentlry go back

reviews.title: Great gay beach, no night life here tho
reviews.text: Awesome time at the gay beach, you will find it at pier 9. You will see the rainbow flags. You will need to rent a chair at the beach its around 10-15Rs, only downside there was no real night life at this beach in comparison to copacabana beach. After 6pm this beach dies down.

reviews.title: Our favourite
reviews.text: We had a nicer time here than we did at the Copacabana. The waves are great the street vendors were friendly. Made a bill at the start and payed at the end. We had a great time, many times.At one point my daughter dropped her phone & had it given back to her by one of the street vendors?!

reviews.title: A wander along the prom
reviews.text: This beac is similar to Copacobana but slightly more upmarket. There is a narrow busy road to cross to get to the beach which has netting between it and the prom. There are makeshift bars every few hundred yards with cheap tables and chairs outside so it’s easy to get a drink. On the beach there are lots of ‘bars’ set up by locals. They’re quite scruffy looking and have huge ice filled boxes containing beer etc. Food is available at these places but it’s not easy to see what there is. I’d only be tempted to have a drink and we stuck to a bar on the actual prom.

reviews.title: you have to stroll along Ipanema Beach and find the Girl from ipanema...
reviews.text: have been on this Beach several times over the years... on weekends it is very busy and on the sidewalk there is a market, this beach is very long but not as wide as Copacabana.  It is very clean as well, there is a special cleaning Crew on the job in Orange suits to keep it that way... stroll along the Mosaic Tile floor, look for Garota de Ipanema  ( you can have LUNCH there as well ) it is on a side street where the song " the girl from Ipanema was written by Jobim... mark my word you will love this area of Rio...enjoy , now look at my photos...Our Tour  Guide " Nilton " at  (55 21  ) 99955-1798  very reliable & dependable will take you there ,his prices are down to earth, he will NOT disappoint you, use him and you will never have a problem in RIO de Janeiro....

reviews.title: Simply beautiful
reviews.text: I walked from Copacabana to Ipanema. I just love it. But, if you want to swim or surf, percuation is necessarry - big waves and strong current. If the red flag is up the air, do not go in the water because the risk for rip currents is too high. Don t be crazy. :) You can see the favela Vidigal from Ipanema, beach (I walked from there to Vidigal, but I didn't go in). For me, one of the most gorgeous beaches ever. Must visit.

reviews.title: Just as I Imagined
reviews.text: So I read REALLY great reviews and then poor reviews... which led me to just go visit on my own to form my own opinion.So glad I went because I was beyond pleased. Our hotel was in Copacabana by Posto 3 so an Uber cost us R$12 at 1000 to go to Posto 8. Upon arrival we realized it’s true... all the good stuff happens at Posto 9.Tips:- We chose to get Umbrellas and chairs from “Barraca do Uruguay N* 80” it was R 20 for an umbrella and 2 chairs that were already set up so we didn’t have to carry ANYTHING.- It’s true no one carry’s towels they all have “Congo’s” which we found for R$25 at little shops vs the beach men who sell them for R$50 - the place we locked in sold water bottles, juices, coconut water, beers, snacks ... basically everything you could possibly want so you don’t need to load up on snacks- their are numerous Vendors that sell snacks, bikinis, sunglasses, drinks, cigarettes, speakers ... I mean everything while you just lay and ran- try to stay in front of the Posto since the restroom is located there. It’s R$2 for the restroom.- almost each stand that sells chairs and umbrellas has WiFi that you can use if you’re a customer... so you can request an Uber as a tourist and not worry. - the tide rises as the day goes on so don’t get too comfy laying on the sand. We saw a couple of people get woken up by crazy big waves hitting them- tip whoever is helping you out. These guys work super hard to please you and I think it’s just appropriate

reviews.title: Ipanema and samba
reviews.text: It was a great noon beach time, I got there slightly earlier and paid a chair for the entire afternoon with drinks and wifi abd even cheese fondue if you want. Beach is pretty clean and strong current. Pay for each bathroom time. samba musician was friendly and I get to jammed with them a little. It's good to run or bike around in the morning. Local told me is much safer on this beach.

reviews.title: Best beach in Rio
reviews.text: Less people than Copacabana. Betterr colour and size aswell. A bit more waves, but a very nice beach.

reviews.title: Nice beach younger crowd
reviews.text: Ipanema beach is a great beach For Walking along the shore Bars and some restaurants Younger crowed and a gay beach in the middle The sellers on the beach are more friendly

reviews.title: Less Populated Ghan Copa
reviews.text: We liked this beach, as it was quieter than Copa.  There are lots of locals exercising, as the town provides great equipment free of charge.  There are more umbrellas not so on top of each other, since it is not as crowded.

reviews.title: Where the young people go
reviews.text: We walked part of this beach, which was very busy. Unfortunately the rubbish from the sea gets washed up and is a constant problem and requires constant attention

reviews.title: Nicer than Copacobana
reviews.text: I would pick Ipanema over Copacabana any time as it's just a nicer beach. Less busy during the week.

reviews.title: Great Beach!
reviews.text: Fairly clean water. Great views all around. Plenty of bars and restaurants around. Perfect for relaxing, and for pictures.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Ipanema is one of my favorite beaches. It is for the grown and sexy, I rarely see any children when I go. My only caution is to be ware of the locals. The people working on the beach can be a tad bit aggressive. But they are friendly. Everything you want can be sold to you on the beach: beach chairs, umbrellas, drinks, food etc.. you will have a great time. The water is fairly warm in be summer.

reviews.title: Disappointingly dirty!
reviews.text: We were told by everyone the best beach is Ipanena, that may be true at any other time but a Carnaval time it wasn't good, Dirty, many dubious hawkers and a strong smell of weed. Not advised at that time of year!

reviews.title: Sunny in Brazil
reviews.text: This beach is crowded, especially on the weekends but there are some good eye candy on the each.  Watch yourself carefully because there are wondering eyes and hands all over, so do not taking anything of value there.  The beach is gorgeous and most of the people are friendly.  It's a must do while there but the water is colder than what I am used to in Miami.

reviews.title: Another beautiful beach!!!!
reviews.text: Very close to copacabana less tourists compared to copacabana i ll say better sand too beach volley is a must on this beach and for my opinion better for swimming!!!

reviews.title: Very nice beach in a nice neighborhood.
reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at our hotel on Ipanema Beach. The beach is beautiful with lots of touristy activities, places to eat, places to shop, and places to stop for a beverage. One of my favorite beaches.

reviews.title: Famous stretch of sand!
reviews.text: Nice beach but waves can build up at times.Can be some 'undesireables' at the southern end so don't show off your glitzy jewelry or posh phone!

reviews.title: Beach living
reviews.text: The only place in Rio to sit with a rum filled coconut and sit to watch and clap when the sun sets. Perfect for street parades and street parties also

reviews.title: long streched beach
reviews.text: To come here and take a sunbath was the perfect distraction to enjoy one of our afternoons over here. Especially the view to the mountein in the back is fantastic

reviews.title: WOW
reviews.text: stayed at a beach hotel, very busy and lively, but what fun, BEWARE the water can be very deceiving, it will drag you out all too easy, the waves are incredible

reviews.title: A landmark site of Rio.
reviews.text: Rio is a city that lives under a lucky star: it has two of the most recognisable, popular, and beautiful beaches. One, Copacabana, the other, Ipanema. Copacabana has a view sprawling in front of you as if it were a painting in the living room. It’s iconic. It’s stunning. Some of the most amazing bodies can be found on the beach – as in living people!The constant flow of beach salespeople can be annoying, though, but if you can get past that, you’ll have a great time. Use the opportunity to watch the sunset from one of the far ends of the beach. People sit on the rocks and clap as if it were a theatre performance.

reviews.title: Beautiful and vibrant
reviews.text: There is not a significant difference between Copacabana and Ipanema. I loved them both. I sensed Ipanema a bit more expensive but this could be subjective. The eastern edge is very close to Copacabana and the rocks, the view point, are really interesting.

reviews.title: Ipamena Beach
reviews.text: Phenomenal- everyone needs to go at least once in their life. If it gets crowded walk 5 minutes to Cococabana.

reviews.title: Nothing
reviews.text: Nothing major was a bit overcast the day I was there very carnival vibe going on all around which was nice

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Ipanema is a great beach but swim with great care because the tide is strong. Maybe better to soak up the sun and there atmosphere.....

reviews.title: Ipanema or Copacabana?
reviews.text: Either one! Both beaches are beautiful but climbing out onto the flat rocks for sunset at Ipanema is a must. Get there 30 minutes to one hour before sunset for the best spot!

reviews.title: Crazy at Carnaval
reviews.text: I was lucky enough be in Rio at Carnaval and Ipanema beach is insane.  Sp many people on the beach.  The water is beautiful and refreshing,  Great place to people watch - and spot some of the beautiful people.

reviews.title: Exciting, Crowded, Dangerous
reviews.text: We visited from a Celebrity Cruise ship with Glayber Silva Tours (look up on Trip Advisor!).  Glayber brought us to the beach in an air conditioned van.  He followed us through the crowded beach and watched our belongings as we swam in the warm waters.  There was quite an under tow and fairly strong waves near shore.  Young children should be watched.Because the beach is near a poor area of the city, Glayber carefully watched our belongings and advised about not keeping phones, bags and money out in the open.  Young teams of kids quickly grab and run.It was very scenic and historic, but far too crowded for my liking.  There were hoards of scantily dressed girls in thongs and bikinis to keep the imagination occupied.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: I strongly recommend to stay at Ipanema beach while in Rio de Janeiro. The beach is gorgeous. Forget about packed lunches! Just buy meals/snacks and literally anything under the sun from the vendors / roaming vendors there! Support local business!

reviews.title: Too crowded during Carnival
reviews.text: If you love giant crowds then this is the place during Carnival    Getting food and drink with dollars is impossible.  Get local currency.

reviews.title: Best sunset ever....
reviews.text: This beach is very cool mainly because the sunsets. Its not as wide as copacobana but still very beautiful always busy with some nice beach bars along the promanade. You must stay till sunset as this is an amazing sight to see.. there is a guy that sings on the edge while the sunsets giving you such a chilled out vibe its incredible.

reviews.title: Atmosphere is good
reviews.text: Visited Rio during Carnival week.  Everywhere was packed with people dressing costumes and there were Police all over the street that you felt so safe.  A stroll along the beach after dinner was nice.  Remember not to bring valuables with you.

reviews.title: Ipanema Beach- fun and authentic!
reviews.text: Ipanema was more than I imagined.  It was far more authentic and not as pretentious as I expected.  Lots of families and vendors.  Loved this beach!

reviews.title: The best experience ever
reviews.text: We travelled when it was summer in Brazil - and what a beautiful time to be there. It is exactly how you would imagine it - bikinis, sand, sun, water, caiprinhas, sunbeds, towels - everything is perfection. I am not a big fan of crowded places - but this was something else. The crowd of beautiful brazilian bodies makes it even better :)My husband and I had one of our most memorable time at Ipanema. I hope we can go there again.

reviews.title: The most famous beach worldwide
reviews.text: Gorgeous place to visit in Rio de janeiro. Gives you one of the most beautiful natural sites of the world. Place where "The girl from Ipanema" became famous with one of the most popular songs of Brazil

reviews.title: Brasil
reviews.text: Ipanema beach is beautiful it's near all hotels, bars and restaurants. It's 15 mins away from Copacabana beach. Food is great a lot of churascarias not expensive at all... had a wonderful time ..will go back in 3 yrs...

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: One of the best beaches around Rio.  While Copacabana may be the most famous, this is the most beautiful  A must visit while in Rio.

reviews.title: What a beach!
reviews.text: I have stayed a Ipanema beach located hotel the whole week - and what a lovely place from the rising sun to sunset. Not as busy as Copacabana which I also past today. A 17km training walk along both beaches. You can choose between the pedestrian or simply in the sand. There is a lot of people exercising from morning to evening.

reviews.title: A beautiful place for a stroll.
reviews.text: The beach and sea here are beautiful- more refined and pretty than Cococabana beach. We went on a Saturday and it had a lovely atmosphere with lots of families enjoying themselves.

reviews.title: Disappointing beach
reviews.text: Really looking forward to seeing Ipanema but it was disappointing.Lots of stalls and small drinking areas.People pestering you.Poor.  Go to Copacabana which was good.

reviews.title: The best beach i have been.
reviews.text: Excellent beach with friendly people ,good environment ,clean ,safety ,huge amount of attractions to do like  volleyball,football, etc.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Ipanema beach is beautiful just like you see in the photos. Lovely white sand and clean water. This is a great spot to watch the sunset. Was not too busy when we were there but I would imagine it can get very busy.

reviews.title: Great beach vacation
reviews.text: Wonderful beach. We enjoyed the atmosphere and friendly people. We felt very safe and the water was great.

reviews.title: During NYE time and it was amazing
reviews.text: Friendly people offering you drinks and chair to stay on the beach for really cheap price. Looking for you space, bring you everything, no rush at all with pay and more drinks. People are good looking around, beach is clean and in nye is was absolutely full. Music and good atmosphere is was what we need before the big party. Also we came back after nye time and much less people but still same good service. Def good beach to be

reviews.title: Famous Beach
reviews.text: Worth a stroll along the sidewalk, and the view of the surrounds. Good swimming, but quite short edge into the water. Street sellers not as prevelant or as good as Copocobana

reviews.title: Most sexy beach in the world
reviews.text: Ipanema beach is cleaner and more upmarket than Copacabana.  It is the place where rich and the poor Brazilians mingle.  The beaches are the most democratic parts of Rio.  Everybody is welcome here.  Lots of beautiful bodies, old people, children and a gay section around posto 9.  It is the best place to having a cold coconut drink, while watching he sunset.

reviews.title: Beautiful beautiful beach
reviews.text: Just a fabulous beach, much quieter than Copacabana but equally beautiful. Fabulous white sand and blue sea. Great for surfing if a little rough if you are a novice. Well worth going to   Lots of places to eat or drink nearby but use only local currency no cards or dollars

reviews.title: My Favourite Beach in Rio, especially at Sunset!
reviews.text: Visited in October 2014. Really lovely beach, quieter than the main Copacabana beach. Nice for swimming and relaxation. Be careful of currents and waves though. Great for surfing too. Enjoyed walking along the long promenade. Loved the view from the rocks at the far right corner of the beach and this is a prime spot to watch the sun go down between the Rio Hills. Great atmosphere here and enjoyed the native music and dance and little food stalls at sunset! Definitely must go here if visiting Rio. Can walk along the coast from Copacabana beach or its also easily accessible by Metro!

reviews.title: Great beach, great sights
reviews.text: As a well-known tourist spot, & beach to go to, you know it's going to be crowded! Well worth a look though, and a stroll swim will make you feel like you're really been to Rio de Janeiro! A must see sight when you go to Rio!

reviews.title: Isolated
reviews.text: I think that was the period but there aren’t people here; in the night was scary because there were only us! I hope was the period!

reviews.title: Romantic
reviews.text: We loved the beach in front of the Fasano.  We had to lounge set up for laying in the sun together.  The waves and sand were perfect for a dip in the ocean. Gorgeous! Abrigada

reviews.title: #upclass
reviews.text: 1. Beautiful women 2. Excellent bars 3. Good waves4. Calm5. Relaxing 6. Safe and Secure7. Beautiful women

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Loved this beach. But be aware of your surroundings, pick pockets are about. The sales people on the beach seemed ok

reviews.title: Best Worldwide Beach Panorama
reviews.text: If you wanna see the best sunset of your life you have to visit Ipanema beach and go till Arpoador Rock to assist one of the most wonderful nature scene of your life!

reviews.title: Amazing Beach
reviews.text: Incredible beach even more that I stayed at Ipanema Beach Hostel very close to this beach in especial space 11

reviews.title: Not as busy as Copacabana
reviews.text: It’s a smaller beach than Copa, and not as busy. So if you are looking for quiet and relaxing this is the beach to be at.

reviews.title: Better than Copacabana
reviews.text: The water is clean here and also there is something about it being away from the main road which made this beach a better experience

reviews.title: A great place to watch the sun set.
reviews.text: In December when the sun sets over the sea, Ipanema is the place to watch the sun go down. Crowds gather to witness this sight and often clap when the sun finally sets. The sky often glows an orange or pink colour - after the sun sets head up to the Blue Peacock for cod fritters and beer.

reviews.title: Great for wave jumping!
reviews.text: Very strong waves and currents although heavily life guarded. Great fun! Lots going on - good place to people watch!

reviews.title: Favorite beach in Rio
reviews.text: During the day, you can buy yummy coconuts for little more than £1 / 1€ everywhere. Definitely stay at least once for the incredible sunsets

reviews.title: Stunning and Lively beachfront and shops
reviews.text: Ipanema is slightly more upscale than its neighbour Copacabana with more high end stores, restaurants and accomodation.  The beach is stunning and the locals friendly and welcoming.  The beach can get busy on the weekends but the street along the beach front and a block or two back from the beach are a nice respite from the heat and the crowds.

reviews.title: One of the best beaches in Rio
reviews.text: My wife and I, we were visited Ipanema and Ipanema beach during our one week vacation in Rio on November. It seems that Ipanema is one if the safest locations in Rio and Ipanema beach is beautiful. We loved Ipanema and Ipanema beach. Definitely, better than Copacabana. Barra beach also very beautiful, but not in downtown Rio. If you are interested with beaches, try Barra beach as well.

reviews.title: It's a beach
reviews.text: We were not overly impressed with Ipanema beach. It's essentially another nice beach, but is bordered by high rise after high rise. It is a nice walk along the pathway that leads to a good overview point however. As tourists, we guess it's a "must do", but if your time is limited, don't feel bad if you don't get there.

reviews.title: Ipanema beach with friends
reviews.text: My favorite place is Ipanema the most visited in Rio, the beach so amazing with a beautiful view the twins mountains also the energy in this place where u can make friends and share a good moments

reviews.title: Famous Beach
reviews.text: We have all heard about this beach.  Since I ended up in Rio by myself I didn't want to go to the beach by myself but I still wanted to see it.  I hired a cab to take me.  The beach is amazing especially since it is so close to the city.  It was only about 28 C on the day I went to the beach which is cool for the locals so there were very few people on the beach.

reviews.title: Great Location to stay in Rio
reviews.text: I highly recommend staying in this area. Smaller then Copacobana, and a bit quieter without the large Tourist hotels. Very safe, and you have the fun Hippy market on Sunday!. I am not a beach person, so wandered a bit on the sand, and the ocean is a bit cold for me. Only drawback here is downtown is quite a ways away, Uber is 30 minutes or so.

reviews.title: Next beach along from Copacabana
reviews.text: Slightly quieter than Copacabana. Lovely long bay to take a leisurely stroll. Shopping street parallel to coast, not worth the walk. Several coffee bars and small places to eat.

reviews.title: Great spot, cleaner than Copacabana.
reviews.text: Great place to swim and hang out and is narrower than Copa. You can people watch and grab a cold mate tea or coconut.

reviews.title: Beach culture in Rio
reviews.text: I enjoy the promenades in Rio. You can walk from one beach to the next. Will take about an hour to walk from Ipanema to Leblon (my favourite beach). Lots of sports activities along the way, many vendors (quite noisy) selling their items, from drinks to food to beachwear. You can do chair and umbrella hire if your hotel does not provide these. The weather is hot so I found the need to dive into the shade every now and then. Tides are strong so beware of wading too deep into the ocean. Water is pleasantly warm, but waves can be big. For the rest safe to swim and clean. There are also fresh water showers on the beach to get rid of the salty water before returning to the hotel or stopping by one of the many beach 'restaurants' for a drink. Very enjoyable!

reviews.title: Happiness
reviews.text: Stunning beach, great cocktails, friendly people, great souvenirs, lots of different drinking places separated into zones,

reviews.title: Iconic!
reviews.text: Prefer Ipanema over Copacabana. Well maintained beach with array of services. Good chair and umbrella service friendly hawkers with sone great snack food, pricing very fair

reviews.title: We went by bus and taxi on our own
reviews.text: Although I read a lot about Ipanema and the shopping to be done there, we could could not find out anything once we arrived there,  as a result of a language problem. We find very few people speak English. I just thought taxis would know more English, not that I blame them. so just see to it that you know what to do or ask at your hotel. and pleaset try at least to say hello and thank you in Portugese. They appreciate it. find

reviews.title: Best choice in Rio
reviews.text: My first choice beach in Rio. Less tourists and more locals. also a safer place with a beautoful scenery.

reviews.title: Upper market end of the beach
reviews.text: We were staying in the corner section between Copacabana and Ipanema beaches and so going to both was very easy. We chose to go to the beach early morning and just after lunch time. It was a weekend so we was surprised just how packed the beach was by 0830amThey shut off one side of the road on the Sunday so people can skate and cycle and run in the unused side of the road. Great idea but means you need to be carful when crossing. The beach itself is clean and has a lot of activities going on all the way along it so it doesn’t matter where you chose to make your spot.There are plenty of bars and restaurants but we felt they were very expensive. The downside was the toilets appeared to be controlled by the bars and you were not permitted to use without a ticket which you only got when you purchased food or drink at the bar beside the toilet.Surf can be quite rough which is fun to play in

reviews.title: Hive of activity and safe
reviews.text: You hear a lot of bad things about the dangers of going to the beaches in Rio - you’ll get robbed, stabbed etc etc. But nothing could have been further from the truth - the wide beach was full of both families & ‘beautiful bodies’ and there was no hint of anything but fun. The shopping strip was worth a visit and we bought lots of Havianas as souvenirs for those at home. There is nothing to choose between Ipanema & Copa both being very pleasant days out. Just watch the surf - it was very rough & too cold for me.

reviews.title: Ipanema
reviews.text: Great beach, you do not have to leave it except for the toilet.You can get almost anything to drink brought to you by the beach boys and all on account, you then settle your bill at the end of the day.

reviews.title: Breathtakingly gorgeous, but not relaxing.
reviews.text: In my view this is Rio's most spectacular beach. The mountainous vistas to the left and right with the blue southern Atlantic in front of you are absolutely one of a kind. The fantastic photos that you have no doubt already seen look great for a good reason. This beach feels more local than Copacabana. It is however both shorter in length and narrower than Copa. A narrow canal separates Ipanema from Leblon. What gets emptied out into the ocean from that canal may give you at a minimum a persuasive reason to shower thoroughly from head to toe afterwards if you choose to enter the water.There is always something going on at this beach: folks working out, tanning, playing volleyball, walking, heading into and out of the ocean. There is also plenty of eye candy. Some show up wanting to be noticed. There are always folks trying to sell you something and it gets annoying at times. There is sadly often petty crime that happens, so if it isn't something that you can be perfectly happy living without, don't bring it along with you. That also means unless you are in a protective group, not wise for example to take out your new iPhone X to get that perfect shot of your friend.It is that combination of having to constantly be aware and constantly being solicited that makes the experience completely un-relaxing. If you go looking to be a part of an energetic Brazilian beach experience you should definitely see Ipanema, just go with a pragmatic level of awareness.Ipanema + relaxing experience = 5 starsIpanema + un-relaxing experience = 3 stars

reviews.title: Copacabanas more local twin
reviews.text: This beach is a little bit more local, but rather similar to Copacobana. Very nice soroundings, and quite touristy. In the bottom of the beach there is a huge rock between copacabana and Ipanema where you can get a glimpse of a beautiful sunset. Here you have to be a bit more careful, but the police is also more present here, so you should be fine. :-)

reviews.title: Love the energy!
reviews.text: Ipanema is shorter in distance length wise than Copacabana and it could be just me but I feel the locals go to Ipanema more than Copacabana which seems more touristy. I actually prefer Ipanema.

reviews.title: One of the best
reviews.text: The ideal time to visit is on Sunday when the road is closed to traffic and the area is one huge facility for fun. You need to know the numbers of the life guard stations. Those numbers indicate to those who know what sort of groups assemble in those specific areas.

reviews.title: Even in clouds, it's a beautiful beach!
reviews.text: We walked along the beach and sat for a while even though it was the evening and cloudy. The sand and water is beautiful here and we ate at a restaurant nearby.  You can't go wrong going here.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: It is pretty nice to watch the sun going down from Ipanema. Really nice beach, sometimes sea too rough.

reviews.title: Nearly the same as Copacabana and for me very nice.
reviews.text: Cannot tell how it might be during "high season" - but most pictures speak for themselves. I was there where nearly no one was on the beach and it was amazing. It is clean and in the evening there were lots of nice small locations to sit down and dring a little.It might be crowded, but I also liked the prominade and the restaurants there. In general there was no "but", but i think it is so famous that it will not be surprising, that stuff is a little more expensive and it might be crowded. BTW - there was not much of a difference for me to Copacabana.

reviews.title: I LOVED IT
reviews.text: A nice beach. wonderful.a true tourist spot.clean and sophisticated place. worthy holiday. what a wonderful bath and a view like never before. I LOVED IT

reviews.title: WOW
reviews.text: You can sit hours watching surfing with caipirinhas cocktails.The beach and the views of 2 Irmaos mountain is stunning.

reviews.title: best beach
reviews.text: This is a lovely white, soft, sandy beach. You can sit by the beach in boardwalk cafe/bars sipping a very inexpensive cocktail - you must try caipirinhas - enjoying the beach football/volleyball and watching the people cycle, roller blade, and jog by. Ipanema is smaller than Copacabana, with far fewer people selling things so much more peaceful. It is the perfect spot to watch the sun, looking like an orange ball, sink into the sea every night to the applause of the people on the beach. Pure magic - but please be careful after dark - the atmosphere gets a little more edgy as the area becomes much quieter

reviews.title: white sand beach
reviews.text: best to go there for sunset watching as the locals. Take your beer or capirinia and enjoy beach beauties and life.

reviews.title: Windy and beautiful.
reviews.text: Best at sunset. For a walk and taking photos. You can make a long walk from Ipanema to Copacabana and enjoy the views and atmosphere.

reviews.title: Lovely beach crammed with people
reviews.text: We cycled along to Ipanema from Cocacabana on a Brazilian holiday to find it even more crowded than Cocacabana. It is lovely however and full of lively locals having a great time. I'd recommend having a drink in the small cafes at the end of Leblon beach. From there you have a wonderful view right along the length of Ipenema and Leblon beaches.

reviews.title: Don’t hold out to go swimming here - the currents were strong and the water was dirty. Sunbaking appears to be the go.
reviews.text: There are 3 beaches that share this approximately 3.6 klm stretch of sand. Ipanema Beach is in the middle of Leblon Beach (to the west) and Arpoador Beach (to the east).We were lucky to have stayed for a week at a hotel just across the road from the beach and so had a lot of time to get a tiny bit of a feel for the place. We were looking forward to having a swim here but quickly observed that there were hardly any people swimming and when they did go in the water it was only predominantly up to their waist. We soon found out why when we went in. There are strong currants that run along the beach and we could see a number of rips. Also the water was pretty dirty and there were very few good waves for body surfing. On one day when the waves were a little large they were just breaking on shore.The beach though was packed on Saturday and Sunday, still very few people in the water, but with thousands of people sunbaking along the whole length of the beach. There were also literally hundreds playing volleyball, either the traditional way with their hands or just using their feet, chests and heads, or playing football or just kicking a ball around. There was a lot of bare skin and very few hats. There were plenty of people on the beach on weekdays as well.We were lucky in that our hotel had a tent on the beach and supplied us with sun baking lounges, umbrellas, towels and water at no extra cost. This would not have been a problem though as there were a plethora of other vendors who could supply the same things if you decided to sit in what appeared to be their designated areas, plus kiosks supplying drinks other than water. There were also dozens of vendors walking along the beach selling a range of things from trinkets to sarongs to hats to a large assortment of clothes, drink and food items.There were hundreds of people running, walking, skateboarding, roller skating and cycling along the beach every morning and afternoon into the early evening, particularly on Sunday when one side of the normally very busy Ave Delfim Moreira was closed to cars.

reviews.title: Great waves for surfing
reviews.text: This beach stretches on from copacabana but differs in that there are better waves here for surfing. The Arpoador which is like a rocky protrusion is a good place to watch the sunset. You walk through the park to get to the Arpoador and then continue on the beach front. There is a statue of Tom Jobin of ‘the girl from Ipanema’ fame on the pavement.

reviews.title: Not Like you Think
reviews.text: Yes, very famous, no, not what you picture it to be.  Dirty, and not very inviting.  Locals were not very friendly, but that could be because of the amount of tourists.

reviews.title: The good old Ipanema
reviews.text: Enjoying the beach is Rio is different. You lay down at the appropriate bench, see the water, your neighborhood and the coming sellers of all sort of "eatibles" and  "drinkables" to take advantage of the Sun and the environment.Relax and enjoy it.... it was great!

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: This is the famous and popular beach. It is really nice with wonderful views and the best sunset in the city

reviews.title: Took a walk and enjoyed the sun, the views and the beatiful ocean
reviews.text: Like the Copacabanna better, beach is wider, houses further away.But, it is a beatiful place even so.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: My husband and I walked Impanena Beach quite a few times as it was close to where we were staying. Also they had little bars for drinks scattered along the shoreline. Everyday was different and entertaining well worth the visits
