reviews.title: Great beach in great city
reviews.text: It's a great wide beach right in the city with close access to many hotels.  There are also plenty of vendors and other kiosks or mini-bars selling drinks, food, and toys.Additionally there are plenty of nets set up for beach soccer, volleyball, or volleyfut.

reviews.title: Famous for its GIRL !
reviews.text: The most elegant beach in Rio. Beautiful sunset.  Not so crowded as Copacabana. Water usually clean and not treacherous.

reviews.title: So beautiful!
reviews.text: Just as lovely as we imagined!  Legend!  Ipanema Beach is a place for young and old.  We walked the wide footpath and watched the various activities.  The beach is full of life, bars, icecream, cool drinks, cafes, restaurants, exquisite, intricate sand castle.  Lines of water sprinklers across the beach create a cool path across the hot sand to the water.    We wish we could have stayed longer!

reviews.title: Great vibe!!!!
reviews.text: Although i witness a lady getting her necklace robbed. The beach its amazing, make sure you stick for sunsets at the beach they look amazing.

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach , nice neighborhood to bike around . Path all along the beach . People selling everything !! Bikinis shrimp jewelry ... water ... you name it!

reviews.title: Everyone has to go to Ipanema Beach
reviews.text: Ipanema Beach is a place everyone should visit while you are there. The beach is full of life and activities. The people of Rio love their sport and beach activities. There is a walking / cycling path to view the beach if you don't want to get sand in between your toes. Lots of bars and cafes / restaurant along and across from the beach. I love the water sprinklers from the walk path on to the beach. It saves your feet from being burned by the hot sand. Australia needs to invest in this idea.

reviews.title: My favorite beach!
reviews.text: I love this beach, this place. What else can I say? It's my city! The people and the place complete eachother, making you feel confortable, at home!

reviews.title: Bike ride
reviews.text: Excellent clean no threat beach. In a better environment than Copacabana and with less traffic and taxis. Definitely worth a walk or a ride from AvAtlantic.

reviews.title: Iconic Beach
reviews.text: We came and watched the sunset on the rocks over Ipanema beach. It was like a scene from a really cheesy romcom movie and I mean that in the best possible way.

reviews.title: Better than Copacabana
reviews.text: This beach is getting more famous than Copacabana. More quiet as well with amazing view and amazing sea. Emplacemen at Posto 8 is one of the best

reviews.title: Rent a bicycle .. cruise along the beach
reviews.text: The beach is narrower than Copacabana  but still nice.  I live in Queensland Australia so I am spoilt for good beaches. Didn't think it was worth swimming in as the water is still cold in October. The place is still interesting though. Great for people watching and chilling out. We rented bikes and rode along the beach all the way to the end.  Then turned off by post 10 and rode inland to a lake and park. Was an excellent way to spend the day.

reviews.title: My favourite Brazillian beach
reviews.text: By far the best beach I visited along the Rio coastline. The water was the cleanest, warm enough to swim and calm.The service on the beach is amazing with waiters running up and down who can get you anything from caipirinhas to suncream to cigarettes to a swimming costume etc. I spent the most time here.

reviews.title: The good days are long gone
reviews.text: The famous Ipanema beach is losing its charm. With so many tents and chairs on the beach and  salespeople hunting tourists, it’s no longer an enjoyable or safe place to go. Hotels and apartment building are not being maintained and it’s visible the number of properties either for rent or sale. I wish I wasn’t saying this but it’s no longer a great place to go.

reviews.title: Insanely busy
reviews.text: Ipanema is cleaner than copacabana, but atleast on a week end next level busy, you'll have to work for a spot in the sand

reviews.title: was ok, other beaches much better
reviews.text: Went in Feb, time and it was ok, only bad thing was our rucksack got stolen! but l preferred other beaches to this better. and it was far away from city centre also.

reviews.title: Safer
reviews.text: Thus beach is, safer than Copabacabana beach. Very open view, and nice beach to walk and swim. In the weekend à lot of people.

reviews.title: Very Nice
reviews.text: Very nice beach and fascinating intensive life and people on the breach. Just watching everything that constantly goes on can keep you entertained the whole day. Lots of people during weekends but weekdays much more space. Always keep an a eye (and firm grip on) your belongings, bags, cameras etc as there are lots of muggings around.

reviews.title: Like Copacabana used to be
reviews.text: We were staying near Copacabana and took a taxi over to Ipanema. My friends were a little disappointed as it is less developed than Copacabana, but I said it was how Copacabana used to look the last time I visited Rio, which was over 15 years ago. There are little places selling drinks and a few with food, but it is much more limited than you see at Copacabana. The beach itself is narrower, but it is still pretty long. Its a pleasant walk along the pavement even if you aren't here for the beach itself.

reviews.title: Run and Bike
reviews.text: Such a beautiful run this morning along Ipanema Beach. Although it was raining the lighting and activity was still amazing. Made good use of the exercise stations along the way too.Later on we hired a bike each and cycled it as well, stopping for a coconut drink then to the point between Ipanema and Copacabana Beach where we found an outdoor, concrete barbell gym. Ill hit it tomorrow and pump some stone!!

reviews.title: Crowded 🏖 beach
reviews.text: On early mornings and especially earlt mirning week ends, this beach is fantastic! Very quite, friendly and clean;) But within a day it is more like a market when everybody sells smth. I spent one day on this beach but no more... i can not relax being in the centre of the market place ;((

reviews.title: Runner's review - Ipanema beach!
reviews.text: I'm not a beach person but I love to run.  Ipanema has a boardwalk running its entire length. Check the distance on something like map my run. It seems completely safe to me despite advice against carrying anything of value - though I did strip it down to an old ipod and cheap head phones. Nonetheless, this is another BEAUTIFUL Rio run, more attractive than Copacabana. I did it on a Sunday and one side of the bordering street was closed to traffic.  Hundreds of runners passing by all day long. Go for it.  Best part of Rio might be running the famous beaches and the Lagoon.

reviews.title: Hustle and bustle and life! Never boring!
reviews.text: This beach will have samba rhythms playing in your ears and put a smile on your face like only Brasil can! Lively and fun, Ipanema was one of my favorite city beach experiences ever! With humorous salespeople rushing up and down, in an endless parade of bikinis, caipirinhas and every type of snack under the Sun, it's a people watchers dream! You can't miss it!

reviews.title: Lovely beach but not as wide as Copacabana
reviews.text: We grew up with the soundtrack "Girl from Ipanema ......aaaarrgh" so we had to go  there. Essentially it is the same beach as Copocabana but it is narrower and much less commercialised. There are even a few places where the original sand dunes still survive - suitably fenced off

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Not as crowded or famous as Copa but still a very nice beach. If you want to get away from the big crowds come here

reviews.title: Not as nice as Copacabana
reviews.text: This beach is nice though less attractive than its bigger and more famous brother, Copacabana beach. It is less fancy and less eventful. Should be considered as second option.

reviews.title: Beautiful to take a ride
reviews.text: Río de Janeiro has many beaches, beautiful beaches, and Ipanema is not the exception, there are no as many sellers as there are in Copacabana. I advice you to rent a bike and take a ride throughout Ipanema.

reviews.title: Song is better
reviews.text: This was a stop on our tour of Rio, it was worth time to be able to sing the girl from Ipanema on Ipanema beach.

reviews.title: Great spot to walk all beach long, take a mojito, jogging...great landscapes
reviews.text: Landscape makes it unique; It's a beach as usual, but with particularities that gives them a brasileiro style: like mojitos spots all beach long... jogging over that particular lane. Those hills becomes experience a total brazilian style!!

reviews.title: Beautiful and clean
reviews.text: Strolled along the length of this beach on a Sunday afternoon watching the beach life in Rio. No one bothered us and we felt perfectly safe.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviews.text: The beach was beautiful. We were there before it was too crowded. Later we drove by and it was packed!! The sand is fine and there were a lot of places to get refreshments and cool off. A must see if you are in Rio.

reviews.title: Hot, hot, hot!
reviews.text: Great span of clean beaches, plenty of food/drink stalls as with Copacabana great Caiprinhas and cheap!!Spaces to play beach volley ball and public work out stations.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach.It has a very good views of the mountains around Ipanema.Worth a visit.Free wifi!!
Not as long as Copa; not as deep; less cafes and juice bars; and a narrower pavement.But still iconic, and a must visit.

reviews.title: Beautiful, crowded epicenter of the Brazilian Beach Culture
reviews.text: Of course when you go to Brazil you HAVE to see this beach. It's famous for many good reasons but it's not very clean (does any local even notice this?). The surf is a bit stronger than at Copacabana so more surfers and many tiny bikinis. People-watching is excellent -- maybe not so good for children.

reviews.title: This is the Beach
reviews.text: This is the best place to be in Rio. I was lucky to in Ipanema for 1,5 year and visited the beach as often as I could. I simply love this beach and my favorite posto is 9. The beachsellers are nice and the service is good. But be aware of your belongings and sometimes very high wawes.

reviews.title: A beach where the differences coexist
reviews.text: The beach of Ipanema is one of the most famous beaches in Rio de Janeiro, because there coexist the cultural differences of the world. Gays and traditional families live together in harmony. At the end of the afternoon, you can see one of the most beautiful sunsets in the world. The tourist can go to Pedra do Arpoador and from there watch this spectacle of nature.

reviews.title: The man in Ipanema
reviews.text: Probably the classiest of Rio's beaches.  Swimming is only for the strong but a nice place to relax and enjoy.

reviews.title: Amazing views and ambiance
reviews.text: If you sre in thr area on sunday, then a 25minute bike ride from copacabana is beautifulOn Sundays one side of the main road is closed to allow the people foe leisure activities. Absolutely great for a great family day out for the young and old and elderly.  Saw a lot of wheelchair  bound seniors bening brought out for some sunsine and fresh air!

reviews.title: Ipanema is overrated
reviews.text: Decades ago Ipanema used to be a fantastic beach. Clear water, white sand, beautifully bronzed bodies and peace were the norm. And yeah, it used to be a hot surf spot too. However, Ipanema has been yet another victim of Rio de Janeiro's decadence. The water is no longer very clear, except in rare instances. The sand is dirty and the overall ambience is loud and hectic, with the ocasional mugging, or worse - the famous arrastoes (gang muggings). Surfing? Not a chance; successive "improvements" on the beachfront have ruined what used to be a good beachbreak.  By the way, if you intend to see the beautiful "Girl from Ipanema", you're better off going to Barra da Tijuca beach, at a stretch of sand known as Praia do Pepe. That's where all the beautiful people show off their muscular, tanned bodies these days.

reviews.title: Amazing Beaches, coconuts, beer, music and soccer
reviews.text: This place was just how I imagined Rio de Janeiro… People were out till night time playing volleyball and soccer in the sand, there were kiosks dotted along the coast next to beautiful sidewalks. In the kiosk you could get food, beer, or coconuts and listen to beautiful music! If you walk further, you can get to Arapoador (sp?) for a beautiful view and also see the famous park that inspired Garota de Ipanema to be written.

reviews.title: Sun, fun and a lot of people.
reviews.text: Yeah' it's one of the most famous beaches in the world and, of course, it's a nice one but it's not too safe. The beach is always full of people and I know some people their bags have been lifted there. Policemen said there's nothing they can do.If you go there, take care.

reviews.title: Beautiful on vacations
reviews.text: On vacation days the beach is closed to cars and open to thr public  a great place to enjoy the atlantic ocean.

reviews.title: One of the best beach in the world
reviews.text: Ipanema beach is located in Rio and truly one of the most beautiful and colorful beach in the world with people basking in the sun as vendors walk around selling pastries, cocktails, sarongs and bikinis etc

reviews.title: Great for watching Volley Futball
reviews.text: I prefer this beach to Copacabana, and there are some nice restaurants to visit, as well as juice bars.

reviews.title: best beach in Rio
reviews.text: The best beach in Rio. You got everything in a more relaxing environment comparing to copacabana.You can also visit Loblon which is nearby

reviews.title: Just sit down and enjoy the show
reviews.text: Just get a chair, an umbrella, order a caipirinha, sit back and enjoy the best show in town. Watching people on Ipanema  beach is wonderful, don't miss it

reviews.title: Always Gorgeous
reviews.text: A must go for anyone visiting Rio.  Relatively safe to walk, even at night, fun, full of electricity.  It is the place where Brazilian democracy works.

reviews.title: Rio's best
reviews.text: Ipanema is beautiful in many senses. Clean beach, water and friendly people all around. As other places, always keep an eye open at all times. Beautiful sunset to top it off. Love it

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Ipanema is known for it's beautiful beach with white sandy beaches. It' s not expensive to hire a beach chair and parasol. There are really alert lifeguards around who do there jobs seriously ( we saw 2 life saver situations in 2 days). Where you rent your chair you can also order drinks and they even claim to have wifi. There are however a lot of salespersons walking around selling goods. A bit annoying sometimes. A tip: do not use regular towels on the beach but only kanga's ( the ones you can buy at the beginning of the beach). This makes it a little bit less obvious you are a tourist and therefor a good prey for thiefs.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach and fun on the weekend
reviews.text: Our visit in August meant the beach was quiet during the week, but volleyball still went on. On Sunday lively crowd with fun vendors coming through, and amazing surrounding mountains to balance the giant waves rolling in.

reviews.title: MUST SEE the statue of 'THE MAN FROM IPANEMA'
reviews.text: Ipanema Beach is a totally happening busy place to visit or walk along, beachside shopping!! The statue is fabulous - take a picture standing next to him!Walk along the beach, swim, eat ,then walk to the rocky outcrop!! Take a picture, as everyone seems to do, looking back to Ipanema - beautiful!!!

reviews.title: One of the Best in the World
reviews.text: I am a fan of beaches and have been to some of the best in the world. Ipanema is a great party beach.. Reminds me of SoCal and Cancun but with the natural beauty of a once in a million landscape. There was a food and craft beer festival when we went and it was amazing. Great music, great view, great vibes. Drumming circle too. Wow.

reviews.title: One of the worlds tip city beaches.
reviews.text: Ok it's not Bahia, but it's a great place to relax with great sand and at times of the day the hilly sand creates pools for children to play safely in. It's also a better vibe than copacabana which is more famous but not as good (more touristy and dirtier)

reviews.title: The best beach in Río!!
reviews.text: The water, the view of morro dos irmaos, everything in this beach is awesome, we went in August with 6 friends and enjoy a wonderful, warm day. It´s not summer, so the place is not that crowded. I recommend, if you stay in Copacabana, that you go to Ipanema, walking through the Avenida atlantica, is a nice way to see all the beach line. The prices at the bars on the beach, are really expensive, so walk into the neighborhood and you discover better options at good prices.

reviews.title: Quiet stroll
reviews.text: Ipanema is more quiet than Copacabana but seems to have the better waves. It is certainly a nice beach for mice walk along the sea shore

reviews.title: Wow'd by the sunset 🌅
reviews.text: Didn't spend much time here but the sunset was immense, beach was clean and the vendors were friendly. We found an event on at the time and mixed with locals who were so friendly, great food and great drink!

reviews.title: My favorite beach
reviews.text: My husband and I always stay some days in  Ipanema. Many restaurants, bars, hotels, apartments for ren't, and the beach is so gorgeous and so nice to be. I live drink and eat those stuffs they sell around you. I love to lay back and enjoy the beach and the people.Water is cold but is all you need on summer time

reviews.title: Relax place to enjoy great beach
reviews.text: This great and big beach is one of best attractions what Rio have, this is not only for swimming, this is place where need to be!

reviews.title: Beautiful day!
reviews.text: This beach always has a lot going on. The subway stop has a market on the weekend close to the beach at post 8. There are lots of people and activity, but the vendors don't bother you too much.

reviews.title: Breathtaking!!
reviews.text: Landed in Rio and am staying on Ipanema Beach, and was lucky enough to enjoy a breathtakingly gorgeous FULL MOON sunset. Wow!! I'm most thankful for the experience!

reviews.title: Nice to stroll along the beach
reviews.text: During low season the beach isn't crowded at all. I prefered the smaller beaches to the west (Vidigal, Soa Conrado) more for spending a complete day sunning and swimming, but I had some lovely late nights walks at Ipanema Beach. The beach is perfectly clean, very wide and perfect sand. Temperature is also perfect in April.I liked Ipanema more than Copacabana.

reviews.title: Busy but brilliant
reviews.text: The best beach in Rio. A sun trap with sugar like sand - busy with vendours but sometimes you really want them as you need beer and empanadas to get you through the day. Beware the sun - it's stronger than it feels.

reviews.title: Big reputation but looked run down
reviews.text: I stayed in Copacabana, near the fort, so it was a short 10 minute walk across local streets (Arpoador interrupts the coast.)  There were almost no vendors and half the buildings seemed empty or in disrepair.  Perhaps Ipanema has been hit harder by the economic slowdown, but I would go here for the "bucket list" factor, but I was definitely underwhelmed.  Copacabana was much, much better.

reviews.title: Lively beach!
reviews.text: Probably best beach in Rio...with several areas to stay in.Best way to watch this lovely beach is by walk!

reviews.title: Gorgeous Fun and Friendly
reviews.text: Looking good for a stunning tropical beach with golden sand and calm waters for swimming the head to Ipanema! It has everything you expect in. Rio beach with low deck chairs,  umbrellas,  volleyball players,  people selling all sorts of tat and constant hustle and bustle. You might relax and read a book but you won't really get any sleep!!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach and nice crowd
reviews.text: Located in the posh area of Rio de Janeiro, here is less action and more relaxing. The beaches are not safe when there are not many people around

reviews.title: Cannot beat it
reviews.text: Sand, Sun, great waves, surfers on one of the two most famous beaches in Rio while looking at  the Sugar Loaf...Just go, summer, winter, anytime.  My favorite...

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: We had a great time in Rio and spent some time at Ipanema Beach. It is quite incredible that a beach in a big city is so clean and well looked after. Renting a beach bed and having food and drink service is great and although there were lots of people selling things we did not find them aggressive at all and were happy to purchase things like acai and empanadas - yum! Also fun to watch people playing volleyball and having fun on the beach.

reviews.title: Mice
reviews.text: A nice beach with family and friends everywhere, creating a happy and enlightening environment. The surrounding areas are beautiful such as the mountains and hills. However too many people selling things and advertising their businesses, which is nice but some don't leave you alone which can be rather irritating.

reviews.title: A beautiful stretch of sandy beach
reviews.text: A lovely place to spend a day. Beach vendors sell everything you could need (from sun cream and bikinis, hot food, beer, ice cream to children's toys). You need not move all day if you don't want to 😎👍🏻

reviews.title: Beautiful scenery and people
reviews.text: The pictures and reputation speak for themselves. It's a great beach and feels more authentic than Copacabana. Be a bit cautious in the sea though: patches of foamy contamination sometimes come floating along.

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach
reviews.text: Of course you can't go to Rio without going to the beach. Ipanema is active and fun. A bit pricey, but it's all part of the experience. It was nice to watch the joggers, dogs, exercise maniacs and volley/football beach tournaments. Don't walk there unless there are many people walking about as I ran into trouble early in the morning (about 6:30am).

reviews.title: Ipaema Beach is Beautiful
reviews.text: Ipanema Beach is less crowded and quieter than Copacabana.  If you want the "action" go to Copacabana.  Ipanema, however, is beautiful and you can surf, swim, play volley ball, etc.  Grand view of Two Brothers mountains.

reviews.title: Nice and beautiful view points on the rocks.
reviews.text: Views from the Morros at the beginning of the beach coming from Copacabana are great. Large places on the rocks to enjoy the sun and the views. But the beach is smaller than Copacabana and too crowdy.

reviews.title: Crowded body fest
reviews.text: I personally thought Ipanema district is one of the blandest and dullest areas of Rio, not the real Rio and it is a shame too many people spend their entire time here at this place.Ipanema for me is just a place for vain people to show off their bodies. This is not necessarily a bad thing. Being serious, Ipanema is way safer than people say, as long as you keep an eye on your stuff you should be fine, but it is much more of a target than say Corcovado or Sugarloaf simply because its much more accessible (i.e. because its free). There's a better beach in Flamengo.

reviews.title: You feel the music
reviews.text: We just loved walking in Ipanema Beach and singing "garota from Ipanema"! The beach is as many others, but you just feel the music

reviews.title: Super
reviews.text: Ipanema beach is super nice. I love the sand the weather the Caipiroshka the sauted with garlic shrimp.... Everything

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: The local's beach. With the usual beach sales "staff" selling rubbish. Nice waves and relaxed pace. If you are not looking for an "in" place to go, this is a good beach to start with. Ipanema also has a good variety of shops in the neighbourhood.

reviews.title: A place of renown
reviews.text: We walked there from Copacabana. It was crowded on a Monday. A lovely beach with a matching atmosphere . The iconic place created by the song. Lots of girls to was but not all slim and tender.

reviews.title: Clean beach
reviews.text: Very clean beach and close to the business center if you need to grab some food or withdraw cash. Quite a few cafes on the beach for cocktails and beer. You do pay for chairs and umbrellas from local vendors.  Gets very busy when its sunny, people jogging and tanning. Also a nice location to view the majestic sunset.

reviews.title: Amazing and safe
reviews.text: This beach is Really Nice, and the best thing is that I felt safe. The brazilian people told me to visit this beach since it's the "nicer" beach, and that it's safer... if Your in Rio, visit this place 😍

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Much prettier and less crowded than Copacabana! Worth going to with uber, metro or taxi..You can rent bike everywhere, go for a run or just chill. The beach is clean and less crowded!

reviews.title: Pure beauty everywhere!
reviews.text: This is one of the best beaches located in the lovely neighborhood of Ipanema, definately worth a visit.

reviews.title: Just as you'd imagine it to be
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, clean, lovely views. Just play the girl from inane a while you're there. Lots of beach cafes if you need a drink or coffee

reviews.title: Hang gliders land here too
reviews.text: This beach is very nice and has a more personal feel being smaller and not so busy at Copacabana.  A bit further away from the main part of Rio but worth a visit

reviews.title: The Best Beach in Rio.
reviews.text: Unfortunately many of the dream -like beaches are not particuarly clean to sit or swim on, we were told by the locals to come to Ipanema. I love this beach- it gives me life!! There is space to chill, play sports, swim, dance, whatever you want to do! Fab views of Sugar Loaf Mountains at sunset too. Beautiful.

reviews.title: Favorite beach
reviews.text: I've been around the world and yet, this is still my favorite beach. The scenery is amazing, living and attractive crowds, and across the street is the city. This beach really has it all. It's a must see when visiting Rio.

reviews.title: The most IN beach in RIOOOO
reviews.text: Love Ipanema beach, always so IN! Beach with the most beautiful people in Rio, where fashion is in the air!

reviews.title: Great beach!
reviews.text: Had an amazing at Ipanema Beach. Its a beautiful place and not as dirty as I'd heard people saying. The water is kinda cold but Rio usually is a very hot place. There are always some people selling ice cream and some sort of snacks.

reviews.title: Outstanding Urban Beach
reviews.text: Few cities have the choices beach lovers have in Rio. Leme, Copacabana, Arpoador, Ipanema, Leblon, and the list goes on as the traveler ventures further down the Coast. With regard to Ipanema, specifically, it tends to be less crowded than its next door rival Copacabana and perhaps a bit more family oriented. But, on any stretch of beach the size of Copacabana or Ipanema you are likely to find a great variety of people and diversions. Families meet at the same location on the beach they have frequented all their lives, friends know exactly where to find them. Currently, Ipanema beach has one of those seemingly never ending/never completed construction projects - a new kiosk being built near the Aropador end, but that only interferes with a small part of the overall beach. Always keep in mind that the sun in Rio is extremely strong, and going to the beach without sunscreen or blocking cream is inviting a painful and potentially unhealthy sunburn. Brasilian beach lovers have skin conditioned by many years of exposure to the sun, but even most of them still use sun protection of some style or degree.

reviews.title: Bonito
reviews.text: Nice side walk towards the ocean.Many many people, walking, jogging, riding bicycles, skateboarding, playing at the beach. Lovely sand and sun. Amazing just it.

reviews.title: Surfing spot with great sunsets
reviews.text: Nice beach, with lots of activities going on. If you are up for surfing, you can rent boards there or take a lesson (Arpoador part of the beach).

reviews.title: Super clean, not crowded
reviews.text: This beach is awesome, it wasnt crowded at all, there were plenty of umbrellas and tables available. The view is amazing, and I love the rocks. By far my favorite beach in Sicily.

reviews.title: Iconic Beach
reviews.text: We stayed in an apartment just 1 block from the beach. It was winter there, but very comfortable, 75 degrees. We swam and enjoyed the beach. There is a great running/biking path as well as a beautiful walkway between the beach and the road. You can even have a drink brought to you as you lie on the beach.

reviews.title: Best beach for swimming in zona sul.
reviews.text: If you are looking for a nice Beach not far from Zona Sul Rio, this is your best option. It's cleaner than the more famous Copacabana beach but also has same look and feel. You can buy souvenirs, swimsuits, drinks,  food Etc from the vendors on the beach and sidewalk.

reviews.title: Local beach
reviews.text: Copacabana is crowded and is usually the first choice for the tourists. Ipanema is the local beach for the locals.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: What can one say, really. This is, after all, Ipanema! The beach does look gorgeous; would have dove into the sea if I were 30 years younger. Perhaps coz it was a relatively cold day, there was not many people there even though it was a Sunday afternoon.

reviews.title: Amazing beach, soft sand, clean water
reviews.text: Our family enjoyed an afternoon here after spending the day before at Copacabana. This was more upscale with fewer people selling stuff. The shopping area is nicer as well.  The sand is so soft and the water was just gorgeous. Very strong current so need to keep kids close.

reviews.title: Superb!
reviews.text: And very long!! A nice beach with all the typical stuff you can expect: locals offering food, drinks, and other things to rent or buy. Beautiful sand and overall clean. Not crowded at all in this season😎

reviews.title: Beware
reviews.text: This is one of the zones that is not very safe. We visited this zone during carnival, and I had an attempted pick pocket. Thankfully the kid didn't get anything. I had my money in a hidden pocket. The way the scam works is when you buy drinks at one of the vendors on the beach they watch where you get you cash from and watch where you put it away. Then they tell one of the local kids where the money is that you're holding. Stay in a large group when buying things, and don't be on the beach of the boardwalk at night.

reviews.title: Take your rubbish with you
reviews.text: Amazing beach lots to see and do nearby but please don't leave your rubbish on the beach! Strong currents in the waves so not always good for swing but great for a walk along, water is more calm near Arpoador which is a big rock outlet near one end of Ipanema and is better for swimming. Arpoador is a great place to visit just a few minutes walk down Ipanema beach and you can get some great pictures of the city and the beach from there. Parking along the beach can be hard to find and if you get a park it will cost $2 reals.

reviews.title: Lovely !
reviews.text: In my opinion it's better than Copacabana ! What else it's a beach isn't it, great sand ... hum lovely lace to chill, sunbath and have a deep.

reviews.title: Watch your belongings and your drinks
reviews.text: Great atmosphere and people watching to be had here. Buy some globos and make a mess eating them! That said, I had my drink spiked on this beach. Either that or I had a very unusual reaction to cachaca. This is a notorious beach for tourists to be targeted so keep your wits about you and stay in a group for safety.

reviews.title: A beach with classes,
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, lovely cafe, fun and active people are the attractions at Ipanema Beach. During day time, the beach is full of people in their beach activities: sports, sunbathing, ocean dipping. On the shore, rows of restaurants, cafe's and  bakeries catering all you need. You will fall in love with Ipanema.

reviews.title: Similar to Copa
reviews.text: Ipanema Beach is very similar to Copa but a little less touristy and not as much going on. We stayed here so obviously had a look

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: There really is a girl from Ipanema! She is now in her 70s but still beautiful! Breaking waves, lots of beautiful people playing games,and scenery to die for. Islands breakup the horizon and to your right Sugar loaf..
